title: AI Evaluation Should Work With Humans
comments: Accepted to ICML 2026 Position Paper Track
summary: This position paper argues that the dominant paradigm of AI evaluation (which focuses on superhuman autonomous performance and so implicitly targets the goal of replacing humans) is guiding AI development in the wrong direction. Instead, the AI community should pivot to evaluating the performance of human--AI teams. We argue that this collaborative shift will foster AI systems that act as true complements to human capabilities and therefore lead to far better societal outcomes than will the current process.
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Position Paper Track

title: BCMT: Blockwise Causal Memory Transformer
summary: Transformer architectures rely on dense self-attention to model long-range dependencies, but this mechanism exhibits quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length. We introduce BCMT (Blockwise Causal Memory Transformer), an architecture for long-context language modeling that decouples local token interactions from global context propagation. Dense causal self-attention is applied independently within local blocks, while each block produces an adaptive summary aggregated through an exponential causal memory. This memory is subsequently injected back into the token representations, enabling efficient propagation of long-range contextual information without relying on explicit global attention. Unlike standard Transformers and recurrent memory architectures, BCMT maintains neither dense interactions between distant tokens nor learned memory states. Its memory mechanism is fully parallelizable and remains compatible with standard implementations of dense self-attention. Experiments on language modeling with context lengths of up to 1024 tokens show that BCMT achieves validation performance comparable to that of Dense Transformers while significantly improving training throughput and reducing memory consumption. An ablation study further confirms that these improvements arise from the proposed memory mechanism. These results demonstrate that an exponential causal memory constructed from block summaries provides an effective alternative to dense global attention mechanisms for long-context language modeling.

title: Jais 2: A Family of Arabic-Centric Open Large Language Models
summary: Jais 2 is a family of Arabic-centric large language models developed jointly by MBZUAI, Cerebras, and Inception, designed to advance Arabic-centric language modeling, with strong performance across the Arabic and culturally grounded benchmarks evaluated in this report. The family includes, to our knowledge, the largest open Arabic-centric LLM trained from scratch at 70B parameters, and a competitive 8B-parameter variant among the evaluated open models. A custom Arabic-centric vocabulary enables efficient training and inference. In addition, an optimized architecture and training recipe yield highly compute-efficient training. With a substantially smaller token budget than comparable models, Jais 2 achieves strong Arabic performance on the benchmarks considered in this report and competitive English results. The models obtain leading results among the evaluated open models on OALL2 and AraGen. They also perform strongly on several culturally grounded Arabic benchmarks, including poetry, religion, cuisine, and dream interpretation, as well as in general tasks such as translation and summarization. We release the models in HuggingFace under a commercially permissive license. Jais 2 70B is also released as a chat app on the Web, iOS, and Android; it runs on Cerebras hardware, delivering up to 2,000 tokens per second, and enabling high-throughput Arabic-centric chat serving in our deployment setting. By uniting scale, linguistic diversity, cultural fidelity, openness, and speed, Jais 2 provides an open-weight foundation intended to support further research and development in Arabic-centric LLMs.

title: From Prediction to Intervention: Personalized Meal-Level Glucose Regulation via an LLM Agent
comments: Accepted in ACL 2026 Findings, 17 pages, 4 figures
summary: Personalized glucose regulation remains a central yet unresolved challenge in precision nutrition, as postprandial glucose response varies substantially across individuals. Existing approaches based on glycemic indices fail to adequately account for such heterogeneity and lack the mechanism to dynamically adjust meals based on personal physiological feedback. In this context, recent advances in LLM-based agents offer a promising direction, as they enable context-aware reasoning and iterative refinement. Inspired by this, we propose a physio-feedback agentic loop, a unified system that integrates individualized absorption modeling with dietary intervention to regulate glucose response. Specifically, we develop a Physiology-Aware Glucose Predictor to model individualized absorption dynamics through a learnable Temporal Physiological Absorption Decay Module. We then construct a Prediction-Driven Two-Stage Meal Optimization Agent that iteratively refines real-world meals using predicted outcomes as explicit feedback. Through extensive experiments on multiple public datasets, we demonstrate that our method not only improves prediction accuracy but also effectively reduces glucose excursions. To the best of our knowledge, this paper marks the first step in integrating physiological learning with an LLM-based agent for personalized glucose regulation.
comment: Accepted in ACL 2026 Findings, 17 pages, 4 figures

title: Regulation, Power, and the Compliance 1 Paradox: A Longitudinal Study of Smart Homes
summary:
Smart home technologies are becoming increasingly embedded in domestic environments, yet their implications for power, privacy, and inequality remain insufficiently understood, particularly in non-Western contexts. This paper presents a longitudinal socio-technical study of smart home adoption in Jordan, examining how cultural norms, regulatory frameworks, and everyday technological practices shape domestic power dynamics.
  Building on our 2022 study, we employ a two-phase grounded theory approach comprising (1) a secondary analysis of 30 interviews and (2) 28 new interviews conducted in 2025 with returning and new participants, including household members, domestic workers, policymakers, and civil society advocates. This design provides a rare longitudinal perspective on how regulatory and technological change reshapes domestic surveillance practices.
  Our findings reveal a compliance paradox: although Jordan's 2023 Data Protection Law has increased privacy awareness, it also enables new forms of exploitation by leaving domestic contexts largely outside its scope. We identify three dynamics: (1) the normalization of passive surveillance through convenience and legal compliance; (2) regulatory ambiguity that shifts responsibility to households, reinforcing existing hierarchies; and (3) constrained resistance among domestic workers facing intensified monitoring.
  We contribute a longitudinal account of how privacy regulation is appropriated within socio-cultural systems to reproduce existing inequalities. We conclude by identifying four intervention spaces across design, policy, and advocacy, emphasizing the need for contextually grounded approaches to privacy governance in smart home ecosystems.

title: Beyond Simplification: DFT-GEN for Fidelity-Preserving Visual Accessibility in Dyslexia-Friendly Educational Texts
summary: Dense educational texts impose avoidable reading friction on people with dyslexia, yet generic simplification can delete terminology, task constraints, or source evidence that readers still need. Stakeholder interviews with dyslexic adults and specialists reveal a core tension: reduced burden must not compromise information fidelity. We present DFT-GEN, a stakeholder-informed text transformation framework for content-heavy educational materials. Its central contribution is not a generic LLM refinement loop, but a dyslexia-specific accessibility layer that combines protected-span preservation with a deterministic Dyslexia Accessibility Controller (DAC) for rendered visual organization. DAC converts stakeholder and expert preferences into reproducible controls for visual-unit length, chunk spacing, source/task separation, highlighting budget, and reviewable risk flags. We therefore separate evaluation into DCFI, a fidelity-safety diagnostic, and B-DVAS-VL, a rendered visual-accessibility diagnostic. On 2,280 bilingual exam-style items, DFT-GEN preserves task-critical information while improving visual accessibility: it wins 93% in English and 64% in Chinese of B-DVAS-VL pairwise judgments against same-backbone controls, and in a controlled pilot with dyslexic adult readers it preserves answerability while reducing effort.

title: UltraArUco: A Lightweight Multilingual Library And Framework With Low-Latency Real-Time Marker-Based Tracking System For Mobile AR Interaction
summary: UltraArUco - a lightweight multilingual library and framework for low-latency, real-time marker-based tracking in mobile augmented reality. Unlike standard OpenCV-based implementations, UltraArUco introduces an optimized multilingual wrapper that reduces per-frame latency by five times, while maintaining high accuracy. Distributed Wi-Fi architecture provides portability, connects a mobile device (camera input) with a PC-based visual application, enabling responsive interactions. The framework is validated through an interactive piano simulation, where static ArUco markers on keys enable occlusion-based note triggering, and hand-mounted markers provide spatial gesture recognition. UltraArUco's system requirements make it perfect for resource-constrained mobile AR applications, demonstrating a viable AR music application without specialized equipment.

title: FactorFlow: A Visual Analytics Workspace with Large Language Model-Assisted Interpretation for Factor Analysis
summary: In exploratory factor analysis (EFA), one typically aims to extract and describe a small number of factors (i.e., latent variables) based on the relationships among numerous manifest variables (i.e., directly observable variables). In practice, performing EFA entails examining different factor models (and rotations) to identify the underlying latent structure. Now, the primary criterion for evaluating a factor model is interpretability. That is, the preferred model is the one that yields a meaningful, coherent, and theoretically defensible factor structure. However, gauging a model's interpretability is not a trivial task, as it is subjective and often requires keeping track of large amounts of information simultaneously. Because of this, researchers typically employ various visualizations to interpret models and determine the "best" one. Hence, we introduce FactorFlow, a visual analytics workspace for performing EFA end-to-end. Using FactorFlow, one can fit and rotate factor models, perform model diagnostics, and more. The main component of the tool is a dashboard with a comprehensive set of interactive visualizations, where a user can easily dissect a factor model and even compare two models side-by-side at the same time. Moreover, several large language models are integrated with FactorFlow, enabling the user to generate and assess automated factor interpretations written in natural language. With multiple views and readily available calculations, FactorFlow can enable the researcher to efficiently and effectively understand factors and ultimately, perform EFA. Finally, we conducted a usability study to identify strengths and weaknesses, and capture feedback to incorporate in the app.

title: The Tool-to-Entity Threshold: Parasocial Dynamics of Personalised AI Agents in Shared Social Spaces
summary: As AI agents acquire names, avatars, phone numbers, and persistent personalities, they increasingly inhabit the same messaging platforms and group conversations as the humans they serve, crossing from tools their users operate into social entities their users relate to. This reclassification carries under-explored consequences for consent, emotional attachment, and group dynamics, yet no existing framework identifies the specific infrastructural markers that cause it. We propose the identity marker framework: six design variables (naming, visual identity, contact presence, personality derivation, social co-presence, and persistence) that collectively trigger a discrete psychological reclassification, operating independently of model capability. The framework is derived inductively and read through two established lenses: parasocial interaction theory (Horton & Wohl, 1956) and the Computers Are Social Actors paradigm (Nass et al., 1994). We further identify four novel dynamics that arise when such an agent participates in existing group conversations: bidirectional information asymmetry, delegation legibility, social norm negotiation, and parasocial contagion. Our method is autoethnographic: the first author built and deployed a personalised agent into WhatsApp and Signal group chats over two months of live use, supplemented by twelve structured interviews with the group members who encountered it. We treat this as a preliminary qualitative evaluation of the framework, with controlled experimental validation left to future work. The strongest design implication runs through all four dynamics: in shared social spaces, consent to an agent's presence is categorically distinct from consent to its processing of the messages exchanged there, and existing consent frameworks collapse the two.

title: Student-ChatGPT Interaction Visible: Designing a Teacher Dashboard for EFL Writing Education
summary: We present a Prompt Analytics Dashboard (PAD) for teachers that can traces student-LLM interactions from EFL writing classes. PAD can show student prompt-response exchanges with LLM chatbot and English essay writing revision histories to support data-informed instruction and visibility in classes. Through two iterative co-design sessions with six EFL instructors, we distilled a compact trace taxonomy (misuse signals, goal-alignment cues, revision effort) and instantiated three interface views (overview, week/outcome filter, drill-down with evidence snippets). This pipeline summarizes potential misuse and alignment at class/cohort levels and attaches micro-explanations to reduce over-surveillance. Instructors reported reduced scanning burden and clearer timing for interventions.

title: IterCOMP: Reasoning-aware Adaptive Prompt Compression for Multi-hop Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop question answering requires complex reasoning across multiple evidence segments, which often overwhelms retrieval-augmented generation systems with lengthy and noisy contexts, thereby undermining both efficiency and accuracy. While existing prompt compression methods attempt to address this issue, they are typically designed for single-turn queries and fail to capture interdependent reasoning steps. We propose IterCOMP, a unified, training-free prompt compression framework that incorporates multi-hop reasoning within an iterative compression loop. IterCOMP decomposes documents into evidence segments, evaluates question answerability, and generates targeted follow-up questions to iteratively integrate essential evidence, producing a compact, reasoning-oriented prompt. Experiments on MusiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA demonstrate that IterCOMP achieves substantial improvements in Exact Match and F1 scores while reducing the token budget, outperforming existing baselines and exhibiting robustness as reasoning complexity increases.

title: Context Aware AI Assistant and AR Interface for Lunar Extravehicular Activity (EVA) Procedural Guidance
comments: 4 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted to ACM SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference Posters, July 19-23, 2026, Los Angeles, California, USA
summary: As human space exploration returns to the Moon, astronauts need rapid access to procedural information during extravehicular activities (EVAs), where attention is divided across navigation, repair tasks, tool handling, and environmental risk. The challenge is not the absence of information, but surfacing the right information at the right moment. We present GAIN-AI (Guided Assistant for Intelligent Navigation), a context-aware AI assistant and minimal heads-up interface for procedural guidance in simulated lunar EVA. The system operates in two layers. The first grounds a large language model with structured context: EVA procedure documents, live telemetry data, and error-handling protocols encoded as JSON. The second restructures that output into three compact units for AR display: Goal, Task, and Verification. Evaluated on 111 synthetic EVA scenarios, the system scores 10.0/10 on nominal conditions and 8.15/10 on single-fault scenarios, with performance degrading on multi-fault and boundary-threshold cases.
comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted to ACM SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference Posters, July 19-23, 2026, Los Angeles, California, USA

title: Robust XGBoosting for Regression
summary: XGBoost is a very popular and powerful method for prediction. It iteratively fits simple decision trees to the residuals of the previous step. An efficient and scalable implementation is available. The standard loss function for XGBoost is the quadratic loss, but a Huber loss can also be used. In this paper, we study the robustness of XGBoost and show that its performance can be affected by vertical outliers and leverage points. To address this, we explore alternative loss functions, based on M-, S-, and τ -estimators from robust regression. Our results indicate that a two-step procedure, referred to as MM-XGBoost, provides the best trade-off between robustness and prediction accuracy.

title: Stable Miscalibration in Large Language Models: A Practical View of High-Confidence Errors
comments: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML)@ICML 2026. 7 pages, 4 figures
summary: High-confidence errors in large language models are often treated as evidence of fragile internal inference. We study a different possibility: stable miscalibration, where a confident wrong answer remains locally stable under small perturbations. We combine two diagnostics: a label-aware output-level audit score that ranks domains by confidence variation and overconfident mistakes under a forced-answer baseline, and an internal sensitivity probe that measures hidden-state movement. On a multi-domain binary factual audit set, this audit score tracks where abstention-aware self-critique reduces decision loss, although direct labeled baselines rank the same gain more strongly. Internally, self-critical prompting consistently reduces hidden-state sensitivity across layers in three open-weight models. This supports prompt-induced local stabilization rather than a purely output-level abstention pattern, but it does not imply calibration: audit-defined overconfident errors are not clearly more locally sensitive than confidently correct answers, so some high-confidence errors may be stable and miscalibrated rather than simply fragile.
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML)@ICML 2026. 7 pages, 4 figures

title: Towards Scaling Qualitative Analysis of Video Data
summary: Scaling qualitative video analysis is difficult as studies grow. This paper presents QualiVision, a design probe examining how an interactive, spreadsheet-backed workspace can support video-based qualitative analysis. By integrating video, transcripts, coding streams, preliminary reports, heuristic visualization and AI support, QualiVision aims to help researchers preserve evidence, compare interpretations, and conduct iterative, reflexive sensemaking as their analysis evolves.

title: Training-Free Knowledge Transfer Across Model Scales through Activation-Guided Pruning
summary: Heterogeneous model fusion seeks to combine models that differ in tasks, initializations, architectures, or scales. We study an underexplored cross-scale setting: improving a small recipient language model with a stronger donor despite substantial architectural mismatch. We ask whether useful capabilities can be transferred without explicit neuron-wise semantic alignment. Building on the observation that truncating a large model to a smaller architecture and injecting it with a tiny mixing weight can already improve the recipient, we propose Activation-Prune-Merge (APM), an activation-guided framework for cross-scale fusion. APM constructs task-conditioned activation maps on the donor, selects salient layers, hidden dimensions, attention heads, and MLP neurons to prune it to the recipient architecture, and injects the resulting donor slice into the original recipient using a micro interpolation coefficient. This formulation treats the donor as a source of concentrated functional components rather than requiring precise structural transplantation. Across 16 benchmarks spanning reasoning, mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and classification, APM improves the overall average accuracy from 55.5% to 60.6% over the original 3B recipient. RTE accuracy increases from 64.3% to 82.3%, QNLI from 52.3% to 65.7%, and BoolQ from 70.8% to 79.2%. Analyses of injection ratios and sequential multi-stage fusion further suggest that activation-guided extraction improves the quality of the transferable donor slice while preserving the small-ratio fusion regime. These results provide evidence that cross-scale heterogeneous fusion can succeed without explicit semantic alignment when the donor contribution is sufficiently concentrated and carefully selected.

title: Measuring Cross-Task Behavioral Consistency in Language Model Agents
summary: Agent evaluation relies almost entirely on outcome metrics such as success rate, which capture whether an agent succeeds but not how consistently it behaves. We argue that behavioral consistency across tasks is a distinct and measurable property, and we introduce the Behavioral Consistency Metric (BCM) to quantify it. BCM trains a model to predict task success from behavioral features of agent execution traces, derives a per-trajectory feature-attribution vector, and measures the mean pairwise similarity of these vectors within an agent system. Across roughly 9,000 trajectories from six language model agents on software engineering tasks, our central finding is that cross-task and within-task consistency are distinct axes that can diverge: some systems are locally reproducible, behaving similarly on repeated attempts at one task, yet globally fragmented, with no stable strategy across different tasks, while others are consistent at both scales. Prior work measures only same-task reproducibility and so cannot observe this separation. We further find that consistency is not reducible to success rate, since systems with comparable success can differ sharply in consistency, and that the frontier-versus-open-source consistency gap persists under a within-task control that holds task difficulty constant. We position BCM as a process-level reliability signal that complements outcome metrics, and we are explicit about the conditions under which it is meaningful.

title: Continual Evolution Strategies in Control Tasks
comments: Accepted for publication in the GECCO 2026 Companion Proceedings
summary: We study Evolution Strategies (ES) for continual control, where agents must adapt to changing tasks without forgetting previous ones. On sequential MuJoCo locomotion tasks, naive ES suffers from severe catastrophic forgetting. Replay substantially improves retention and can induce positive transfer, while larger replay budgets reduce plasticity. Overall, these results show that ES can support continual adaptation in control and that replay is an effective mechanism for mitigating forgetting.
comment: Accepted for publication in the GECCO 2026 Companion Proceedings

AI.title_translation: 控制任务中的持续进化策略
AI.tldr: 研究发现朴素进化策略在持续控制任务中存在严重灾难性遗忘，而经验回放机制可有效减轻遗忘并促进正向迁移。
AI.motivation: 在持续控制场景中，智能体需要在适应不断变化的新任务的同时不遗忘先前学到的旧任务，因此需要研究进化策略（ES）在此类场景下的表现及遗忘问题。
AI.method: 在连续的 MuJoCo 运动控制任务序列上研究进化策略（ES），并引入和评估了回放（Replay）机制及其不同预算规模对性能的影响。
AI.result: 朴素进化策略存在严重的灾难性遗忘；引入回放机制显著提升了旧任务的保留能力，并能引发正向迁移，但更大的回放预算会降低模型适应新任务的可塑性。
AI.conclusion: 进化策略（ES）能够支持控制任务中的持续适应，且回放机制是缓解灾难性遗忘的有效手段。
AI.translation: 我们研究了用于持续控制的进化策略（ES），在该场景下，智能体必须在不遗忘先前任务的前提下适应不断变化的新任务。在序列化的 MuJoCo 运动任务中，朴素 ES 会遭受严重的灾难性遗忘。回放机制能够显著改善记忆保留，并可以带来正向迁移，而更大的回放预算则会降低模型的可塑性。总体而言，这些结果表明 ES 能够支持控制中的持续适应，且回放是缓解遗忘的有效机制。
AI.summary: 本研究针对连续控制任务探讨了进化策略（ES）的持续学习能力。实验表明，朴素ES会遭受严重的灾难性遗忘，而采用回放机制能显著减轻遗忘并促进正向迁移，同时存在回放预算与可塑性之间的权衡。
AI.keywords: 进化策略, 持续控制, 灾难性遗忘, 经验回放, MuJoCo
AI.comments: 该研究探索了基于黑盒优化的进化策略（ES）在持续强化学习控制任务中的应用，证明了传统基于梯度的持续学习技术（如经验回放）在进化计算范式中同样有效，并指出了记忆保留与模型可塑性之间的权衡关系。

title: Hard Cases, Bad Labels: Testing Error Exposure and Error Location in Uncertainty Sampling Under Bounded Label Noise
comments: 14 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/dev-juy/hard-cases-bad-labels
summary: Active learning can reduce labeling cost by selecting informative examples, but the most uncertain examples may also be the hardest to label correctly. This study tests whether uncertainty sampling fails because it acquires more corrupted labels or because errors concentrated in difficult regions are especially harmful. Margin-based uncertainty sampling is compared with random sampling under clean labels, random classification noise (RCN), and bounded difficulty-dependent noise on three public binary tabular datasets. The design uses 100 paired seeds, nine expected noise rates from 0 to 0.30, annotation budgets from 20 to 120, and logistic regression with regularization re-selected by cross-validation at every budget. An exposure-matched RCN control aligns mean final acquired corruption, while a clean-label extension reaches budget 400. Under clean labels, uncertainty sampling improved normalized balanced-accuracy area under the learning curve by 1.09 to 1.77 percentage points on all datasets. Difficulty-dependent noise reduced this advantage more than RCN at six of eight rates on Breast Cancer Wisconsin, but at no tested rate on Banknote Authentication or MAGIC Gamma Telescope. Exposure-matched analyses found no corrected evidence for a universal additional penalty from structured error location. On clean MAGIC data, uncertainty sampling improved balanced accuracy while reducing average precision and true-positive rate at fixed false-positive rates. Thus, uncertainty sampling was label-efficient, but its apparent robustness depended on dataset, budget, noise structure, and evaluation metric.
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/dev-juy/hard-cases-bad-labels

AI.title_translation: 疑难案例，错误标签：在有界标签噪声下测试不确定性采样中的错误暴露和错误位置
AI.tldr: 本研究测试了主动学习中不确定性采样在标签噪声下的鲁棒性。其有效性取决于数据集、预算、噪声类型和评估指标，并未发现结构化错误位置会带来普遍的额外惩罚。
AI.motivation: 本研究旨在测试不确定性采样失败的原因，是由于获取了更多受损标签，还是因为集中在困难区域的错误特别有害。
AI.method: 本研究在三个公共二元表格数据集上，比较了基于裕度（margin-based）的不确定性采样与随机采样在干净标签、随机分类噪声（RCN）和有界难度依赖噪声下的表现。实验设计包括100个配对种子，九种0到0.30的预期噪声率，20到120的标注预算，并在每个预算下使用通过交叉验证重新选择的带正则化的逻辑回归。同时使用了暴露匹配的RCN控制和干净标签扩展。
AI.result: 在干净标签下，不确定性采样在所有数据集上将学习曲线下的归一化平衡准确度面积提高了1.09到1.77个百分点。在乳腺癌威斯康星数据集上，难度依赖噪声在八个比率中的六个比率下比RCN更显著地降低了这一优势，但在纸币认证或MAGIC伽马望远镜数据集上则没有。暴露匹配分析没有发现结构化错误位置带来普遍额外惩罚的修正证据。在干净的MAGIC数据上，不确定性采样提高了平衡准确度，同时在固定假阳性率下降低了平均精度和真阳性率。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性采样是标签高效的，但其表观鲁棒性取决于数据集、预算、噪声结构和评估指标。
AI.translation: 主动学习可以通过选择信息丰富的示例来降低标注成本，但最不确定的示例也可能是最难正确标注的。本研究测试了不确定性采样失败的原因，是因为它获得了更多错误标签，还是因为集中在困难区域的错误特别有害。在三个公共二元表格数据集上，将基于裕度（margin-based）的不确定性采样与随机采样在干净标签、随机分类噪声（RCN）和有界难度依赖噪声下进行了比较。该设计使用了100个配对种子，九种0到0.30的预期噪声率，20到120的标注预算，以及在每个预算下通过交叉验证重新选择的带正则化的逻辑回归。暴露匹配的RCN控制对齐了最终获得的平均损坏，而干净标签扩展达到了预算400。在干净标签下，不确定性采样在所有数据集上将学习曲线下的归一化平衡准确度面积提高了1.09到1.77个百分点。在乳腺癌威斯康星数据集上，难度依赖噪声在八个比率中的六个比率下比RCN更显著地降低了这一优势，但在纸币认证或MAGIC伽马望远镜数据集上则没有。暴露匹配分析没有发现结构化错误位置带来普遍额外惩罚的修正证据。在干净的MAGIC数据上，不确定性采样提高了平衡准确度，同时在固定假阳性率下降低了平均精度和真阳性率。因此，不确定性采样是标签高效的，但其表观鲁棒性取决于数据集、预算、噪声结构和评估指标。
AI.summary: 本研究调查了主动学习中不确定性采样在各种标签噪声条件下的性能。它在三个数据集上比较了基于裕度（margin-based）的不确定性采样与随机采样，并纳入了随机噪声和难度依赖噪声。研究结果表明，尽管不确定性采样是标签高效的，并在干净标签下提高了平衡准确度，但其鲁棒性会因数据集、标注预算、噪声结构和评估指标的不同而显著变化。研究没有发现普遍的证据表明集中在困难区域的错误会带来额外的惩罚。
AI.keywords: 主动学习, 不确定性采样, 标签噪声, 错误位置, 平衡准确度
AI.comments: 这篇论文为主动学习的实际挑战提供了宝贵的见解，特别是在存在标签噪声的情况下不确定性采样的问题。其详细的实验设计，通过比较不同噪声类型和评估指标在各种数据集上的表现，突出了真实世界主动学习场景的复杂性。鲁棒性高度依赖于上下文的发现对实践者至关重要。缺乏结构化错误位置带来额外惩罚的普遍证据也是一项重要的贡献，挑战了潜在的假设。

title: Omni-LiveAvatar: Minute-Level Real-Time Streaming Joint Audio-Visual Avatar Generation
summary: Joint audio-video generative models serve as foundation for immersive and interactive digital-human generation. Nevertheless, most existing models rely on bidirectional attention and multi-step denoising and can generate only short clips, making them unsuitable for real-time interaction over extended durations. We present Omni-LiveAvatar, the first framework for minute-level, real-time streaming joint audio-video avatar generation. Specifically, we propose (1) a progressive autoregressive distillation pipeline that transfers a large bidirectional joint audio-video diffusion model into a few-step autoregressive generator without auxiliary stabilization mechanisms; (2) a synchronized audio-video long-short-term memory that preserves global consistency under a bounded memory budget; and (3) a hierarchical rolling prompt planning strategy that enables coherent semantic evolution and seamless prompt transitions. Extensive experiments show that Omni-LiveAvatar generates high-quality, synchronized minute-level avatars in real time. In terms of speed, it achieves a 33$\times$ generation speedup over its teacher, LTX-2, on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU; in terms of generation quality, it outperforms accelerated baselines across visual quality, audio quality, cross-modal synchronization, and human fidelity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Aoko955/Omni-LiveAvatar.

AI.title_translation: Omni-LiveAvatar：分钟级实时流式音视频联合虚拟形象生成
AI.tldr: Omni-LiveAvatar是一个首创的框架，能够实现分钟级的实时流式音视频联合虚拟形象生成，解决了现有模型无法进行长时间实时交互的问题，并在生成速度和质量上均超越了现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的音视频联合生成模型大多依赖双向注意力机制和多步去噪，只能生成短片段，不适用于长时间的实时交互。
AI.method: 本文提出了Omni-LiveAvatar框架，该框架包含：1) 一个渐进式自回归蒸馏流程，将大型双向音视频扩散模型转换为无需辅助稳定机制的少步自回归生成器；2) 一个同步音视频长短期记忆模块，在有限内存预算下保持全局一致性；3) 一个分层滚动提示规划策略，实现连贯的语义演变和无缝的提示转换。
AI.result: Omni-LiveAvatar能实时生成高质量、同步的分钟级虚拟形象。在单张NVIDIA H200 GPU上，其生成速度比其教师模型LTX-2快33倍；在视觉质量、音频质量、跨模态同步和人类保真度方面，均优于加速基线模型。
AI.conclusion: Omni-LiveAvatar成功实现了分钟级实时流式音视频联合虚拟形象生成，显著提升了生成速度和质量，为沉浸式和交互式数字人生成提供了新的解决方案。
AI.translation: 音视频联合生成模型是沉浸式和交互式数字人生成的基础。然而，大多数现有模型依赖于双向注意力和多步去噪，并且只能生成短片段，这使得它们不适用于长时间的实时交互。我们提出了Omni-LiveAvatar，这是第一个用于分钟级、实时流式音视频联合虚拟形象生成的框架。具体来说，我们提出了 (1) 一个渐进式自回归蒸馏流程，它将一个大型双向音视频扩散模型转换为一个无需辅助稳定机制的少步自回归生成器；(2) 一个同步音视频长短期记忆模块，它在有限内存预算下保持全局一致性；以及 (3) 一个分层滚动提示规划策略，它实现了连贯的语义演变和无缝的提示转换。大量实验表明，Omni-LiveAvatar能够实时生成高质量、同步的分钟级虚拟形象。在速度方面，它在单张NVIDIA H200 GPU上比其教师模型LTX-2实现了33倍的生成加速；在生成质量方面，它在视觉质量、音频质量、跨模态同步和人类保真度方面均优于加速基线模型。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Aoko955/Omni-LiveAvatar 获取。
AI.summary: Omni-LiveAvatar是一个创新的框架，旨在解决现有音视频联合生成模型在实时、长时间交互方面的局限性。它通过引入渐进式自回归蒸馏、同步音视频长短期记忆以及分层滚动提示规划策略，实现了分钟级、高质量、实时流式的音视频联合虚拟形象生成。实验证明，Omni-LiveAvatar在生成速度上比现有模型快33倍，并在多项质量指标上均表现出色，为沉浸式数字人应用提供了强大的支持。
AI.keywords: 实时生成, 虚拟形象, 音视频联合, 模型蒸馏, 流式生成
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种创新的实时流式音视频联合虚拟形象生成框架Omni-LiveAvatar，通过结合模型蒸馏、记忆机制和规划策略，有效克服了现有模型在生成时长和实时性上的瓶颈。其在速度和质量上的显著提升，对于推动数字人、虚拟现实和元宇宙等领域的实时交互应用具有重要意义。

title: Cross-Disciplinary Taxonomy and Modeling of Misunderstanding Generation, Amplification, and Detection, from Pragmatics to AI Agents
comments: 49 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables, 94 references. Cross-disciplinary conceptual synthesis across multiple fields. Includes a source-by-source evidence matrix in Appendix A and a coding manual in Appendix B for independent application of the taxonomy
summary: Detection of misunderstanding is an urgent problem to solve because communication has moved away from real-time, in-person interaction and is increasingly handled by AI-mediated channels. This shift cuts communicators off from the resources repair depends on faster than new means of detection are being built. In this paper we analyse misunderstanding as a layered process in which a divergence is generated, may then be amplified, and is either detected and repaired or left to persist unnoticed. Consolidating accounts from nine fields of research that do not ordinarily cite one another, we identify eleven exact failure modes and show that each operates at a specific point in a communicative process rather than anywhere within it. Those points give eight analytical layers, derived from the literature rather than adopted from an existing model. Eight of the mechanisms primarily generate a divergence, two primarily amplify one already present, and one governs whether a divergence is detected and repaired. We model the eight layers formally, extending information and communication theory from the transmission of signals to the reconstruction of meaning, and we supply a source-by-source evidence matrix that makes every rating auditable, a coding manual, and nine analysed dialogue cases. No prior classification of misunderstanding both locates mechanisms at points in the process and types them by function.
comment: 49 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables, 94 references. Cross-disciplinary conceptual synthesis across multiple fields. Includes a source-by-source evidence matrix in Appendix A and a coding manual in Appendix B for independent application of the taxonomy

AI.title_translation: 跨学科的误解生成、放大和检测分类学与建模：从语用学到人工智能代理
AI.tldr: 本文提出一个跨学科的误解分类和建模框架，分析了误解的生成、放大和检测过程，识别了11种失败模式和8个分析层，并正式建模，以解决AI媒介通信中误解检测的紧迫问题。
AI.motivation: 随着通信从实时、面对面互动转向AI媒介渠道，沟通者失去了修复误解所需的资源，而新的检测手段尚未建立。因此，检测误解是一个亟待解决的紧迫问题。
AI.method: 本文将误解分析为一个分层过程，包括分歧的生成、放大以及检测和修复。通过整合来自九个不同研究领域的理论，识别出11种精确的失败模式，并确定它们在通信过程中的特定操作点。这些点形成了8个分析层。研究者对这8个层进行了形式化建模，将信息和通信理论从信号传输扩展到意义重建。此外，还提供了一个逐源证据矩阵、一个编码手册和九个已分析的对话案例。
AI.result: 研究识别出11种精确的误解失败模式，并将其定位在通信过程中的特定点，从而建立了8个分析层。其中，8种机制主要产生分歧，2种主要放大已存在的分歧，1种机制控制分歧是否被检测和修复。该模型扩展了信息和通信理论，并提供了一个可审计的证据矩阵、编码手册和案例。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种新颖的误解分类方法，首次将误解机制定位在通信过程中的特定点并根据其功能进行分类，为AI媒介通信中误解的检测和修复提供了全面的理论框架和工具。
AI.translation: 误解检测是一个亟待解决的紧迫问题，因为通信已经从实时、面对面互动转向了由人工智能（AI）介导的渠道。这种转变使得沟通者失去修复所依赖的资源的速度，快于新的检测手段的建立。在本文中，我们将误解分析为一个分层过程，其中分歧被生成，随后可能被放大，并被检测和修复，或者被忽视而持续存在。通过整合九个通常不相互引用的研究领域的观点，我们识别出十一种精确的失败模式，并表明每种模式都在通信过程中的特定点而非任意位置运作。这些点形成了八个分析层，这些层是从文献中推导出来的，而非采纳现有模型。其中八种机制主要产生分歧，两种主要放大已存在的分歧，一种机制控制分歧是否被检测和修复。我们对这八个层进行了形式化建模，将信息和通信理论从信号传输扩展到意义的重建，并且我们提供了一个逐源证据矩阵，使每个评级都可审计，一个编码手册，以及九个已分析的对话案例。之前没有哪种误解分类方法能同时将机制定位在过程中的特定点并按其功能进行分类。
AI.summary: 本文针对AI媒介通信中误解检测的紧迫问题，提出了一个跨学科的误解生成、放大和检测的分类学与建模框架。通过整合九个研究领域的知识，识别出11种精确的误解失败模式和8个分析层，并将这些层进行形式化建模，扩展了信息和通信理论。研究结果包括对误解机制的功能分类和过程定位，并提供了可审计的证据矩阵、编码手册和对话案例，填补了现有误解分类的空白。
AI.keywords: 误解检测, 跨学科分类, AI媒介通信, 失败模式, 形式化建模
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于其跨学科方法，整合了九个不同领域的知识来构建一个全面的误解分类和建模框架。它不仅识别了误解的多种失败模式，更重要的是，将这些机制定位在通信过程中的特定点并进行功能分类，这在现有研究中是独一无二的。对于AI代理而言，理解误解的生成、放大和检测过程至关重要，这为未来构建更智能、更能识别和修复误解的AI系统提供了坚实的理论基础和实践工具。其形式化建模和可审计的证据矩阵也增加了研究的严谨性和实用性。

title: Active Perception for Embodied Disambiguation
summary: Natural language provides robots with a flexible task interface, but target ambiguity in embodied environments arises not only from user intent; it can also result from missing taskrelevant physical evidence in the current observation. Existing interactive disambiguation methods primarily obtain additional information by asking the user, whereas occlusion, restricted viewpoints, unreadable text, and unobserved targets require the robot to actively change its observation. We propose an active-perception framework for embodied target disambiguation that uses active observation as the backbone for information acquisition and uses a vision-language model to decide, on the basis of accumulated visual evidence and interaction information, whether to continue observing, request clarification, or complete target selection. Active observation can both directly recover missing discriminative evidence and reveal object names, labels, and semantic attributes, thereby improving user clarification when it remains necessary. Real-robot experiments show that the framework combines physical information acquisition and userintent clarification within a unified embodied disambiguation process.

AI.tldr: 机器人通过主动感知框架解决具身环境中的目标歧义，该框架利用主动观察获取物理信息，并结合视觉语言模型决定何时继续观察、请求用户澄清或选择目标。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人交互消歧方法主要通过询问用户获取信息，但具身环境中目标歧义不仅来自用户意图，还可能因当前观察中缺少任务相关的物理证据（如遮挡、受限视角、文本不可读、目标未被观察到）而产生，这要求机器人主动改变其观察方式。
AI.method: 提出了一种用于具身目标消歧的主动感知框架。该框架以主动观察作为信息获取的支柱，并使用视觉语言模型根据积累的视觉证据和交互信息来决定是继续观察、请求澄清还是完成目标选择。主动观察可以直接恢复缺失的判别性证据并揭示物体名称、标签和语义属性，从而在必要时改进用户澄清。
AI.result: 真实机器人实验表明，该框架在一个统一的具身消歧过程中结合了物理信息获取和用户意图澄清。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出并验证了一个结合主动感知和用户澄清的统一框架，有效解决了具身机器人环境中因物理证据缺失导致的目标歧义问题。
AI.translation: 自然语言为机器人提供了灵活的任务接口，但具身环境中的目标歧义不仅源于用户意图；它还可能因当前观察中缺少任务相关的物理证据而产生。现有的交互式消歧方法主要通过询问用户来获取额外信息，而遮挡、受限视角、不可读文本和未被观察到的目标则要求机器人主动改变其观察方式。我们提出了一种用于具身目标消歧的主动感知框架，该框架以主动观察作为信息获取的支柱，并使用视觉语言模型根据积累的视觉证据和交互信息来决定是继续观察、请求澄清还是完成目标选择。主动观察既可以直接恢复缺失的判别性证据，又可以揭示物体名称、标签和语义属性，从而在必要时改进用户澄清。真实机器人实验表明，该框架在一个统一的具身消歧过程中结合了物理信息获取和用户意图澄清。
AI.summary: 本文提出一个用于具身目标消歧的主动感知框架，旨在解决机器人因物理环境证据缺失（如遮挡）导致的目标歧义。该框架通过主动观察获取物理信息，并利用视觉语言模型智能决策是否继续观察、请求用户澄清或直接选择目标，从而将物理信息获取与用户意图澄清整合到一个统一的消歧过程中。
AI.keywords: 主动感知, 具身消歧, 视觉语言模型, 机器人, 目标歧义
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入主动感知来解决机器人具身环境中的目标歧义问题，其创新之处在于将物理信息获取与用户意图澄清相结合，形成一个统一的框架。这克服了传统方法仅依赖用户澄清的局限性，使得机器人能够更自主、更有效地处理复杂环境中的不确定性。该方法对于提升具身智能体的鲁棒性和自主性具有重要意义。

title: MobileMem: Learning from a Year of Mobile Experiences
summary: The next generation of AI agents is increasingly moving beyond systems that answer isolated questions toward persistent personal assistants that can understand, remember, and continuously learn from users' experiences. Such assistants require long-term memory to accumulate and leverage user-specific experiences over time, yet existing benchmarks remain inadequate for realistic mobile settings, where experiences are heterogeneous, multimodal, evolving, and deeply personal. We introduce MobileMem, a benchmark and framework for studying on-device long-term memory, grounded in a year-scale collection of mobile experiences. MobileMem employs a knowledge-grounded synthesis pipeline to construct coherent and temporally consistent long-horizon trajectories from user-app sessions. It provides complementary text and multimodal settings covering multi-hop and temporal reasoning, knowledge updating, and implicit preference inference. Specifically, MobileMem enables agents to remember the past, understand the present, and adapt to the future. By modeling experiences rather than isolated facts, MobileMem moves memory beyond information retrieval toward experiential intelligence for continuous personal learning.

AI.title_translation: MobileMem：从一年的移动体验中学习
AI.tldr: 引入MobileMem，一个基于一年移动体验的基准和框架，用于研究设备上的长期记忆，以支持持续学习的下一代AI个人助手。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准不足以支持下一代AI个人助手在真实移动环境中理解、记忆和持续学习用户体验，因为这些体验是异构、多模态、不断演进且高度个性化的，需要长期记忆来积累和利用用户特定经验。
AI.method: 引入MobileMem，一个基准和框架，通过知识驱动的合成管道，从用户应用会话中构建连贯且时间一致的长周期轨迹。它提供互补的文本和多模态设置，涵盖多跳和时间推理、知识更新和隐式偏好推断。
AI.result: MobileMem使智能体能够记住过去、理解现在并适应未来，将记忆从信息检索提升到用于持续个人学习的经验智能。
AI.conclusion: MobileMem通过建模经验而非孤立事实，为AI代理提供了在真实移动环境中实现持续个人学习所需的长期记忆和经验智能。
AI.translation: 下一代AI智能体正日益超越回答孤立问题的系统，转向能够理解、记忆并从用户体验中持续学习的持久性个人助手。此类助手需要长期记忆来随着时间积累和利用用户特定的经验，然而，现有的基准对于真实的移动环境来说仍然不足，在移动环境中，用户体验是异构的、多模态的、不断演进的且高度个性化的。我们引入了MobileMem，一个用于研究设备上长期记忆的基准和框架，其基础是为期一年的移动体验集合。MobileMem采用知识驱动的合成管道，从用户应用会话中构建连贯且时间一致的长周期轨迹。它提供了互补的文本和多模态设置，涵盖多跳和时间推理、知识更新和隐式偏好推断。具体来说，MobileMem使智能体能够记住过去、理解现在并适应未来。通过建模经验而非孤立事实，MobileMem将记忆从信息检索提升到用于持续个人学习的经验智能。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了MobileMem，一个用于研究设备上长期记忆的基准和框架，旨在支持下一代能够从用户体验中持续学习的AI个人助手。MobileMem基于一年的真实移动体验数据，通过知识驱动的合成管道构建长周期轨迹，并提供文本和多模态设置以支持多跳推理、知识更新和隐式偏好推断，从而使AI智能体能够实现经验智能。
AI.keywords: 长期记忆, 移动体验, AI助手, 基准, 经验智能
AI.comments: MobileMem的创新之处在于其构建了一个大规模、真实且复杂的移动体验数据集和基准，将长期记忆的研究从孤立的事实检索转向更具挑战性的经验智能。其基于一年尺度的移动数据收集和知识驱动的合成管道，为AI代理在真实世界中进行持续学习提供了重要的研究基础。

title: No Universal Signal Predicts Sample-Level LLM Regression under Version Updates
summary: Frontier LLMs are updated frequently and typically outperform their predecessors in aggregate. But aggregate gains say little about individual samples: an update can still cause sample-level regression, where a response correct under the old model becomes incorrect under the new one. This paper studies how to predict such regressions from signals available at inference time. We compare single-model signals (confidence, logit margin, attention entropy) against cross-version signals (output KL divergence, likelihood drift, token-level KL, representation drift) under a unified added-value test that isolates each signal's gain over a confidence baseline. Across six benchmarks in three task families (multiple-choice question answering, or MCQ; math reasoning; code generation) and six model update pairs, we find that (1) signal effectiveness is task-dependent: confidence is strongest on MCQ and simpler math, while likelihood/KL signals give the most frequent gains on harder math and code; (2) no signal is universally best across model updates either; and (3) some cross-version signals stay informative even when confidence fails, including without labels, which supports a proof-of-concept selective fallback that routes high-risk samples back to the old model. Practitioners can use these task-level patterns to choose which regression signal to trust for a given update. Code is available at https://github.com/jiashengsally/llm-regression-signals.

AI.title_translation: 没有通用信号可以预测版本更新下LLM样本级别的回归
AI.tldr: LLM更新通常整体表现更好，但可能导致样本级回归。本研究比较了单模型和跨版本信号预测这种回归的能力，发现信号有效性是任务和模型更新依赖的，没有通用最佳信号，但一些跨版本信号在置信度失效时仍有信息量，支持选择性回退策略。
AI.motivation: 前沿大型语言模型（LLMs）频繁更新，通常整体表现优于其前身，但整体收益对单个样本的说明甚少：一次更新仍可能导致样本级别的回归，即在旧模型下正确的响应在新模型下变得不正确。本文旨在研究如何从推理时可用的信号预测此类样本级别的回归。
AI.method: 本文采用统一的增值测试，比较了单模型信号（置信度、logit 裕度、注意力熵）与跨版本信号（输出KL散度、似然漂移、token级KL、表示漂移）。该测试旨在隔离每个信号相对于置信度基线的增益。研究在三个任务家族（多项选择问答MCQ、数学推理、代码生成）的六个基准测试和六对模型更新中进行。
AI.result: (1) 信号有效性是任务依赖的：置信度在MCQ和简单数学上最强，而似然/KL信号在更难的数学和代码上提供最频繁的增益。(2) 没有信号在所有模型更新中都是普遍最佳的。(3) 即使置信度失效，一些跨版本信号（包括在没有标签的情况下）仍具有信息量，这支持了一种概念验证的选择性回退机制，可以将高风险样本路由回旧模型。
AI.conclusion: 实践者可以利用这些任务级别的模式来选择在给定更新中信任哪种回归信号。研究结果支持将高风险样本回退到旧模型的选择性策略。
AI.translation: 前沿大型语言模型（LLMs）频繁更新，通常整体表现优于其前身。但整体收益对单个样本的说明甚少：一次更新仍可能导致样本级别的回归，即在旧模型下正确的响应在新模型下变得不正确。本文研究如何从推理时可用的信号预测此类回归。我们比较了单模型信号（置信度、logit 裕度、注意力熵）与跨版本信号（输出KL散度、似然漂移、token级KL、表示漂移），采用统一的增值测试，以隔离每个信号相对于置信度基线的增益。在三个任务家族（多项选择问答MCQ；数学推理；代码生成）的六个基准测试和六对模型更新中，我们发现：(1) 信号有效性是任务依赖的：置信度在MCQ和简单数学上最强，而似然/KL信号在更难的数学和代码上提供最频繁的增益；(2) 没有信号在所有模型更新中都是普遍最佳的；(3) 即使置信度失效，一些跨版本信号仍具有信息量，包括在没有标签的情况下，这支持了一种概念验证的选择性回退机制，可以将高风险样本路由回旧模型。实践者可以利用这些任务级别的模式来选择在给定更新中信任哪种回归信号。代码可在https://github.com/jiashengsally/llm-regression-signals获取。
AI.summary: 本文研究了预测大型语言模型（LLMs）版本更新后样本级别回归（即旧模型正确而新模型错误）的方法。通过比较单模型和跨版本信号在多项选择、数学推理和代码生成任务上的表现，研究发现信号的有效性取决于任务类型和模型更新，没有单一的通用最佳信号。然而，一些跨版本信号在置信度失效时仍能提供有价值的信息，甚至无需标签，这为将高风险样本回退到旧模型的选择性策略提供了支持。
AI.keywords: LLM回归, 模型更新, 样本级预测, 信号分析, 选择性回退
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了LLM实际应用中的一个重要问题：模型更新带来的不可预测的样本级性能下降。其贡献在于系统地比较了多种预测信号，并揭示了信号有效性的任务依赖性和非通用性。提出并支持选择性回退机制是一个有价值的实践性见解，对于提高LLM部署的鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: Evaluating Agentic Learning Harness Capabilities Without Labels via the Scaling Hypothesis
comments: 18 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at CAMLIS 2025 (Conference on Applied Machine Learning for Information Security)
summary:
Agentic "Continual Learning Harnesses", systems that pair an LLM with retrieval or memory to improve from feedback without retraining, have shown growing value in cybersecurity. But their value is conventionally measured by gains against labeled benchmarks, an approach that often fails in operational security settings. Benchmark labels are scarce, stale, and unrepresentative, so a practitioner often cannot tell whether a given harness helps at all or which of two is better for their task. Traditional LLM-as-a-judge offers little signal because it is no stronger than the agent it evaluates, and distillation is unreliable on scarce, sporadic, and biased labels.
  We propose a framework for evaluating learning harnesses end-to-end without a labeled benchmark, grounded in the scaling hypothesis. A stronger teacher model provides sparsely sampled corrections to a smaller student with a continual learning harness. We score a harness by how much its student converges toward the teacher over time. Across security tasks, model families, and harness designs, we show that improvement relative to the teacher correlates with improvement relative to a held-out gold standard, validating teacher-relative lift as a proxy for true harness uplift when labels are absent. We further show that LLM-as-a-judge between similarly powered models yields no usable signal. These results suggest that a teacher-sized model can be improved through the same harness when humans provide the same kind of sparse, high-precision corrections.
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at CAMLIS 2025 (Conference on Applied Machine Learning for Information Security)

AI.title_translation: 通过缩放假设在无标签情况下评估代理学习线束能力
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种无需标签即可评估代理学习线束能力的新框架，通过衡量学生模型相对于教师模型的收敛程度来解决网络安全中标签稀缺的问题。
AI.motivation: 在网络安全领域，代理式“持续学习线束”的价值通常通过带标签的基准来衡量。然而，这些标签稀缺、过时且不具代表性，导致从业者难以判断线束的有效性或选择最佳线束。传统的“LLM作为评判者”方法信号微弱，而蒸馏法在稀疏、零星和有偏见的标签上不可靠。
AI.method: 本研究提出了一个基于缩放假设的框架，用于在没有标签基准的情况下端到端地评估学习线束。一个更强的教师模型向一个带有持续学习线束的较小学生模型提供稀疏采样的校正。线束的得分通过学生模型随时间向教师模型的收敛程度来衡量。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，相对于教师模型的改进与相对于保留的黄金标准的改进呈正相关，这验证了在没有标签的情况下，相对于教师模型的提升可以作为真实线束提升的代理。此外，研究还发现，能力相似的模型之间，LLM作为评判者的方法无法提供可用信号。
AI.conclusion: 本研究的结论是，当人类提供相同类型的稀疏、高精度校正时，教师规模的模型可以通过相同的线束得到改进。
AI.translation:
代理式“持续学习线束”系统，即将大型语言模型（LLM）与检索或记忆相结合，无需重新训练即可从反馈中改进，在网络安全领域显示出日益增长的价值。但其价值传统上通过针对带标签基准的收益来衡量，这种方法在实际安全环境中常常失效。基准标签稀缺、过时且不具代表性，因此从业者通常无法判断某个线束是否有帮助，或者哪个线束更适合他们的任务。传统的“LLM作为评判者”方法提供的信号很少，因为它不比它评估的代理强，而蒸馏法在稀缺、零星和有偏见的标签上不可靠。
我们提出一个框架，用于在没有带标签基准的情况下端到端地评估学习线束，该框架以缩放假设为基础。一个更强的教师模型向一个带有持续学习线束的较小学生模型提供稀疏采样的校正。我们通过学生模型随时间向教师模型的收敛程度来评估线束。在各种安全任务、模型家族和线束设计中，我们展示了相对于教师模型的改进与相对于保留的黄金标准的改进呈正相关，验证了在没有标签时，相对于教师模型的提升可以作为真实线束提升的代理。我们进一步表明，能力相似的模型之间，LLM作为评判者的方法无法产生可用信号。这些结果表明，当人类提供相同类型的稀疏、高精度校正时，教师规模的模型可以通过相同的线束得到改进。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了一种无需标签即可评估代理式“持续学习线束”能力的新框架，以解决网络安全领域中标签稀缺、过时且不具代表性的问题。该框架基于缩放假设，通过让一个更强的教师模型对一个带有学习线束的较小学生模型进行稀疏校正，并衡量学生模型向教师模型收敛的程度来评估线束性能。研究发现，相对于教师模型的改进与真实性能提升高度相关，并且传统的LLM作为评判者的方法在评估能力相似模型时无效。这表明该方法在无标签环境下是评估和改进代理学习线束的有效途径，特别是当人类提供稀疏但高精度的反馈时。
AI.keywords: 代理学习线束, 无标签评估, 缩放假设, 持续学习, 网络安全
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于提出了一个无需依赖稀缺、过时标签即可评估代理学习线束的实用框架，这对于实际网络安全操作环境具有重要意义。通过利用“缩放假设”和教师-学生模型范式，它提供了一种在无标签条件下衡量模型改进的有效代理。其局限性可能在于教师模型的选择和其“高精度校正”的质量，以及该方法在教师模型本身也需要持续改进的场景中的适用性。

title: SN-ASMO: Satellite-Navigation Array Spatial-Manifold Precise Observation Theory A Mathematical Foundation for Observation Formation, Unified U(1) Geometry, Intrinsic Information, and Preservation of the RTK Integer Structure
summary:
Suppressive interference, high-dynamic motion of the receiving platform, and carrier-phase RTK lead satellite navigation to one fundamental question: when the receiver actively participates in observation formation through its array geometry, channel states, weights, and signal-processing rules, how can the resulting carrier observation continue to represent the same objective propagation process while preserving continuous phase and the integer-ambiguity structure? The physical world is not changed by a reconfiguration of the observer, but its complex representation in the observation world is. Without a strict separation between propagation-induced and observer-induced variations, anti-jamming, high dynamics, and precise carrier-phase positioning become structurally coupled at the observation-formation level.
  Finally, reproducible and falsifiable protocols are provided for static interference, dynamic rotation, inter-branch timing mismatch, near-null response, RF replay, and RTK integer-risk validation. The scoped novelty of SN-ASMO is the unification of observation formation, reference covariance, exact nuisance quotients, same-source transport, intrinsic statistical information, and preservation of the RTK integer structure in one mathematically closed and physically testable framework.

AI.title_translation: SN-ASMO：卫星导航阵列空间流形精密观测理论——观测形成、统一U(1)几何、内蕴信息与RTK整周结构保持的数学基础
AI.tldr: 本文提出了SN-ASMO理论，通过统一U(1)几何与严格解耦观测者效应，解决了阵列抗干扰与高动态环境下RTK载波相位整周结构保持的理论难题。
AI.motivation: 在压制性干扰和接收平台高动态环境下，阵列天线与信号处理的主动重构会改变观测量的复数表征；若无法严格解耦传播变化与观测者自身引入的变化，抗干扰、高动态响应与载波相位RTK高精度定位在观测形成层面上将发生结构性耦合冲突，破坏整周模糊度特性。
AI.method: 提出了SN-ASMO理论框架，建立统一的U(1)几何与观测形成数学体系，严格分离传播诱导与观测者诱导的相位变化，并提供了覆盖静态干扰、动态旋转、通道时延失配、近零陷响应、射频重放及RTK整数风险验证的可复现、可证伪验证协议。
AI.result: 建立了针对静态干扰、动态旋转、分支间时序失配、近零响应、射频重放和RTK整周风险验证的可复现且可证伪的检验协议，实现了观测形成与RTK整周结构保持的闭合数学表征。
AI.conclusion: SN-ASMO理论成功将观测形成、参考协方差、精确冗余商空间、同源传输、内蕴统计信息以及RTK整周结构保持统一在一个数学闭合且可物理检验的框架中。
AI.translation: 压制性干扰、接收平台的高动态运动以及载波相位RTK将卫星导航引向一个基本问题：当接收机通过其阵列几何结构、通道状态、加权权值和信号处理规则主动参与观测量的形成时，所生成的载波观测值如何能够在保持连续相位和整周模糊度结构的同时，继续表征相同的客观传播过程？观测者的重构不会改变物理世界，但会改变其在观测世界中的复数表征。如果不能严格分离由传播引起的物理变化与由观测者自身引起的变化，抗干扰、高动态和精密载波相位定位将在观测量形成层面发生结构性耦合。最后，本文针对静态干扰、动态旋转、分支间时序失配、近零响应、射频重放和RTK整周风险验证提供了可复现和可证伪的验证协议。SN-ASMO的核心创新在于将观测形成、参考协方差、精确冗余商空间、同源传输、内蕴统计信息以及RTK整周结构的保持统一在一个数学闭合且可物理检验的框架中。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SN-ASMO理论框架，旨在解决阵列天线信号处理与高动态抗干扰重构对卫星导航RTK载波相位观测及其整周模糊度结构的破坏性耦合问题。该理论统一了U(1)几何表征与内蕴信息度量，提供了严格解耦观测者效应与物理传播效应的数学闭环框架及验证协议。
AI.keywords: 卫星导航, 阵列空间流形, RTK整周模糊度, 抗干扰, 载波相位观测
AI.comments: 该论文从基础数学和物理几何角度出发，直面了阵列信号处理（如抗干扰自适应加权）与高精度载波相位RTK定位之间的内在耦合与冲突问题。其创新在于构建了统一的U(1)流形几何框架，严格解耦观测者引入的变化与信号传播物理变化，从而保护RTK的整周模糊度结构。局限在于摘要中未展示具体实验数值增益，主要强调理论体系与可证伪验证协议。

title: SemPlan: Benchmarking Structured Semantic Planning for LLM-Based Queries over Enterprise Data
comments: 11 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Natural-language interfaces to enterprise data must translate underspecified requests into governed, executable behavior while controlling invalid queries, policy failures, cost, and nondeterminism. SemPlan Benchmark evaluates this architectural design space with a deterministic synthetic bilingual benchmark containing 1,800 cases in English and Brazilian Portuguese; 1,200 cases form the frozen scientific evaluation subset. Four architectures are compared under the same model configuration: direct SQL generation (A1), a bounded tool-agent baseline (A2), structured semantic-request generation followed by deterministic planning and execution (A3), and a clarification/stateful semantic-plan variant (A4). Across 4,800 primary records, answer correctness was low in absolute terms: 22.25% for A1, 22.58% for A2, 25.67% for A3, and 24.25% for A4. A3 had the highest observed correctness and significantly exceeded A1, A2, and A4 in the pre-specified paired correctness analysis, while A1 retained the highest policy-correct rate and the lowest unsafe-or-invalid rate. A4 had the lowest mean API cost and lowest false-refusal rate. On a preselected 150-case stability subset, answer-correct repeatability ranged from 92.00% to 98.67%. The results support a trade-off interpretation rather than a universal ranking: additional structural constraints changed failure modes and efficiency, but did not monotonically improve correctness or solve ambiguity and multi-turn state consistency.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)

AI.title_translation: SemPlan：针对企业数据LLM查询的结构化语义规划基准评估
AI.tldr: 提出了SemPlan双语基准来评估企业数据LLM查询的四种架构，发现结构化语义规划在正确性上更优，但不同架构在合规、成本与正确率之间存在权衡。
AI.motivation: 企业数据的自然语言接口需要将表述不明确的请求转化为受合规治理且可执行的行为，同时有效控制无效查询、策略违规、调用成本和非确定性。
AI.method: 构建了包含1,800个英语和巴西葡萄牙语用例的确定性合成双语基准SemPlan（含1,200个冻结评估用例），并在统一模型配置下对比了四种架构：直接生成SQL（A1）、有界工具智能体（A2）、结构化语义请求生成+确定性规划与执行（A3），以及澄清/有状态语义规划变体（A4）。
AI.result: 在4,800条记录中各架构绝对正确率普遍较低（A1为22.25%、A2为22.58%、A3为25.67%、A4为24.25%）；A3在成对正确性分析中表现最佳；A1具有最高的策略正确率和最低的不安全/无效查询率；A4具有最低的平均API成本和误拒率；在150例稳定性子集上，可重复性在92.00%至98.67%之间。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，不同的LLM查询架构之间存在明显的权衡取舍而非通用排名：引入结构化约束能够改变失效模式和效率，但无法单调提升正确率，也未能从根本上解决请求歧义与多轮状态一致性问题。
AI.translation: 企业数据的自然语言接口必须将表述不充分的请求转化为受合规治理且可执行的行为，同时控制无效查询、策略违规、成本以及非确定性。SemPlan基准通过一个包含1,800个英文和巴西葡萄牙语用例的确定性合成双语基准（其中1,200个用例构成冻结的科学评估子集）来评估这一架构设计空间。在相同的模型配置下对比了四种架构：直接SQL生成（A1）、有界工具智能体基线（A2）、结构化语义请求生成后进行确定性规划与执行（A3），以及澄清/有状态语义规划变体（A4）。在4,800条主要记录中，绝对回答正确率普遍较低：A1为22.25%，A2为22.58%，A3为25.67%，A4为24.25%。A3的观测正确率最高，并在预设的成对正确性分析中显著优于A1、A2和A4；而A1保持了最高的策略正确率和最低的不安全或无效比率。A4具有最低的平均API成本和最低的误拒率。在预选的150个用例稳定性子集上，回答正确的重复性在92.00%到98.67%之间。结果表明架构之间呈现出权衡取舍而非通用优劣排名：额外的结构约束改变了失效模式和效率，但并未单调提高正确性，也未解决歧义与多轮状态一致性问题。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SemPlan基准，用于评估LLM在企业数据查询中的不同架构设计。实验对比了直接SQL生成、工具Agent、语义规划及多轮澄清变体，结果表明各架构在正确率、安全性、合规策略与成本之间存在显著权衡，结构化语义规划虽提升了正确性但仍受限于歧义和多轮一致性。
AI.keywords: 结构化语义规划, 自然语言接口, 企业数据查询, LLM基准测试, SQL生成
AI.comments: 本论文针对企业级数据查询中LLM落地的核心痛点（合规、安全、成本与确定性）构建了系统化的评测基准，具有很高的实用价值。研究明确指出了不同架构路线（如端到端直接生成与结构化规划）之间存在权衡而非绝对优劣，为未来企业NL2SQL与Agent架构选型提供了坚实的实证参考。

title: A Survey of Typical-Cell Volume Distributions in Poisson--Voronoi and Poisson--Delaunay Tessellations: Analytical Theory, High-Dimensional Limits, and Wireless Applications
comments: 23 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, Accepted for publication in IEEE Access
summary: Random spatial tessellations generated by point processes provide fundamental models for proximity, space partitioning, and local geometry in stochastic systems. Poisson--Voronoi and Poisson--Delaunay tessellations induced by homogeneous Poisson point processes form a canonical dual pair used in stochastic geometry, computational geometry, spatial statistics, and wireless-network analysis. Their typical-cell volume distributions provide important geometric inputs for modeling coverage, traffic load, clustering, connectivity, and other system characteristics. Despite extensive study, the literature remains analytically asymmetric. For Poisson--Voronoi cell volumes, exact integral representations exist in certain planar settings, while a recent scale--shape factorization provides an exact general-dimensional representation with conditional Gamma structure. However, the normalized shape laws and unbounded facet-count mixture remain implicit, and tractable unconditional closed-form distributions are unavailable. Practical modeling therefore relies largely on simulation, moment characterizations, and empirical approximations. By contrast, Poisson--Delaunay simplex volumes admit dimension-explicit PDFs, CDFs, and moment formulas derived through Mellin-transform analysis and Meijer's \(G\)-function representations. Motivated by this contrast, this paper surveys typical-cell volume distributions in Poisson--Voronoi and Poisson--Delaunay tessellations. We review the main analytical methods, synthesize exact and approximate results, summarize emerging high-dimensional limits, and discuss wireless-network applications, including load modeling, cooperative transmission, and three-dimensional architectures. We also identify open problems concerning unconditional Poisson--Voronoi distributions, non-Poisson spatial models, data-driven geometric inference, and dimension-aware network modeling.
comment: 23 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, Accepted for publication in IEEE Access

AI.title_translation: 泊松-Voronoi和泊松-Delaunay剖分中典型单元体积分布的综述：解析理论、高维极限和无线应用
AI.tldr: 本文综述了泊松-Voronoi和泊松-Delaunay剖分中典型单元体积分布的解析理论、高维极限和无线应用，并讨论了相关开放问题。
AI.motivation: 泊松-Voronoi和泊松-Delaunay剖分在随机几何等领域是重要的模型。尽管对典型单元体积分布进行了广泛研究，但文献中存在分析不对称性，特别是泊松-Voronoi单元体积缺乏可处理的无条件闭合形式分布，而泊松-Delaunay单形体积则有明确的解析表达式。这种对比促使本文进行综述。
AI.method: 本文通过回顾主要的分析方法、综合精确和近似结果、总结新兴的高维极限，并讨论无线网络应用来综述典型单元体积分布。
AI.result: 综述了泊松-Voronoi和泊松-Delaunay剖分中典型单元体积分布的分析方法、精确和近似结果、高维极限，并讨论了其在无线网络（如负载建模、协作传输、三维架构）中的应用。同时，指出了无条件泊松-Voronoi分布、非泊松空间模型、数据驱动几何推断和维度感知网络建模等开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文综述了泊松-Voronoi和泊松-Delaunay剖分中典型单元体积分布的现有理论和应用，并明确了未来研究的开放问题，强调了无条件泊松-Voronoi分布和非泊松空间模型等挑战。
AI.translation: 随机空间剖分由点过程生成，为随机系统中的邻近性、空间划分和局部几何提供了基本模型。由均匀泊松点过程引起的泊松-Voronoi和泊松-Delaunay剖分构成了一对经典的对偶，广泛应用于随机几何、计算几何、空间统计和无线网络分析。它们的典型单元体积分布为建模覆盖、流量负载、聚类、连通性及其他系统特性提供了重要的几何输入。尽管进行了广泛研究，但文献在分析上仍然不对称。对于泊松-Voronoi单元体积，在某些平面设置中存在精确的积分表示，而最近的尺度-形状分解提供了一个具有条件Gamma结构的精确通用维度表示。然而，归一化形状定律和无界面计数混合仍然是隐含的，并且缺乏可处理的无条件闭合形式分布。因此，实际建模主要依赖于仿真、矩特征和经验近似。相比之下，泊松-Delaunay单形体积通过Mellin变换分析和Meijer的G函数表示推导出了维度明确的PDF、CDF和矩公式。受此对比启发，本文综述了泊松-Voronoi和泊松-Delaunay剖分中典型单元体积分布。我们回顾了主要的分析方法，综合了精确和近似结果，总结了新兴的高维极限，并讨论了无线网络应用，包括负载建模、协作传输和三维架构。我们还指出了无条件泊松-Voronoi分布、非泊松空间模型、数据驱动几何推断和维度感知网络建模等开放问题。
AI.summary: 这篇综述文章探讨了泊松-Voronoi和泊松-Delaunay剖分中典型单元体积的分布，这两种剖分在随机几何和无线网络分析中是核心模型。文章指出，尽管泊松-Delaunay单形体积具有明确的解析表达式，但泊松-Voronoi单元体积缺乏可处理的无条件闭合形式分布，这种分析不对称性是其主要动机。该综述回顾了主要分析方法、综合了精确与近似结果、总结了高维极限，并讨论了其在无线网络中的应用。此外，文章还提出了无条件泊松-Voronoi分布、非泊松空间模型等未来的开放研究问题。
AI.keywords: 泊松-Voronoi剖分, 泊松-Delaunay剖分, 单元体积分布, 随机几何, 无线网络应用
AI.comments: 这篇综述文章系统地梳理了泊松-Voronoi和泊松-Delaunay剖分中典型单元体积分布的研究现状，特别强调了两者在解析理论上的不对称性。其重要性在于为相关领域的研究人员提供了一个全面的概览，并明确指出了未来的研究方向，尤其是在无线网络应用和解决泊松-Voronoi分布的无条件闭合形式问题上。文章对开放问题的识别具有指导意义。

title: Adjacency-Based Spectral Proxy Control of Mobile Communication Agents
summary:
We consider a heterogeneous mobile-agent network composed of uncontrolled task agents and controllable communication agents. The objective is to reposition communication agents online as task agents move. Since throughput-based objectives are generally unsuitable for real-time control, spectral graph metrics such as algebraic connectivity are commonly adopted as surrogate objectives. However, controlling algebraic connectivity relies on the eigenvector corresponding to the second-smallest eigenvalue of a graph's Laplacian matrix (i.e., the Fiedler vector), whose distributed estimation requires an unbounded number of communication rounds to converge.
  In this work, we identify a structural decomposition of this Fiedler-gradient controller into a local interaction rule and a graph embedding component, suggesting the use of alternative embeddings that are easier to estimate distributively than the Fiedler vector. As a particular instance, we propose A-Fiedler, which replaces the Fiedler embedding with the dominant eigenvector of the adjacency matrix, commonly used as a graph embedding of nodes into a latent geometry. This representation is more naturally suited for distributed implementation under local communication constraints.
  We evaluate A-Fiedler against the classical Fiedler-gradient controller. Results show comparable network performance in the absence of communication constraints and improved robustness under distributed estimation. For instance, under the same number of communication rounds, the Fielder-gradient may even converge to disconnected configurations whereas our proposition maintains performance. We believe our contribution provides a simpler path toward distributed network control.

AI.title_translation: 基于邻接的移动通信代理谱代理控制
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为A-Fiedler的新型分布式网络控制方法，用邻接矩阵的主特征向量代替传统的Fiedler向量，以解决Fiedler向量分布式估计困难的问题，并在分布式估计下表现出更好的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 在异构移动代理网络中，通信代理需要在线重新定位以适应任务代理的移动。传统的基于吞吐量的目标不适合实时控制，而代数连通性等谱图指标作为替代目标。然而，控制代数连通性依赖于Fiedler向量，其分布式估计需要无限次通信才能收敛，这在实时控制中是不可行的。
AI.method: 该研究将Fiedler梯度控制器分解为局部交互规则和图嵌入组件。在此基础上，提出了一种名为A-Fiedler的新方法，用邻接矩阵的主特征向量替换Fiedler向量作为图嵌入。这种表示方式更适合在局部通信限制下进行分布式实现。
AI.result: A-Fiedler在没有通信限制的情况下，表现出与经典Fiedler梯度控制器相当的网络性能。在分布式估计下，A-Fiedler的鲁棒性有所提高。例如，在相同通信轮数下，Fiedler梯度可能收敛到断开的配置，而A-Fiedler仍能保持性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种实现分布式网络控制的更简单途径，通过使用邻接矩阵的主特征向量替代Fiedler向量，解决了Fiedler向量分布式估计的难题，并提高了系统在分布式环境下的鲁棒性。
AI.translation:
我们考虑一个由不受控任务代理和可控通信代理组成的异构移动代理网络。目标是在任务代理移动时在线重新定位通信代理。由于基于吞吐量的目标通常不适用于实时控制，因此代数连通性等谱图指标通常被用作替代目标。然而，控制代数连通性依赖于图拉普拉斯矩阵的第二小特征值对应的特征向量（即Fiedler向量），其分布式估计需要无限次通信才能收敛。
在这项工作中，我们确定了Fiedler梯度控制器的结构分解为局部交互规则和图嵌入组件，这表明可以使用比Fiedler向量更容易分布式估计的替代嵌入。作为一个特例，我们提出了A-Fiedler，它用邻接矩阵的主特征向量替换Fiedler嵌入，该特征向量通常用作节点到潜在几何的图嵌入。这种表示更自然地适用于局部通信限制下的分布式实现。
我们评估了A-Fiedler与经典的Fiedler梯度控制器。结果表明，在没有通信限制的情况下，网络性能相当，并且在分布式估计下鲁棒性有所提高。例如，在相同通信轮数下，Fiedler梯度甚至可能收敛到断开的配置，而我们的提议保持了性能。我们相信我们的贡献为分布式网络控制提供了一条更简单的路径。
AI.summary: 该论文针对异构移动代理网络中通信代理的在线重新定位问题，提出了一种名为A-Fiedler的分布式控制方法。现有方法依赖于难以分布式估计的Fiedler向量。本研究通过将Fiedler梯度控制器分解，并用更容易分布式估计的邻接矩阵主特征向量替代Fiedler嵌入，解决了这一难题。实验结果表明，A-Fiedler在无通信限制下性能与传统方法相当，但在分布式估计环境下展现出更高的鲁棒性，有效避免了网络断开问题，为分布式网络控制提供了一条更简化的路径。
AI.keywords: 移动代理网络, 谱代理控制, Fiedler向量, 邻接矩阵, 分布式控制
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了A-Fiedler方法，通过替换难以分布式估计的Fiedler向量为邻接矩阵的主特征向量，显著简化了移动代理网络的分布式控制实现。这一改进不仅解决了实际应用中的通信效率问题，还在鲁棒性方面表现出优势，对于大规模、实时性要求高的移动网络控制具有重要意义。其贡献在于为分布式网络控制提供了一个更实用且性能优异的替代方案。

title: How Compliant is Sepsis Treatment? An Expert-Guided Neuro-symbolic Pipeline for Generating Clinical Compliance Insights
comments: This has been submitted and accepted in NeSy 2026 (https://2026.nesyconf.org/)
summary: Verifying whether clinical care follows evidence-based protocols is a natural neuro-symbolic problem, yet the safety-critical setting defeats either paradigm alone. We present an expert-guided pipeline that constrains a large language model strictly to semantic normalization, mapping messy drug and microbiology strings onto a fixed clinical vocabulary, while a Sugeno fuzzy inference system reasons over the normalized events. The fuzzy layer encodes eight Surviving Sepsis Campaign bundle rules and replaces binary judgments with graded scores in [0,1]. Applied to 2,438 MIMIC-IV v3.1 sepsis episodes, it surfaces antibiotic timing as the most critical breakdown (mean 0.24, 13% within one hour), Hour-1 underperformance (mean 36.7%), a 51% elevated-lactate drop-off, and descriptive differences in ICU stay across compliance groups (3.8 versus 5.1 days).
comment: This has been submitted and accepted in NeSy 2026 (https://2026.nesyconf.org/)

AI.title_translation: 脓毒症治疗的依从性如何？一个专家指导的神经符号管道，用于生成临床依从性洞察
AI.tldr: 开发了一个专家指导的神经符号管道，结合LLM和模糊推理系统，评估MIMIC-IV数据中脓毒症治疗的依从性，发现抗生素时机是主要问题，并量化了依从性不足的方面。
AI.motivation: 验证临床护理是否遵循循证方案是一个神经符号问题，但在安全关键环境中，单一范式不足以解决。因此，需要一种新的方法来评估脓毒症治疗的依从性并生成临床依从性洞察。
AI.method: 提出了一个专家指导的神经符号管道，该管道将大型语言模型（LLM）严格限制于语义标准化，将混乱的药物和微生物字符串映射到固定的临床词汇。随后，一个Sugeno模糊推理系统对标准化事件进行推理，该模糊层编码了八个“生存脓毒症运动”捆绑规则，并用[0,1]范围内的分级分数取代了二元判断。
AI.result: 应用于2,438个MIMIC-IV v3.1脓毒症病例，发现抗生素时机是最关键的依从性问题（平均0.24，13%在一小时内完成），小时-1表现不佳（平均36.7%），51%的乳酸升高下降，以及依从性组之间ICU住院时间存在描述性差异（3.8天对5.1天）。
AI.conclusion: 该神经符号管道能有效揭示脓毒症治疗中的依从性问题，特别是抗生素给药时机，并量化了护理依从性的具体不足之处，为改进临床实践提供了有价值的洞察。
AI.translation: 验证临床护理是否遵循循证方案是一个自然的神经符号问题，然而在安全关键的环境中，单一范式都无法胜任。我们提出了一个专家指导的管道，它严格限制大型语言模型进行语义标准化，将混乱的药物和微生物字符串映射到固定的临床词汇，同时一个Sugeno模糊推理系统对标准化事件进行推理。模糊层编码了八个“生存脓毒症运动”捆绑规则，并用[0,1]范围内的分级分数取代了二元判断。应用于2,438个MIMIC-IV v3.1脓毒症病例，它揭示了抗生素时机是最关键的故障（平均0.24，13%在一小时内），小时-1表现不佳（平均36.7%），51%的乳酸升高下降，以及依从性组之间ICU住院时间的描述性差异（3.8天对5.1天）。
AI.summary: 本文提出一个专家指导的神经符号管道，用于评估脓毒症治疗的临床依从性。该管道结合大型语言模型进行语义标准化和Sugeno模糊推理系统进行规则判断。通过对MIMIC-IV v3.1数据中2,438个脓毒症病例的应用，研究发现抗生素给药时机是依从性最差的环节，并量化了其他依从性不足的方面，如小时-1表现和乳酸水平下降情况，同时观察到依从性与ICU住院时间的相关性。
AI.keywords: 脓毒症治疗, 临床依从性, 神经符号系统, 大型语言模型, 模糊推理系统
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于结合了大型语言模型（LLM）和模糊推理系统来解决临床依从性验证这一安全关键的神经符号问题。LLM负责处理非结构化临床数据并进行语义标准化，而模糊推理系统则能够对复杂的临床指南规则进行灵活的、非二元的评估。这种混合方法克服了单一范式的局限性，为临床决策支持和质量改进提供了有价值的工具。其重要性在于能够量化和识别脓毒症治疗中的具体依从性差距，从而指导干预措施以提高患者预后。

title: Algorithm Design and Physician Liability
comments: 65 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables; includes online appendix (pp. 51-65)
summary: A single clinical algorithm can deliver unequal accuracy across patient groups, and concern about such disparity has grown as artificial intelligence (AI) spreads through clinical decision-making. In response, a liability rule introduced in the United States holds healthcare providers responsible when their reliance on disparate algorithms contributes to erroneous clinical decisions. We examine how such liability considerations reshape (i) an AI firm's algorithm design decisions that drive group-specific accuracy and (ii) a physician's decisions to use AI in healthcare delivery. The AI firm designs an algorithm for two patient groups, and improving accuracy for the disadvantaged group is more costly. The physician (who remains the accountable decision-maker) then decides whether to consult AI, weighing the reduction in clinical uncertainty against expected liability exposure when AI errors disproportionately affect the disadvantaged group. We find the liability rule can induce disparate use of AI: the physician may reduce AI use overall and, over an intermediate range of liability, rely on AI less for disadvantaged patients. The effect is non-monotone. As liability increases, the physician's use of AI for disadvantaged patients first declines, then rises as the firm reallocates investment toward reducing disparity or switches to an equal-accuracy design. Mandating equal algorithmic accuracy across patient groups can then inadvertently harm both groups, because a uniform accuracy requirement distorts the firm's investment incentives and the physician's equilibrium AI-use decisions.
comment: 65 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables; includes online appendix (pp. 51-65)

AI.tldr: 研究了美国引入的医生对使用AI算法导致不平等临床决策的责任规则如何影响AI公司的算法设计和医生使用AI的决策。发现责任规则可能导致AI使用上的不平等，甚至可能在某些情况下损害患者群体，强调了强制要求算法平等准确性的潜在负面影响。
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能在临床决策中的普及，单个临床算法在不同患者群体间可能产生不平等的准确性，引发了对这种差异的担忧。美国引入的责任规则要求医疗服务提供者对其依赖的差异化算法导致错误临床决策负责，因此研究这种责任考量如何重塑AI公司的算法设计和医生使用AI的决策。
AI.method: 构建了一个模型，其中AI公司为两个患者群体设计算法（提高弱势群体的准确性成本更高），医生（作为负责任的决策者）决定是否咨询AI，权衡临床不确定性的减少与预期责任风险，特别是当AI错误不成比例地影响弱势群体时。
AI.result: 研究发现，责任规则可能导致AI使用的差异：医生可能会全面减少AI的使用，并且在一定责任范围内，对弱势患者使用AI的程度更低。这种效应是非单调的：随着责任的增加，医生对弱势患者使用AI的程度先下降后上升，因为公司会重新分配投资以减少差异或转向等准确性设计。强制要求患者群体间算法准确性平等，可能会无意中损害两个群体，因为统一的准确性要求会扭曲公司的投资激励和医生的均衡AI使用决策。
AI.conclusion: 美国引入的医生责任规则对AI算法设计和临床AI使用决策产生了复杂且非单调的影响。虽然旨在解决不平等，但该规则可能导致AI使用的差异化，甚至可能在强制要求平等准确性时带来意想不到的负面后果，损害所有患者群体。因此，在制定AI医疗应用政策时，需要仔细权衡责任规则和激励机制。
AI.translation: 一份单一的临床算法可能在不同患者群体之间提供不平等的准确性，随着人工智能（AI）在临床决策中的普及，对这种差异的担忧日益增长。作为回应，美国引入了一项责任规则，即当医疗服务提供者依赖差异化算法导致错误的临床决策时，他们需要承担责任。我们研究了这种责任考量如何重塑（i）AI公司的算法设计决策（这些决策驱动了群体特定的准确性）和（ii）医生在医疗服务中是否使用AI的决策。AI公司为两个患者群体设计算法，为弱势群体提高准确性成本更高。然后，医生（作为负责任的决策者）决定是否咨询AI，权衡临床不确定性的减少与预期责任风险，特别是当AI错误不成比例地影响弱势群体时。我们发现，责任规则可能导致AI使用的差异：医生可能会全面减少AI的使用，并且在一定责任范围内，对弱势患者使用AI的程度更低。这种效应是非单调的。随着责任的增加，医生对弱势患者使用AI的程度先下降，然后上升，因为公司会重新分配投资以减少差异或转向等准确性设计。强制要求患者群体间算法准确性平等，可能会无意中损害两个群体，因为统一的准确性要求会扭曲公司的投资激励和医生的均衡AI使用决策。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了美国针对医疗AI算法引入的医生责任规则，如何影响AI公司的算法设计决策和医生在临床中采用AI的行为。模型分析表明，当AI算法在不同患者群体中表现出不平等的准确性时，医生承担的责任可能导致他们减少AI的整体使用，并在中等责任水平下，对弱势患者使用AI的意愿更低。这种影响是非单调的，即随着责任增加，对弱势患者的AI使用先下降后上升。研究进一步指出，强制要求算法在所有患者群体中达到同等准确性，反而可能通过扭曲AI公司的投资激励和医生对AI的均衡使用决策，无意中损害所有患者群体。
AI.keywords: AI算法, 医生责任, 临床决策, 算法公平性, 医疗AI
AI.comments: 这篇论文探讨了人工智能在医疗领域应用中一个非常关键且复杂的问题，即算法公平性、责任归属与实际应用之间的权衡。其创新之处在于，它不仅关注了算法设计层面的公平性，更深入分析了医生责任对AI公司投资策略和医生临床决策的反馈影响。研究发现责任规则可能导致意想不到的负面后果，如减少AI整体使用或对弱势群体的AI使用减少，甚至强制平等准确性可能损害所有群体，这对于政策制定者具有重要的警示意义。论文的局限性可能在于其模型是理论性的，实际情况中的医生行为、AI公司策略以及法律环境可能更为复杂。

title: Your Probabilistic JEPA Is Secretly a Hidden Markov Model: A State-Space Interpretation of Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
summary: A hidden Markov model (HMM) combines three roles: inference of a hidden-state belief from observations, propagation through a Markov transition, and emission back to observation space. We show that full, time-indexed Predictive Information Bottleneck VJEPA (PIB-VJEPA) exposes the same computational structure: a stochastic context encoder plays the role of an amortized filtering distribution, a probabilistic predictor defines latent-state dynamics, and a decoder, inverse target encoder, or induced implicit conditional supplies the emission direction. We distinguish 4 progressively stronger levels of correspondence and give sufficient conditions for exact sequence-level HMM equivalence. To make the connection concrete, we introduce Markov-Chain JEPA (MCJEPA), which replaces the latent predictor by a learned transition matrix; in the finite time-homogeneous case, matrix powers guarantee exact multi-horizon Chapman--Kolmogorov consistency. Conditioned discrete-state transitions, continuous-state Markov kernels, and continuous-time dynamics extend this construction, while deterministic temporal JEPA appears as a degenerate Dirac-kernel special case. We further interpret predictive information-bottleneck learning as seeking a compact predictive state: compression promotes minimality, while residual predictability tests sufficiency. Controlled experiments support transition composition, the filtering interpretation, predictive Markovization in a known synthetic process, and the distinction between JEPA latent prediction and HMM-style sequence learning. Together, these results give temporal JEPA a principled state-space interpretation.

AI.title_translation: 你的概率型JEPA秘密地是一个隐马尔可夫模型：联合嵌入预测学习的状态空间解释
AI.tldr: 该论文首次证明了概率型JEPA在数学上等价于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM），为联合嵌入预测学习提供了状态空间理论基础。
AI.motivation: 旨在揭示时间序列联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）背后隐藏的概率解释，将其与经典的状态空间模型（如隐马尔可夫模型 HMM）联系起来，从而为JEPA提供一个有原则的理论基础。
AI.method: 证明了PIB-VJEPA具有与HMM相同的计算结构（过滤、过渡、发射），提出了4个渐进的对应级别，并引入了基于学习转移矩阵的Markov-Chain JEPA（MCJEPA）来实现精确的Chapman-Kolmogorov一致性。
AI.result: 实验支持了过渡组合、过滤解释、已知合成过程中的预测马尔可夫化，以及JEPA潜在预测与HMM式序列学习之间的区别。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过建立PIB-VJEPA与HMM的等价性，并引入MCJEPA，为联合嵌入预测学习提供了坚实的状态空间理论基础。
AI.translation: 隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）结合了三个角色：从观测中推断隐藏状态信念、通过马尔可夫转移进行传播，以及发射回观测空间。我们表明，完整的、带时间索引的预测信息瓶颈VJEPA（PIB-VJEPA）展现出相同的计算结构：随机上下文编码器扮演摊销滤波分布的角色，概率预测器定义潜状态动力学，而解码器、逆目标编码器或诱导的隐式条件提供发射方向。我们区分为4个渐进更强的对应级别，并给出了精确序列级HMM等价性的充分条件。为了使这种联系具体化，我们引入了马尔可夫链JEPA（MCJEPA），它用学习到的转移矩阵代替了潜状态预测器；在有限时间齐次情况下，矩阵幂保证了精确的多视界查普曼-柯尔莫哥洛夫一致性。条件离散状态转移、连续状态马尔可夫核和连续时间动力学扩展了这一构建，而确定性时间JEPA则表现为简并的狄拉克核特例。我们进一步将预测信息瓶颈学习解释为寻求紧凑的预测状态：压缩促进极小性，而残差可预测性测试充分性。受控实验支持了转移组合、滤波解释、已知合成过程中的预测马尔可夫化，以及JEPA潜状态预测与HMM式序列学习之间的区别。总之，这些结果赋予了时间JEPA一个有原则的状态空间解释。
AI.summary: 该论文证明了概率型联合嵌入预测架构（如PIB-VJEPA）本质上是一个隐马尔可夫模型（HMM），阐明了它们在计算结构上的对应关系，并引入了Markov-Chain JEPA（MCJEPA）来具体实现这一状态空间解释。
AI.keywords: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture, Hidden Markov Model, State-Space Interpretation, Predictive Information Bottleneck
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了概率型联合嵌入预测架构（Probabilistic JEPA）与隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）之间的深层数学联系，为时间序列JEPA提供了一个有力的状态空间解释，极具理论创新价值。

title: ARC: Fair Relative Advantage Comparison in Open-Ended Real-World Interaction
summary: Open-ended real-world interaction admits multiple valid behaviors: an agent may answer directly, ask for clarification, provide progress updates, or confirm before acting. This flexibility breaks a core assumption behind group-based RL: rollouts compared within a group are no longer guaranteed to be behaviorally comparable. As a result, reward-model preferences over interaction style can distort relative advantages and steer optimization toward reward-preferred behaviors rather than context-appropriate ones. We formalize this as a \textit{reward fairness problem} and propose \textbf{ARC} (Advantage Regularization via Conditioning), a training recipe that restores fairer relative comparison through strategy-conditioned rollout grouping, together with hybrid rewards and entropy regularization. We study ARC in our proposed \inter, a novel paradigm for responsive, steerable, and execution-aware user-agent interaction that decouples user-visible communication from latent reasoning and tool use. \inter\ also provides the annotation and distillation pipeline for constructing \inter-86K, our strategy-annotated training corpus for supervised and RL training. Empirically, ARC substantially strengthens the core $τ/τ^2$ tool-use benchmarks, while \inter\ reduces time-to-first-token from 4.91s to 1.27s relative to a think-style baseline. Together, these results suggest that a central bottleneck in open-ended interactive learning is not only how agents are rewarded, but whether their behaviors are compared fairly in the first place. The ARC implementation and \inter-86K training data will be released.

AI.tldr: 在开放式交互中，由于行为不具可比性，基于群体的强化学习（RL）方法会扭曲相对优势，导致优化偏向奖励偏好的行为而非适合情境的行为。ARC（Advantage Regularization via Conditioning）通过策略条件化回滚分组、混合奖励和熵正则化来解决这一奖励公平性问题。ARC在提出的 	exttt{inter} 范式中进行了研究，该范式可解耦用户可见通信与潜在推理和工具使用，并提供了 	exttt{inter}-86K 语料库。ARC显著增强了工具使用基准测试，并大幅减少了响应式交互中的时间。
