title: FreeBalance: Pre-Routing Online Moe Load Balancing via Residual Workload Prediction
summary: Load imbalance poses a major bottleneck to the efficiency of expert parallelism in distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The most heavily loaded rank stalls global execution due to skewed routing distributions, directly increasing latency. While offline expert placement can alleviate persistent imbalance, practical multi-task serving workloads exhibit layer- and batch-dependent routing dynamics, making online load balancing indispensable. Existing approaches rely on routing statistics collected after each MoE router, requiring expert weight load or migration to begin only after routing decisions are available, consequently placing migration overhead on the inference critical path. In this work, we observe that online balancing can instead be largely overlapped with computation before target routing (e.g., attention), if routing distributions can be predicted accurately in advance. Therefore, we propose FreeBalance, a lossless online load-balancing framework that overlaps expert migration with preceding computation stages via residual workload prediction. FreeBalance leverages cross-layer similarities in hidden representations within the residual network to build a lightweight workload predictor. This enables proactive expert migration planning before routing decisions are available, creating substantial overlap between weight transfer and computation-heavy pre-routing stages. Furthermore, a cost model constrains the number of swaps to fully hide the synchronization overhead within the available window. Experiments across models and datasets show that FreeBalance reduces the max-to-mean rank load ratio by 32.8% and end-to-end prefill latency by 13.1%. Specifically, our method hides balancing overhead of an average of 5.1 experts per layer, which would otherwise account for about 8.5% of the critical-path latency.

AI.title_translation: FreeBalance：通过残差工作负载预测实现预路由在线MoE负载均衡
AI.tldr: FreeBalance通过在路由前预测工作负载并预先迁移专家，将MoE模型的在线负载均衡开销与计算重叠，显著降低了推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 分布式MoE模型推理中的负载不平衡是效率瓶颈，尤其是在线多任务服务工作负载中路由动态变化大，现有在线负载均衡方法将专家迁移开销置于推理关键路径上，导致延迟增加。
AI.method: 本文提出了FreeBalance，一个无损在线负载均衡框架。它通过残差工作负载预测将专家迁移与之前的计算阶段重叠。FreeBalance利用残差网络中隐藏表示的跨层相似性构建轻量级工作负载预测器，从而在路由决策前进行主动专家迁移规划。此外，一个成本模型限制交换数量以在可用窗口内隐藏同步开销。
AI.result: FreeBalance将最大-平均秩负载比降低32.8%，将端到端预填充延迟降低13.1%。平均每层隐藏了5.1个专家的均衡开销，否则将占关键路径延迟的约8.5%。
AI.conclusion: FreeBalance通过在路由前预测工作负载并预先迁移专家，成功地将MoE模型的在线负载均衡开销与计算重叠，显著降低了分布式推理的延迟和负载不平衡。
AI.translation: 负载不平衡是混合专家（MoE）模型分布式推理中专家并行效率的主要瓶颈。由于路由分布不均，负载最重的秩会停滞全局执行，直接增加延迟。虽然离线专家放置可以缓解持续不平衡，但实际的多任务服务工作负载表现出依赖于层和批次的路由动态，使得在线负载均衡不可或缺。现有方法依赖于每个MoE路由器之后收集的路由统计数据，需要在路由决策可用之后才能开始专家权重加载或迁移，因此将迁移开销置于推理关键路径上。在这项工作中，我们观察到，如果能够提前准确预测路由分布，在线均衡可以在目标路由（例如注意力）之前的计算中大部分重叠。因此，我们提出了FreeBalance，一个无损的在线负载均衡框架，它通过残差工作负载预测将专家迁移与之前的计算阶段重叠。FreeBalance利用残差网络中隐藏表示的跨层相似性来构建一个轻量级工作负载预测器。这使得在路由决策可用之前能够进行主动的专家迁移规划，在权重传输和计算密集型预路由阶段之间创建了实质性的重叠。此外，成本模型限制了交换数量，以在可用窗口内完全隐藏同步开销。跨模型和数据集的实验表明，FreeBalance将最大-平均秩负载比降低了32.8%，端到端预填充延迟降低了13.1%。具体而言，我们的方法隐藏了平均每层5.1个专家的均衡开销，否则这将占关键路径延迟的约8.5%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FreeBalance，一个针对MoE模型分布式推理的无损在线负载均衡框架。它通过在路由决策前利用残差工作负载预测器，主动规划专家迁移，从而将专家权重传输的开销与计算密集型预路由阶段重叠。FreeBalance利用残差网络中跨层隐藏表示的相似性进行轻量级预测，并通过成本模型优化交换。实验结果显示，该方法显著降低了负载不平衡和端到端预填充延迟，有效地隐藏了均衡开销。
AI.keywords: MoE模型, 负载均衡, 在线负载均衡, 工作负载预测, 专家并行, FreeBalance
AI.comments: FreeBalance的创新之处在于其将在线负载均衡的专家迁移开销从推理关键路径中移除，通过预路由工作负载预测实现与前置计算的重叠。这种主动式而非被动式的均衡策略，利用了残差网络中固有的跨层信息相似性，构建了一个轻量级且高效的预测器，对于提升MoE模型在实际多任务服务场景下的效率具有重要意义。其主要贡献在于解决了传统在线均衡方法中迁移开销导致延迟增加的问题。

title: MMUSV-Sim: A Perception-Oriented Simulation and Data-Generation Platform for Multi-USV Cooperative Perception
summary: Cooperative perception among multiple unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) combines complementary observations to extend maritime target sensing beyond the view range and field of a single platform. Developing such systems at scale calls for a unified workflow for configurable multi-USV scenarios, multimodal acquisition, and shared annotations. We present MMUSV-Sim, a perception-oriented maritime simulation and data-generation platform built on Unreal Engine 5 and Project AirSim. It provides island, open-sea, and port environments; configurable weather, time of day, and wave conditions; a diverse vessel asset library; and spline-based multi-vessel motion. MMUSV-Sim acquires RGB, depth, semantic, LiDAR, and radar observations across multiple USVs and captures a common world state for per-agent annotation export. Experiments verify that the configured wave settings produce the intended changes in vessel heave, roll, and pitch, and evaluate the geometric consistency between projected annotations and semantic renderings. In LiDAR-based cooperative BEV vessel detection experiments on the generated multi-USV dataset, Early Fusion achieves an AP@0.5 of 72.74, compared with 45.54 using a single USV.

AI.title_translation: MMUSV-Sim：一个面向多无人艇协同感知的感知导向仿真与数据生成平台
AI.tldr: 本文推出了一个名为MMUSV-Sim的面向多USV协同感知的仿真与数据生成平台，并通过实验证明多USV早期融合显著提升了水面目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 多无人艇（USV）之间的协同感知能够通过互补观测将水面目标感知范围扩展到单个平台的视野和范围之外，而开发此类系统需要一个统一的工作流来进行可配置的多USV场景模拟、多模态采集和共享标注。
AI.method: 基于Unreal Engine 5和Project AirSim构建了MMUSV-Sim平台，提供岛屿、公海和港口环境，支持可配置的天气、时间和波浪条件，具备多样化的船只资产库、样条曲线多船运动控制以及RGB、深度、语义、激光雷达和雷达等多模态观测与共享标注导出功能。
AI.result: 实验验证了配置的波浪设置可产生预期的船只升沉、横摇和纵摇变化，并评估了投影标注与语义渲染之间的几何一致性；在基于激光雷达的多USV协同BEV船只检测实验中，早期融合（Early Fusion）的AP@0.5达到了72.74，而单个USV仅为45.54。
AI.conclusion: MMUSV-Sim是一个功能强大且实用的多USV协同感知仿真平台，能够有效填补当前海上多智能体感知数据集和仿真环境的空白，实验证明其生成的数据和多USV融合策略能显著提升感知性能。
AI.translation: 多个无人水面艇（USV）之间的协同感知结合了互补的观测结果，将海上目标感知范围扩展到单个平台的视野范围之外。在大规模开发此类系统时，需要一个统一的工作流来实现可配置的多USV场景、多模态采集和共享标注。我们提出了MMUSV-Sim，这是一个基于Unreal Engine 5和Project AirSim构建的面向感知的海上仿真和数据生成平台。它提供了岛屿、公海和港口环境；可配置的天气、时间和波浪条件；多样化的船艇资产库；以及基于样条曲线的多船运动。MMUSV-Sim获取多个USV的RGB、深度、语义、激光雷达和雷达观测数据，并捕获公共世界状态以导出每个智能体的标注。实验验证了配置的波浪设置会产生预期的船艇升沉、横摇和纵摇变化，并评估了投影标注与语义渲染之间的几何一致性。在生成的的多USV数据集上进行的基于激光雷达的协同BEV船艇检测实验中，早期融合（Early Fusion）的AP@0.5达到了72.74，而单个USV为45.54。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了MMUSV-Sim，这是一个基于虚幻引擎5和AirSim的面向感知的海上仿真与数据生成平台，旨在支持多无人艇协同感知系统的开发。该平台提供丰富的环境、动态天气、波浪条件、多模态传感器采集及共享标注导出功能，实验证明其能显著提升多USV协同检测的性能。
AI.keywords: 多无人艇, 协同感知, 仿真平台, 虚幻引擎, 多模态数据生成
AI.comments: 该论文开发了一个面向多无人艇（USV）协同感知的仿真与数据生成平台MMUSV-Sim，通过集成多模态传感器、多样化的环境和波浪动力学，有效支持并提升了多无人艇协同感知算法的开发与评估。其基于虚幻引擎5和AirSim的架构具有良好的扩展性和真实感。

title: Adaptive Protection for Evolutionary Feature Construction in Symbolic Regression with Application to Credit Classification
summary: Evolutionary feature construction has shown strong promise in symbolic regression by automatically discovering informative transformations of input features that enhance a simple base learner. However, existing approaches often lack explicit mechanisms to preserve important constructed features discovered during evolution, and valuable genetic material can be lost when genetic operators disrupt effective features. This paper introduces an adaptive protection mechanism that leverages feature importance metrics to selectively preserve constructed features during evolution. The mechanism provides stronger protection for more important constructed features while still allowing less important features to be modified and to incorporate useful building blocks from more important features. We evaluate the approach using multiple feature importance calculation methods and demonstrate its robustness across different base learners. Experimental results on 98 regression benchmark datasets show that the proposed mechanism consistently improves solution quality over baseline approaches, and experiments on two credit classification datasets demonstrate that the method also extends effectively to improve search effectiveness beyond symbolic regression.

AI.title_translation: 符号回归中演化特征构造的自适应保护及其在信用分类中的应用
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于特征重要性的自适应保护机制，可防止符号回归中演化特征构造时的遗传材料丢失，显著提升回归和分类任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的演化特征构造方法缺乏显式机制来保护演化过程中发现的重要构造特征，导致在遗传算子破坏有效特征时珍贵的遗传材料丢失。
AI.method: 引入了一种自适应保护机制，利用特征重要性指标在演化过程中选择性地保护构造的特征，对更重要的特征提供更强的保护，同时允许较不重要的特征进行修改并融合优秀构建块。
AI.result: 在98个回归基准数据集上的实验表明，该机制持续提升了基线方法的解质量；在两个信用分类数据集上的实验证明其能有效扩展至符号回归以外的搜索任务。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的自适应保护机制能有效防止演化过程中的特征丢失，显著提升符号回归及信用分类任务的解的质量。
AI.translation: 演化特征构造在符号回归中展现出了巨大的潜力，它能够自动发现能增强简单基础学习器的输入特征的信息变换。然而，现有方法往往缺乏显式机制来保存演化过程中发现的重要构造特征，当遗传算子破坏有效特征时，宝贵的遗传材料可能会丢失。本文引入了一种自适应保护机制，利用特征重要性指标在演化过程中选择性地保存构造的特征。该机制为更重要的构造特征提供更强的保护，同时仍允许较不重要的特征进行修改，并融合来自更重要特征的有用构建块。我们使用多种特征重要性计算方法评估了该方法，并证明了其在不同基础学习器上的鲁棒性。在98个回归基准数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的机制始终如一地提高了优于基线方法的解质量，而在两个信用分类数据集上的实验证明，该方法也能有效地扩展以提高符号回归之外的搜索效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于符号回归中演化特征构造的自适应保护机制。通过利用特征重要性指标有选择地保护构造特征，该方法解决了演化过程中优秀遗传材料易丢失的问题。实验表明，该机制在多个回归基准和信用分类任务中均能显著提升搜索性能和解的质量。
AI.keywords: 符号回归, 演化特征构造, 自适应保护, 特征重要性, 信用分类
AI.comments: 该论文针对演化特征构造在符号回归中的局限性，引入了一种基于特征重要性度量的自适应保护机制，有效防止了有价值遗传材料的丢失。创新点在于通过动态保护不同重要性的特征，平衡了搜索的探索与开发，并在多个基准测试及信用分类任务中验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。

title: How Much Do Legal RAG Systems Still Hallucinate?
summary: Hallucination is a major challenge for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems in the legal domain, where ungrounded answers can lead to serious consequences. To better understand this problem, we conduct a fine-grained analysis of hallucination behavior in eight legal RAG systems across two legal corpora, the GDPR (in English) and a national civil law (in French). Using claim-level and answer-level evaluation, we report on hallucination density and severity, analyze performance across question categories and user personas, and validate our findings on an independent set of 142 legal-expert-authored questions. Our results show that hallucinations remain pervasive, ranging from less than 10% of responses for the best-performing systems to nearly half in the worst case. We further find that false-premise questions, containing incorrect assumptions that must be rejected, produce high hallucination rates on the manually-drafted questions.

AI.title_translation: 法律RAG系统仍然会产生多少幻觉？
AI.tldr: 法律领域的检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的幻觉仍然普遍存在，对八个系统的分析显示，幻觉率从不到10%到近一半不等，尤其是在错误前提问题上。
AI.motivation: 幻觉是法律领域检索增强生成（RAG）系统面临的一个主要挑战，因为没有根据的答案可能导致严重后果。本研究旨在更好地理解这个问题。
AI.method: 对八个法律RAG系统在两个法律语料库（英文GDPR和法文国家民法）上的幻觉行为进行了细粒度分析。使用声明级别和答案级别评估，报告了幻觉密度和严重性，分析了跨问题类别和用户角色的性能，并通过142个法律专家编写的独立问题集验证了研究结果。
AI.result: 幻觉仍然普遍存在，最佳系统响应中不到10%出现幻觉，最差情况下接近一半。此外，包含必须被拒绝的错误假设的“错误前提问题”在手动起草的问题上产生了高幻觉率。
AI.conclusion: 法律RAG系统中的幻觉问题依然普遍且严重，尤其是在处理包含错误前提的问题时，这表明需要进一步改进以提高其可靠性。
AI.translation: 幻觉是法律领域检索增强生成（RAG）系统面临的一个主要挑战，其中无根据的答案可能导致严重后果。为了更好地理解这个问题，我们对八个法律RAG系统在两个法律语料库（英文GDPR和法文国家民法）上的幻觉行为进行了细粒度分析。通过声明级别和答案级别评估，我们报告了幻觉的密度和严重性，分析了跨问题类别和用户角色的性能，并在一个由142个法律专家撰写的独立问题集上验证了我们的发现。我们的结果表明，幻觉仍然普遍存在，从表现最佳系统的不到10%的响应到最差情况下的近一半。我们进一步发现，包含必须被拒绝的错误假设的“错误前提问题”在手动起草的问题上产生了高幻觉率。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在深入分析法律领域检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的幻觉问题，因为其可能导致严重后果。研究人员对八个法律RAG系统在GDPR和国家民法两个语料库上进行了细致评估，涵盖了声明级和答案级分析，并考虑了不同问题类别和用户角色。结果显示，幻觉普遍存在，最佳系统幻觉率低于10%，而最差系统接近一半。特别地，包含错误前提的问题会显著提高幻觉率。
AI.keywords: 法律RAG系统, 幻觉, 检索增强生成, 法律领域, 评估
AI.comments: 这项研究对于理解法律RAG系统的局限性具有重要意义，特别强调了在法律这种对准确性要求极高的领域中，幻觉问题仍然是一个严峻的挑战。其细粒度的分析方法和对特定问题类型（如错误前提问题）的关注，为未来RAG系统的改进提供了宝贵的见解。

title: Training Fair Tabular Foundation Models
comments: Spotlight paper at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data
summary: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have emerged as leading methods for tabular predictive tasks, leveraging in-context learning to predict on new data without task-specific training. Despite the increased use of TFMs in high-stakes decision-making, their fairness properties remain largely unexplored. In this work, we incorporate fairness constraints directly into TFM training, enabling fair predictions in a single forward pass. Our approach addresses two key challenges: limited access to sensitive attributes in training data, and the incompatibility of existing fairness techniques with the in-context learning paradigm. We propose FairTFM, a scalable training strategy based on synthetic fairness tasks and a fairness-aware architecture using a gradient reversal layer, which encourages the model to learn representations invariant to sensitive attributes. Experiments on 132 fairness tasks show consistent improvements in fairness while maintaining competitive accuracy.
comment: Spotlight paper at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data

AI.title_translation: 训练公平的表格基础模型
AI.tldr: 提出FairTFM，一种在表格基础模型中引入公平性约束的训练策略，能够在单次前向传播中实现公平且准确的预测。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFMs）在处理表格预测任务时表现领先，但在高风险决策中广泛应用时，其公平性属性仍未得到充分探索，且现有的公平性技术与上下文学习范式存在不兼容性，训练数据中也往往存在敏感属性受限的问题。
AI.method: 提出FairTFM，一种基于合成公平任务的可扩展训练策略，并采用结合梯度反转层的公平感知架构，以鼓励模型学习对敏感属性不变的表示。
AI.result: 在132个公平性任务上的实验表明，FairTFM在保持竞争力的准确率的同时，一致地改善了模型的公平性。
AI.conclusion: FairTFM通过结合合成公平任务和梯度反转层，成功解决了表格基础模型中的公平性挑战，在保持竞争力的准确率的同时显著提升了模型的公平性。
AI.translation: 表格基础模型（TFMs）已成为表格预测任务的领先方法，它们利用上下文学习来对新数据进行预测，而无需进行特定任务的训练。尽管TFMs在高风险决策中的使用日益增加，但它们的公平性属性在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们将公平性约束直接纳入TFM训练中，从而能够在单次前向传播中进行公平预测。我们的方法解决了两个关键挑战：训练数据中对敏感属性的访问受限，以及现有公平性技术与上下文学习范式的兼容性问题。我们提出了FairTFM，这是一种基于合成公平任务的可扩展训练策略，以及使用梯度反转层的公平感知架构，该架构鼓励模型学习对敏感属性不变的表示。在132个公平性任务上的实验表明，在保持竞争力的准确率的同时，该方法持续改善了公平性。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了表格基础模型（TFMs）中的公平性问题，并提出了名为FairTFM的新型训练策略。该方法利用合成公平任务和带有梯度反转层的公平感知架构，克服了敏感属性受限和现有公平技术与上下文学习不兼容的挑战，从而在单次前向传播中实现了公平预测，并在多个任务中验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: Tabular Foundation Models, Fairness, In-Context Learning, Sensitive Attributes, Gradient Reversal Layer
AI.comments: 该论文首次系统性地探讨并解决了表格基础模型（TFMs）中的公平性问题，提出了创新的FairTFM方法，通过合成公平任务和梯度反转层实现了在单次前向传播中进行公平预测，对高风险决策领域的AI应用具有重要意义。

title: APTER: Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics
summary: As large language models enter professional domains, they must satisfy domain constraints, include critical evidence, and provide complete reasoning rather than merely produce fluent responses. Existing post-training methods often rely on holistic preferences or outcome-level verification, while recent rubric-based methods usually generate rubrics independently for each query. In specialized domains, such unconstrained rubrics may omit critical requirements and vary across samples, hindering the diagnosis and targeted repair of persistent capability deficiencies. We propose APTER (Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics), a framework that integrates structured domain knowledge into fine-grained evaluation, optimization, and diagnosis for specialized complex reasoning. First, expert-grounded rubric construction starts from an expert criteria framework built by domain experts, where each criterion represents a stable professional capability. For each query, APTER selects relevant criteria and instantiates them into query-level rubrics linked to their source criteria, turning reusable expert criteria into executable query-level supervision without reference answers. Second, adaptive post-training uses rubric verdicts as both optimization and criterion-level diagnostic signals. Aggregating low-scoring verdicts by criterion ID reveals persistent deficiencies and triggers targeted supervised fine-tuning updates during reinforcement learning. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and medical question answering show consistent gains across both domains. Across three model generations, APTER improves the mathematics and medical averages over the corresponding base models by up to 15.86 and 8.04 points, respectively. Code and rubric datasets are available at https://github.com/AntDT-APTER/APTER.

AI.title_translation: APTER：基于专家基础评分细则的自适应后训练
AI.tldr: APTER是一个通过引入专家制定的评分细则和自适应后训练诊断机制，显著提升大语言模型在数学和医学等专业领域复杂推理能力的创新框架。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型进入专业领域时，需要满足领域约束、包含关键证据并提供完整推理。然而，现有的后训练方法多依赖整体偏好或结果级验证，且基于评分细则的方法通常独立生成细则，容易遗漏关键要求且缺乏跨样本的一致性，从而阻碍了模型持续能力缺陷的诊断和针对性修复。
AI.method: 提出了APTER框架，包含两个核心步骤：一是专家驱动的评分细则构建（由专家标准框架出发，为每个查询实例化相关的评分细则）；二是自适应后训练（利用评分细则的判定结果作为优化和准则级的诊断信号，通过聚合低分判定触发有针对性的监督微调更新）。
AI.result: 在数学推理和医学问答任务的实验中展现出持续的性能提升。在三个模型代际上，APTER使数学和医学任务的平均分分别比对应基线模型提高了最高15.86分和8.04分。
AI.conclusion: APTER框架通过整合结构化的领域知识进行细粒度评估、优化与诊断，有效提升了大语言模型在数学推理和医学问答等专业领域的表现，实现了显著的性能增益。
AI.translation: 随着大型语言模型进入专业领域，它们必须满足领域约束、包含关键证据并提供完整的推理，而不仅仅是产生流畅的回答。现有的后训练方法通常依赖于整体偏好或结果级验证，而最近基于评分细则的方法通常为每个查询独立生成评分细则。在专业领域中，这种无约束的评分细则可能会遗漏关键要求并在样本之间产生差异，从而阻碍了对持久能力缺陷的诊断和针对性修复。我们提出了APTER（基于专家基础评分细则的自适应后训练），这是一个将结构化领域知识整合到专业复杂推理的细粒度评估、优化和诊断中的框架。首先，专家基础评分细则的构建从由领域专家建立的专家标准框架开始，其中每个标准代表一个稳定的专业能力。对于每个查询，APTER选择相关标准并将其实例化为与其源标准链接的查询-级评分细则，将可重用的专家标准转化为无需参考答案的可执行查询级监督。其次，自适应后训练将评分细则判定用作优化和标准级诊断信号。通过按标准ID聚合低分判定揭示持久的缺陷，并在强化学习期间触发有针对性的监督微调更新。在数学推理和医学问答上的实验表明，两个领域都取得了持续的收益。在三个模型代际中，APTER将数学和医学的平均分较相应的基模分别提高了最高15.86和8.04分。代码和评分细则数据集可在 https://github.com/AntDT-APTER/APTER 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了APTER（基于专家基础评分细则的自适应后训练）框架，旨在将结构化领域知识整合到专业复杂推理的细粒度评估、优化和诊断中。该框架通过专家制定的标准构建稳定的评分细则，并将其转化为查询级监督，结合强化学习与细粒度诊断信号来实现有针对性的模型修复，在数学和医学领域取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 自适应后训练, 专家准则, 领域约束, 数学与医学推理
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的基于专家准则的自适应后训练框架（APTER），通过将领域专家制定的稳定标准转化为可执行的查询级评分细则，有效解决了大模型在专业领域中缺乏严格约束和推理不完整的问题。其亮点在于将强化学习与基于准则的诊断相结合，能够精准定位并修复模型的持续能力缺陷，具有很强的实用价值和跨领域泛化能力。

title: Connected Subspace Clustering: Hardness, a Scalable Heuristic, and an Application to Sea Level Geodesy
summary: Constrained optimization extends classical optimization by integrating side information, making it widely applicable across scientific and engineering domains. Consider a setting where we measure variables at different physical locations. When grouping these measurements, we often want clusters that are both internally similar and physically coherent. Thus, we have a constrained clustering problem where the constraint models coherence. Motivated by an application in geodesy, where contiguous regions of the sea surface must be identified for principal component analysis, we introduce the Connected Subspace Clustering problem: given high-dimensional points and a connectivity graph, partition them into $k$ connected clusters, minimizing their total squared distance to the clusters' best-fit $m'$-dimensional affine subspaces. We prove that, even for $m' = 0$ and a grid graph with holes, the problem is NP-hard to approximate within $Ω(n^{1/2-\varepsilon})$ for every $\varepsilon>0$, where $n$ is the number of measurements. We then introduce an efficient Lloyd-style heuristic that alternates subspace fitting with an iterative merging procedure to enforce connectivity. Our method returns exactly $k$ connected regions by construction, whereas unconstrained methods leave up to $1{,}966$ disconnected fragments at higher cost. In a study of 160 configurations on global sea level time series, our merging-based repair is the strongest of four strategies in $73.75\%$ of cases, and consistently outperforms competitors such as (connected) Ward's method across all tested cluster counts. The resulting regions isolate signals aligning with climate indices such as the El Nino-Southern Oscillation and Indian Ocean Dipole. Although developed for geodesy, the approach applies to other spatially embedded multivariate time series, such as climate fields, remote sensing, neuroimaging, and sensor networks.

AI.title_translation: 连通子空间聚类：难解性、可扩展启发式算法及其在海平面大地测量学中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文研究了带有空间连通约束的子空间聚类问题，证明了其NP难近似性，并提出了一种高效的启发式算法，在海平面数据分析中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 为了解决科学和工程中带有空间连通性约束的聚类问题，特别是受限于大地测量学中需要识别出用于主成分分析的海平面连续区域这一应用场景的驱动。
AI.method: 提出了一种高效的Lloyd风格启发式算法，通过交替进行子空间拟合与基于迭代合并的修复过程来强制实现连通性，从而在构建时精确返回 $k$ 个连通区域。
AI.result: 理论上证明了该问题即使在特定简化情况下也具有很高的NP难近似性（在 $Ω(n^{1/2-\varepsilon})$ 范围内难以近似）；实验表明，所提出的合并修复策略在73.75%的测试配置中表现最优，且在所有测试的聚类数下均持续优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了连通子空间聚类问题，揭示了其理论计算难解性，并设计了一种可扩展的启发式算法，成功应用于全球海平面时间序列分析，有效分离出与气候指数相关的信号。
AI.translation: 约束优化通过整合附加信息扩展了经典优化，使其广泛应用于科学和工程领域。考虑这样一种设置：我们在不同的物理位置测量变量。在对这些测量值进行分组时，我们通常希望聚类既内部相似又在物理上具有连通性。因此，我们面临一个约束聚类问题，其中约束条件对连通性进行建模。受大地测量学中一个应用场景的驱动（其中必须识别出用于主成分分析的海平面连续区域），我们引入了连通子空间聚类问题：给定高维点和一个连通图，将其划分为 $k$ 个连通簇，并最小化它们到簇的最佳拟合 $m'$ 维仿射子空间的总体平方距离。我们证明，即使对于 $m' = 0$ 且带有孔洞的网格图，该问题在每个 $\varepsilon>0$ 下要近似到 $Ω(n^{1/2-\varepsilon})$ 以内也是 NP 难的，其中 $n$ 是测量次数。然后，我们引入了一种高效的 Lloyd 风格启发式算法，该算法交替进行子空间拟合与迭代合并过程以强制实现连通性。我们的方法通过构建能够精确返回 $k$ 个连通区域，而无约束方法则会以更高的成本留下多达 1,966 个不连通的碎片。在对全球海平面时间序列的 160 种配置进行的研究中，我们的基于合并的修复策略在 73.75% 的情况下是四种策略中最强的，并且在所有测试的聚类数下均一直优于诸如（连通的）沃德法等竞争对手。所得到的区域隔离出了与厄尔尼诺-南方涛动和印度洋偶极子等气候指数相一致的信号。尽管该方法是为大地测量学开发的，但它也适用于其他空间嵌入的多元时间序列，例如气候场、遥感、神经成像和传感器网络。
AI.summary: 该论文引入了连通子空间聚类问题，旨在将高-dimensional 数据点根据连通图约束划分为 $k$ 个连通簇，并最小化到仿射子空间的距离。作者证明了该问题的NP难近似性，开发了一种高效的迭代合并启发式算法，并在全球海平面大地测量学数据中验证了其优越性，能够有效识别与气候指数相关的信号。
AI.keywords: 连通子空间聚类, 约束优化, 大地测量学, 启发式算法, 空间多元时间序列
AI.comments: 该论文首次系统研究了连通子空间聚类问题，理论上证明了其极高的计算难度（NP-hard且难以近似），并设计了高效的Lloyd风格启发式算法。其结合空间图结构与子空间聚类的思想，在海平面大地测量学及其他空间多元时间序列分析中展现出卓越的性能。

title: MazeRunner: Nonlinear Task and Clue Orchestration for LLM-driven Black-Box Automated Penetration Testing
summary: Penetration testing is essential yet resource-intensive. Although large language models (LLMs) show promise for automating security auditing, existing agents mainly execute end-to-end workflows in simplified linear scenarios. Real-world black-box testing is fundamentally nonlinear: the attack graph is initially unknown and must be incrementally inferred from environmental feedback. Observations may reveal multiple attack branches, failures are often ambiguous, and critical clues may span long action horizons. Existing agents therefore tend to become trapped in depth-first exploration, misdiagnose failures, and forget prior evidence. We present MazeRunner, an autonomous penetration testing system built on a three-agent task-and-clue orchestration framework. It separates global orchestration, context-intensive execution, and failure-oriented review while persistently maintaining task states and environmental evidence. This design supports action revision, prerequisite recovery, branch switching, and long-range clue correlation. We evaluate MazeRunner on 10 recently released HTB targets, limiting each system-target run to 20 million LLM tokens and preventing target-specific solution leakage. With Claude Sonnet 4.5, MazeRunner completes 47.7% of annotated subtasks, compared with 36.2% for PentestGPT-V2 and 34.2% for Claude Code. It achieves user-level or higher access on six targets, including root access on two; each same-model baseline reaches user-level access on only two targets and never obtains root access. Execution-trace analysis further shows that MazeRunner explores more attack branches and acquires shells more efficiently.

AI.title_translation: 迷宫奔跑者：LLM驱动的黑盒自动化渗透测试的非线性任务和线索编排
AI.tldr: MazeRunner是一个利用LLM进行自动化渗透测试的系统，通过创新的任务和线索编排框架解决了现有方法的局限性，并在真实场景中取得了显著优于基线方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的渗透测试自动化方法在处理现实世界中复杂的、非线性的黑盒测试场景时存在局限性，容易陷入深度优先探索、误诊失败和遗忘先前证据等问题。
AI.method: MazeRunner采用了一个三代理任务和线索编排框架，将全局编排、上下文密集型执行和面向失败的审查分开，同时持续维护任务状态和环境证据，以支持动作修正、先决条件恢复、分支切换和远程线索关联。
AI.result: 在10个HTB目标上进行评估，MazeRunner完成了47.7%的标注子任务，优于PentestGPT-V2（36.2%）和Claude Code（34.2%）。MazeRunner在6个目标上实现了用户级别或更高的访问权限，包括2个目标的root访问权限，而基线方法仅在2个目标上达到用户级别访问权限且从未获得root访问权限。此外，MazeRunner能更有效地探索攻击分支并获取shell。
AI.conclusion: MazeRunner通过其创新的非线性任务和线索编排方法，显著提高了LLM驱动的黑盒自动化渗透测试的效率和效果，克服了现有方法的关键挑战，并在实际测试中展现出优越的性能。
AI.translation: 渗透测试至关重要但资源消耗巨大。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化安全审计方面显示出潜力，但现有代理主要在简化的线性场景中执行端到端工作流。现实世界的黑盒测试本质上是非线性的：攻击图最初是未知的，必须根据环境反馈逐步推断。观察结果可能揭示多个攻击分支，失败通常是模糊的，并且关键线索可能跨越很长的动作范围。因此，现有代理往往陷入深度优先探索，误诊失败，并遗忘先前的证据。我们提出了MazeRunner，一个建立在三代理任务和线索编排框架上的自主渗透测试系统。它将全局编排、上下文密集型执行和面向失败的审查分开，同时持续维护任务状态和环境证据。这种设计支持动作修正、先决条件恢复、分支切换和远程线索关联。我们在10个最近发布的HTB目标上评估了MazeRunner，将每次系统-目标运行限制在2000万个LLM令牌，并防止了目标特定的解决方案泄露。使用Claude Sonnet 4.5，MazeRunner完成了47.7%的标注子任务，相比之下，PentestGPT-V2为36.2%，Claude Code为34.2%。它在6个目标上实现了用户级别或更高的访问权限，包括两个目标的root访问权限；每个相同的模型基线仅在两个目标上达到用户级别访问权限，并且从未获得root访问权限。执行跟踪分析进一步表明，MazeRunner探索了更多的攻击分支，并更有效地获取了shell。
AI.summary: MazeRunner是一个创新的自动化渗透测试系统，通过其独特的三代理任务和线索编排框架，解决了现有LLM代理在处理非线性、动态变化的黑盒测试环境中的不足。该系统能够有效处理模糊的失败信息、探索多个攻击分支并关联跨越长距离的线索，从而在真实世界的渗透测试任务中取得了比现有方法更优越的性能。
AI.keywords: 自动化渗透测试, 大型语言模型, 黑盒测试, 任务编排, 线索关联
AI.comments: 该研究在自动化渗透测试领域取得了重要进展，通过引入非线性任务和线索编排的框架，有效解决了现有LLM代理在复杂场景下的局限性。MazeRunner的设计思路清晰，实验结果具有说服力，证明了其在实际应用中的有效性。未来的工作可以进一步探索该框架在更广泛的安全审计任务中的应用潜力，以及优化LLM的推理效率。

title: A Generalized Parallelogram Rule for Proportional Analogies on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: Analogies are quaternary relations of the form "a is to b as c is to d", usually denoted a : b :: c : d. This notion is formalized in particular with the notion of proportional analogy, which imposes some constraints on the valid analogies. Whereas proportional analogies have been studied mostly in symbolic domains and in vector spaces, their use is limited in non-Euclidean spaces. In this paper, we introduce a proportional analogy relation in Riemannian domains, extending the parallelogram rule used for arithmetic analogies in Euclidean spaces. We illustrate the introduced analogy on various manifolds, such as the sphere, shape spaces and manifolds of probability distributions.

AI.title_translation: 黎曼流形上的比例类比的广义平行四边形法则
AI.tldr: 该论文将比例类比的概念扩展到黎曼流形，引入了一种新的类比关系，并证明了其在各种流形上的适用性。
AI.motivation: 现有的比例类比方法主要局限于符号领域和向量空间，在非欧几里得空间中的应用受限。
AI.method: 在黎曼流形中引入比例类比关系，并扩展了欧几里得空间中的平行四边形法则。
AI.result: 在黎曼流形上成功引入了比例类比关系，并展示了其在球面、形状空间和概率分布流形上的应用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功地将比例类比的概念推广到了黎曼流形，为在非欧几里得空间中研究类比关系提供了新的途径。
AI.translation: 类比是四元关系，形式为“a之于b，如同c之于d”，通常表示为a:b::c:d。这种概念在比例类比的概念下得到了特别的正式化，它对有效的类比施加了一些约束。然而，比例类比的研究主要集中在符号领域和向量空间，在非欧几里得空间中的应用受到限制。在本文中，我们提出了一种黎曼域中的比例类比关系，并将欧几里得空间中用于算术类比的平行四边形法则进行了推广。我们在各种流形上说明了所引入的类比，例如球面、形状空间和概率分布流形。
AI.summary: 本文将比例类比的概念从向量空间扩展到黎曼流形，提出了一种新的类比关系，该关系是对欧几里得空间中平行四边形法则的推广。研究结果表明，该方法在球面、形状空间和概率分布流形等多种流形上均适用。
AI.keywords: 比例类比,黎曼流形,平行四边形法则,非欧几里得空间,类比关系
AI.comments: 该研究在将比例类比的概念推广到黎曼流形方面取得了重要进展，为非欧几里得空间中的类比研究开辟了新的方向。然而，该方法在实际应用中的效率和普适性仍有待进一步验证。

title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement
summary: Autoformalization is commonly framed as translating natural-language mathematical statements into machine-verifiable formal languages such as Lean 4. However, faithful formalization requires more than translation. Models must map mathematical concepts to the complex hierarchy of types and definitions in formal libraries such as Mathlib, while ensuring that generated statements preserve the meaning of the source propositions. Existing approaches struggle because they rely heavily on the model's parametric memory for library-specific knowledge, while common data construction pipelines often resort to filtering single-pass outputs and lack mechanisms for feedback-driven revision. To address these challenges, we introduce MathForm, an autoformalization framework for constructing verified training data through Mathlib knowledge retrieval and verification-guided iterative refinement. Before generation, a retrieval planner gathers relevant definitions and existing formalizations from Mathlib to guide the formalization generator. Generated statements are then revised using compiler diagnostics and semantic-consistency feedback. Using this framework, we construct FormalVerse, a Lean 4 dataset containing approximately 367K verified examples across diverse mathematical domains and sources. We then train MathForm-8B through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. Across six benchmarks, MathForm-8B achieves average Pass@8 rates of 88.06% under Syntax Check (SC) and 72.37% under Consistency Check (CC), outperforming multiple specialized 32B autoformalizers. On the challenging FATE-H and FATE-X subsets, it attains CC pass rates of 63% and 37%, exceeding the strongest specialized baselines in both cases.

title: RankT2I: A Submodular Framework for Discovering Interpretable and Diverse Semantics in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) models have revolutionized the field of image generation and editing. However, identifying semantics that a T2I model can successfully edit in an image continues to be a challenging task. Most existing approaches require users to manually specify semantics to modify a particular image, a time-consuming process that often involves extensive trial and error. In this paper, we present RankT2I, a novel, training-free, and model-agnostic framework that automates the discovery of editable semantics in diffusion and FLUX-based models. Given a visual domain, we first utilize a multimodal vision-language model to gather a broad set of candidate semantics. We then frame semantic discovery as a set selection problem and use a submodular objective to identify semantics that are relevant, editable, and diverse. Our method helps users efficiently identify a wide range of semantics for text-to-image editing models across several domains while outperforming existing methods.

title: Attributing Preprocessing Invariance in Spectral Foundation Models
summary: Preprocessing invariance is an appealing goal for spectral foundation models: a frozen model should remain useful when laboratories preprocess spectra differently. It is usually measured by training a classifier under one preprocessing pipeline and testing it under another, with preserved accuracy read as evidence of learning. We revisit that reading, using a Raman foundation model as a case study. Such models normalize their inputs before any learned parameter is applied. If that normalization maps two differently preprocessed spectra to the same vector, the encoder receives identical inputs, so the invariance cannot be attributed to learning. For a normalization that uses each spectrum's own statistics, this happens exactly when one spectrum is a positive multiple of the other plus a constant. Several standard preprocessing operations take that form. The encoder should therefore be measured against the normalization alone, which has no learned parameters. On six Raman evaluation datasets, the model does not measurably outperform its own normalization. It improves on raw spectra, but so does the normalization alone. Training does improve the encoder over random initialization, and a controlled experiment shows that it learns to ignore a transformation only when that transformation reaches it. A numerical test settles which transformations a given normalization removes. Across released systems in five modalities, most normalizations already remove transformations of that form, and several of those systems claim that invariance as learned. Replicating the comparison on two of them shows no gain either.

title: AutoSchema: Live Schema Grounding for Agentic Text-to-Sparql over Heterogeneous Knowledge Graphs
summary: Life science knowledge graphs make large collections of structured data available through SPARQL, but each resource uses its own schema, identifiers, and links. TogoMCP helps language model agents query these resources by providing curated Metadata Interoperability Exchange files. Creating and maintaining these files still requires language model assisted drafting, validation, and manual review. We study \emph{live schema grounding}, where an agent obtains the schema evidence needed for a question directly from the current endpoints. We present \textsc{autoschema}, a general framework for live schema grounding that requires no training. It inspects live schemas, maps entity names in a question to graph identifiers, explores relation paths, and finds possible connections between resources during iterative query construction. We use TogoMCP as our main comparison framework. We evaluate \textsc{autoschema} on Resource Focused Biomedical KGQA, Multi Resource Biomedical KGQA, Longitudinal Biomedical Semantic QA over BioASQ Task B, and Chemistry Knowledge Graph Transfer to a previously undocumented RDF graph. \textsc{autoschema} improves mean factoid accuracy over TogoMCP in the biomedical KGQA tasks and gives consistent gains in the longitudinal BioASQ evaluation. It also reduces iteration budget exhaustion and uses fewer tool calls on average in the core evaluation. The transfer study gives preliminary evidence that live schema grounding can support irregular and previously unseen graphs without first creating a curated schema file.

title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning
summary: Popular facts are memorised more deeply during pretraining and resist removal longer than rare ones, yet existing LLM unlearning methods apply uniform gradient pressure regardless of training-data frequency. We propose the AdaPop (Adaptive Popularity) method, which combines local token confidence with a per-fact popularity-dependent exponent derived from an external proxy (e.g., Wikidata sitelinks, LLM-as-Judge), and automates the forget-retain balance via a dual-ascent controller that adjusts the retain penalty each epoch. Across three model families and two benchmarks, AdaPop leaks ~5x less forgotten content than competing methods under paraphrased queries and ~1.6x less under adversarial reformulations. We support our analysis with internal metrics: under our method, forget-set hidden states move further from the pre-unlearning model's states than under other methods, while retain-set representations remain close.

title: AppleScab-LT: A Longitudinal Real-Field Apple Scab Dataset for Temporal Disease Progression Analysis
summary: The development of reliable plant disease monitoring systems is constrained by limited longitudinal datasets capturing disease progression under natural field conditions. Although existing plant disease datasets have advanced image-based recognition, most consist of static images acquired at a single time point, limiting analysis of temporal disease evolution and severity progression. To address this gap, this study presents AppleScab-LT, a longitudinal real-field dataset developed to monitor apple scab progression through repeated observations of individually tracked infected leaves. Guided by a research-question-driven framework, the dataset was systematically developed, validated, and characterized for reliable longitudinal disease analysis. AppleScab-LT was constructed through systematic orchard monitoring under natural environmental conditions, incorporating longitudinal leaf tracking, expert-guided disease verification, polygon-based annotation, leaf isolation, disease severity quantification, and temporal sequence construction. A comprehensive quality assurance framework, including standardized annotation protocols, expert validation, automated integrity checks, sequence-level verification, and temporal consistency analysis, was applied throughout curation. The dataset contains 21 longitudinal leaf sequences, 2,101 high-resolution images, and 264 progressive temporal samples from repeated monitoring of same infected leaves. It captures variability in severity accumulation, progression rates, monitoring duration, and inter-leaf progression. Quantitative disease descriptors based on pixel severity, color-intensity severity, and normalized relative severity provide standardized measurements for temporal disease analysis. AppleScab-LT provides a reliable resource for temporal disease intelligence, disease progression modelling, precision agriculture, and future crop health monitoring

title: A Temporal Barrier Framework for Collision Avoidance in Multi-Agent Autonomous Aerial Vehicles
summary: Operating teams of autonomous aircraft in dynamic, uncertain, and potentially adversarial environments requires safety protocols that are reliable yet selective, and allow agents to fly in close proximity while making progress toward mission objectives. We introduce adversarial time-to-collision (aTTC), a risk metric that quantifies, for a given agent, how quickly any surrounding agent could reach it assuming adversarial intent. We embed aTTC into the control barrier function (CBF) framework, defining the barrier directly in time rather than distance or velocity. The resulting aTTC-CBF is inherently anticipatory: agents modulate their own velocity based not on whether a peer is on a collision course, but on how quickly one could reach collision given its dynamical constraints. A differentiable neural-network surrogate makes the aTTC computable in real time within a standard CBF quadratic program. Across long time-horizon simulations of 3D independent-pursuit and formation-flight scenarios, the aTTC-CBF achieves up to twice the waypoint progress at half the collision rate of a higher-order distance-based CBF baseline.

title: Could Model Partitioning Make Federated Learning More Sustainable?
comments: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 2nd International Workshop on Low Carbon Computing (LOCO 2026), Lancaster University, United Kingdom, 10-11 September 2026. Part of the LOCO 2026 proceedings, arXiv:LOCO2026/P09
summary:
As federated learning (FL) extends from distributed machine learning between low-power devices to cross-silo scenarios involving edge servers and data centres, its carbon footprint has become a growing concern. Addressing this, methods for sustainable FL align training with low-carbon energy availability or low grid demand and reduce the energy consumption of clients powered by high-carbon sources by decreasing the size of their models.
  We propose applying model partitioning, which can shift energy consumption by offloading parts of a model to another participant, in response to carbon- or grid-aware signals. Our preliminary findings show that for some partition points, model partitioning can reduce a participant's energy consumption by up to 76% without any significant time or energy consumption overhead compared to non-partitioned training.
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 2nd International Workshop on Low Carbon Computing (LOCO 2026), Lancaster University, United Kingdom, 10-11 September 2026. Part of the LOCO 2026 proceedings, arXiv:LOCO2026/P09

title: Zero-Shot Skeleton-Based Action Anticipation
summary: Action anticipation (AA) aims to recognize ongoing human or humanoids actions from partial observations, enabling robots to predict intentions before the actions are completed. Although skeleton-based AA offers efficiency advantages, existing approaches assume that all action classes are seen during training, which limits their deployment in real-world scenarios where novel actions inevitably arise. To address this gap, we study the new task of Zero-Shot Skeleton-Based Action Anticipation (ZS-SkAA). This task requires recognizing unseen action classes using only limited early-stage skeleton sequences, combining the challenges of partial observations, temporal dynamics, and zero-shot generalization. To establish foundational research for ZS-SkAA, we introduce:(1) A baseline model comprising a spatio-temporal feature extractor and a mutual information estimation and maximization module. This baseline model explicitly aligns partial visual features with semantic class embeddings across modalities by estimating and maximizing their mutual information, enhancing generalization to unseen classes.(2) A benchmark protocol using the NTU RGB+D dataset, which is adapted for rigorous ZS-SkAA evaluation. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our model as a strong baseline for ZS-SkAA, achieving high zero-shot accuracy on NTU RGB+D. This work establishes ZS-SkAA as a vital research direction for real-world systems requiring generalization to novel actions.

title: Vibration Suppression in Collaborative Flexible Payload Manipulation Using Passive Force Control
comments: Published in the proceedings of the 2026 European Control Conference (ECC)
summary: In large and heavy structures, vibrations arise during motion, posing significant challenges for precise manipulation. To accomplish the desired motion, control algorithms must effectively suppress these structural vibrations. In cutting edge projects, such as remote maintenance of future fusion energy reactors (tokamaks), the manipulation of this type of structure is defined as a crucial task. This paper presents a control strategy to suppress transverse vibrations in flexible payloads during motion using a collaborative payload manipulation approach. Two different industrial robot arms are arranged in a leader follower configuration for the manipulation strategy. The leader robot guides the motion with shaped velocity commands, while the follower robot ensures compliance with the estimated external forces applied by the leader on the payload through an admittance controller. Unlike existing methods, the proposed approach enables collaborative manipulation of heavier and larger flexible objects, addressing additional challenges such as vibration suppression and heterogeneous robot specifications. The dynamics of the leader follower payload system are modeled using an equivalent mass spring damper model, and it is shown that, with appropriate admittance parameters, the total energy of the system is passively dissipated. A stability proof is also provided. Numerical simulations validate the proposed method, and experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness.
comment: Published in the proceedings of the 2026 European Control Conference (ECC)

title: Polaris : Multi Agentic System for Conversational Enterprise Analytics
summary: In today's fast-paced environment, the ability to swiftly access, understand, and act on data is no longer optional; it is essential. Yet most organizations remain data-rich but insight-poor, constrained by the complexity of querying, interpreting, and explaining enterprise-scale information. We present Polaris, a supervisor-led multi-agent framework for conversational enterprise analytics that bridges this gap. Polaris introduces Dynamic Task Coordination (DTC), a decision-theoretic orchestration layer that models agent-task assignment as adaptive bipartite matching, enabling real-time coordination, recovery, and optimization across specialized agents for querying, visualization, and reasoning. By coupling DTC with reason-first, ReAct-style agents, Polaris transforms natural-language queries into coherent analytical workflows that not only retrieve and visualize data but also explain the underlying "why." Evaluation on structured enterprise datasets demonstrates high semantic fidelity and answer relevancy, underscoring the potential of multi-agent orchestration to deliver trustworthy, end-to-end business intelligence at scale.

title: AT-ADD: All-Type Audio Deepfake Detection Challenge Summary
summary: This paper summarizes the ACM Multimedia 2026 AT-ADD Grand Challenge on all-type audio deepfake detection. AT-ADD contains two tracks: robust speech deepfake detection under realistic acoustic and channel variations, and type-agnostic detection over speech, environmental sound, singing voice, and music. We describe the challenge tasks, dataset and evaluation-set design, official leaderboard results, and common design patterns observed in participating systems. The best Track 1 system achieved 90.71% Macro-F1 on the final evaluation set, while the best Track 2 system achieved 96.10% Macro-F1. The final submissions show that strong systems commonly combine large-scale self-supervised audio representations, data augmentation, multi-crop inference, and structured fusion or routing. The results also reveal remaining challenges in generalization to unseen generators, robustness to realistic speech-domain distortions, and balanced performance across heterogeneous audio types.

title: Grounding Without Corrective Control: Truth-Tracking Profiles for Large Language Models
comments: 24 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. A six-page methodological supplement, reproducible R script, and constructed data are included as ancillary files
summary:
Recent work suggests that some large language model representations have content or reference. Grounding can secure either without supplying live routes for correction. This paper asks what follows from that gap. An output is answerable when discrepancies can affect what a target- and task-specific arrangement produces, accepts, or withdraws. The arrangement has corrective control only when live, sufficiently independent routes can detect and repair fresh discrepancies. A route profile records which routes constrain the arrangement and how they are related. Those profiles support analysis of truth-tracking: patterned support for representational success.
  Language models are the pressure case; text-only arrangements provide a task-relative limiting case. Text-trained models inherit patterns of testimony, coherence, and prior correction. Where target-sensitive correction survives training, these can supply derivative answerability (inherited constraint); live answerability is the relation supplied by a current route for fresh discrepancies. Fluent failures should follow when a task requires independently informative access to the facts. Self-consistency, retrieval, tools, code execution, multimodal input, and feedback should help selectively. Route-by-task interactions test the distinctions. The decomposition's empirical burden is to predict held-out route--task combinations or improve intervention choice without conceptual refitting. Surface improvement and truth-tracking improvement can come apart.
comment: 24 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. A six-page methodological supplement, reproducible R script, and constructed data are included as ancillary files

title: Meteorology-driven Causal Nowcasting of Fugitive Landfill Emissions Enables Proactive Public Health Response
summary: Fugitive emissions from waste sites increasingly expose communities to toxic and odorous gases, yet public-health responses remain largely retrospective, with episodes investigated only after residents have been exposed. Here we show that the meteorological drivers of elevated hydrogen sulphide (HS) at a long-monitored European landfill, and the timescales over which they act, can be identified directly from routine monitoring data. We introduce CAIRN (Causal-Anchored Inference for Receptor Nowcasting), a machine-learning framework whose internal memory is matched to these measured timescales: a fast component tracking hour-scale wind-borne transport and a slow component tracking multi-hour weather changes. Trained to predict gas measurements, CAIRN operates using only routine weather variables and the calendar, without hand-engineered features. Its behaviour is consistent with the identified transport mechanisms, and the framework transfers unchanged to a second monitoring station and to co-emitted methane. Combining four such nowcasters produces a site-level, tiered alert aligned with WHO odour guidance that closely reproduces the alert generated by a direct sensor network and tracks an independent record of community odour complaints. Weather-driven nowcasting can therefore estimate community impact as an emission episode unfolds, providing public-health authorities with a validated, graded trigger for intervention and enabling exposure to be reduced during events rather than after them.

title: On the Robustness of Temporal Vision-Language Models for Surgical Endoscopy Videos
summary: Temporal vision-language models (TVLMs) offer a reusable, prompt-based interface for surgical video understanding, yet, their robustness under clinically realistic acquisition artifacts in endoscopy remains insufficiently characterized. In practice, degradations such as defocus, haze, motion blur, noise, cautery smoke, and packet loss introduce structured distribution shifts which may compromise video-text alignment. We study the robustness of temporal VLMs under such shifts caused by corruptions in clip frames. We introduce Endo-C6, a compact corruption benchmark of six endoscopy-realistic perturbations evaluated at a fixed high severity, and apply it to public Gastrointestinal (GI) endoscopy and laparoscopic cholecystectomy videos. Under a standardized prompt protocol, we benchmark 3 recent surgical TVLM baselines and analyze robustness in both mean and worst-case settings, spanning 294 dataset-level evaluations. Finally, we present RobustEndoCLIP, obtained by few-shot parameter-efficient tuning with VeRA, outperforming existing TVLM baselines. Our findings show that off-the-shelf TVLMs can exhibit severe worst-case collapse under endoscopy-specific corruptions, whereas lightweight few-shot adaptation can substantially improve corrupted performance and robustness without changing the prompt-based interface. We expect Endo-C6 to support standardized robustness reporting and promote more reliable clinical vision-language systems.

title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Model Merging
summary: Model merging combines trained models directly in weight space, offering a compute-efficient alternative to additional fine-tuning. Selecting merge parameters is nevertheless difficult because downstream evaluations are expensive, gradients are unavailable, and source capabilities can conflict. We formulate merge-parameter selection as a black-box multi-objective optimization problem and introduce MOBO-Merge, a merge-operator agnostic framework that uses multi-objective Bayesian optimization to approximate the Pareto front under a limited evaluation budget. We evaluate Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B in two-model instruction-math and three-model instruction-math-code settings using Linear, SLERP, TIES, and block-wise merge operators. On held-out benchmark partitions, MOBO-Merge obtains higher mean hypervolume than random search in 11 of 12 reported comparisons. The gain is small for one-dimensional Linear interpolation but substantially larger for several TIES, block-wise, and three-objective searches. No merge operator is uniformly best: TIES leads in three of four family-setting combinations, whereas Block-Linear 4x is strongest for the Llama three-model merge. These results show that multi-objective Bayesian optimization is valuable as a search layer for expressive merge parameterizations.

title: Accelerating Large-scale Bundle Adjustment for LiDAR Mapping via Parallel Computing
comments: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE), 2026
summary: LiDAR bundle adjustment is widely utilized in mapping to construct globally consistent point cloud maps. In this paper, we propose the first fully parallel computing framework to accelerate LiDAR bundle adjustment for large-scale mapping, incorporating three key techniques. First, we design an adaptive, asynchronous data loading strategy to efficiently process large-scale point cloud datasets on memory-constrained GPUs. Secondly, we present a novel bottom-up voxelization method for extracting planar features, enabling fully parallelized pre-processing. Thirdly, we build upon a majorization-minimization formulation to accelerate compute-intensive tasks in the optimization via parallel computation, including the computation of residuals, Jacobian and Hessian matrices, and a parallel increment solver. To support our design, we provide both theoretical and experimental analysis of the time complexity of our approach. Extensive benchmarking on large-scale public datasets across various computational platforms validates the robustness and adaptability of our approach, achieving up to a tenfold improvement in computational efficiency while preserving mapping accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art methods. To benefit future research, the implementation code is available on GitHub.
comment: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE), 2026

title: TimeSage-EV: A Live Benchmark for Agentic Time Series Analysis in Evolving Environments
summary: Time series analysis in high-stakes domains relies on recurring data releases, where new observations can alter the evidence base and the validity of later conclusions. Existing time series QA benchmarks mostly rely on fixed snapshots, leaving temporal validity and cutoff-aware evidence use unevaluated. We introduce TimeSage-EV, a live benchmark for agentic time series analysis in evolving environments. It tracks 60 real institutional scenarios across 6 domains, comprising 1,485 scenario-period QA pairs from Feb 2023 to May 2026 and spanning monthly, weekly, daily, and irregular release cadences. At each period, large language model (LLM) agents receive time series data and source reports, while the withheld target release provides ground truth. TimeSage-EV evaluates state identification, data summarization, and outlook reasoning. Experiments with frontier LLM agents and TimeSage-1.0, a novel self-evolving agent with a reusable analytical skill library, reveal significant performance gaps across model tiers and recurring failures in temporal validity, exogenous context use, and adaptation. We release TimeSage-EV as a research resource with monthly updates, code, a leaderboard, and failure-mode analyses.

AI.title_translation: TimeSage-EV：演化环境中基于智能体的时间序列分析实时基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于演化环境的时间序列智能体实时评测基准 TimeSage-EV，并揭示了当前前沿大模型在时间有效性与外生上下文利用上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列问答基准大多依赖固定快照，无法评估在数据持续更新的高风险真实场景中，智能体对时间有效性（temporal validity）和截断感知证据（cutoff-aware evidence）的利用与推理能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含 6 个领域 60 个真实机构场景、1485 个问答对的实时基准 TimeSage-EV，涵盖不同发布周期；在每个周期向 LLM 智能体提供时间序列数据与源报告，并以未公开的目标发布作为真值，评估状态识别、数据摘要和前景推理；同时设计了具备可重用分析技能库的新型自演化智能体 TimeSage-1.0。
AI.result: 在前沿 LLM 智能体和 TimeSage-1.0 上的实验表明，不同梯队模型间存在显著性能差距，且现有模型在时间有效性、外生上下文利用以及动态适应方面普遍存在反复出现的失效模式。
AI.conclusion: TimeSage-EV 为演化环境下的时间序列智能体评测提供了长期维护的实时资源，揭示了当前LLM在处理演化数据时的局限性，对推动具备时间有效性和自适应能力的智能体研究具有重要价值。
AI.translation: 高风险领域的时间序列分析依赖于周期性的数据发布，新观测数据可能会改变证据基础和后续结论的有效性。现有的时间序列问答基准大多依赖固定快照，未能评估时间有效性和截断感知的证据使用。我们提出了 TimeSage-EV，这是一个用于在演化环境中进行基于智能体的时间序列分析的实时基准。它追踪了 6 个领域的 60 个真实机构场景，包含 2023 年 2 月至 2026 年 5 月期间的 1,485 个场景-周期问答对，涵盖月度、周度、日度以及不规则的发布节奏。在每个周期，大语言模型（LLM）智能体接收时间序列数据和源报告，而未公开的目标发布数据则作为真实基准（ground truth）。TimeSage-EV 评估了状态识别、数据摘要和前景推理能力。在前沿 LLM 智能体以及具备可重用分析技能库的新型自演化智能体 TimeSage-1.0 上的实验表明，不同梯队模型之间存在显著性能差距，且在时间有效性、外生上下文使用和自适应方面普遍存在失败情况。我们将 TimeSage-EV 作为研究资源发布，并提供月度更新、代码、排行榜和失败模式分析。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有静态时间序列基准无法评估动态更新场景的问题，提出了实时演化基准 TimeSage-EV。该基准覆盖 6 个领域共 1,485 个场景-周期问答对，用于评估 LLM 智能体的状态识别、摘要与前景推理能力，并揭示了现有模型在时间感知与自适应方面的显著缺陷。
AI.keywords: 时间序列分析, LLM智能体, 实时基准, 演化环境, 时间有效性
AI.comments: 该研究敏锐地捕捉到了现实中时间序列分析动态、周期性更新的本质，指出现有静态快照基准无法评测时间有效性与截断感知能力的核心局限。引入实时更新机制并提出具有技能库的自演化智能体具有较强的创新性和实用价值，为金融、机构决策等高风险动态场景中的LLM评测提供了高质量基准。

title: Designing Mobile and Wearable Sensor-Fused Conversational Agents for Health and Wellbeing
comments: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a Tutorial at the 28th International Conference on Mobile Human-Computer Interaction (MobileHCI '26)
summary: Mobile and wearable devices increasingly collect continuous wellbeing data, including sleep, activity, heart rate, stress, blood glucose, and blood pressure. Yet access to such data does not automatically help people interpret their condition or change behavior. Many health applications remain dashboard-first, presenting charts, thresholds, goals, and alerts while leaving users to decide what a change means and what action should follow. Conversely, generic LLM-based conversational agents (CAs) can provide fluent advice, but without personal sensor grounding, they cannot detect individualized patterns or provide contextual guidance. This three-hour tutorial teaches participants how to move from passive monitoring to actionable wellbeing dialogue. Participants examine a dashboard that combines wearable health-data visualization with conversational-agent feedback, then use Wearable Sensor-Dialogue Wellbeing Agent Studio (WSDWAS) to simulate wearables, generate sensor snapshots, configure agent personas and prompt blocks, and compare dialogue styles. Grounded in Positive Computing, the tutorial emphasizes autonomy, competence, privacy, safety, and boundaries between wellbeing support and medical advice.
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a Tutorial at the 28th International Conference on Mobile Human-Computer Interaction (MobileHCI '26)

AI.title_translation: 为健康和福祉设计移动和可穿戴传感器融合对话代理
AI.tldr: 本教程教授如何设计利用移动和可穿戴传感器数据提供可操作的健康和福祉建议的对话代理，从而超越被动监测。
AI.motivation: 目前的健康应用主要以仪表盘为主，无法帮助用户解读数据或改变行为。通用的基于LLM的对话代理缺乏个人传感器数据基础，无法检测个体模式或提供情境指导。因此，需要从被动监测转向可操作的健康对话。
AI.method: 本教程通过一个结合了可穿戴健康数据可视化和对话代理反馈的仪表盘进行教学。参与者使用可穿戴传感器-对话健康代理工作室（WSDWAS）来模拟可穿戴设备、生成传感器快照、配置代理角色和提示块，并比较对话风格。该方法以积极计算为基础。
AI.result: 参与者学习如何从被动监测转向可操作的健康对话，理解如何设计用于健康和福祉的传感器融合对话代理，并强调自主性、能力、隐私、安全以及界限。
AI.conclusion: 本教程提供设计有效的传感器融合对话代理的实用技能和框架（积极计算），这些代理能够提供可操作的健康支持，弥合数据收集和行为改变之间的鸿沟。
AI.translation: 移动和可穿戴设备越来越多地收集持续的健康数据，包括睡眠、活动、心率、压力、血糖和血压。然而，获取这些数据并不能自动帮助人们解释他们的状况或改变行为。许多健康应用程序仍然以仪表盘为主，呈现图表、阈值、目标和警报，而让用户自行决定变化意味着什么以及应该采取什么行动。相反，基于通用LLM的对话代理（CA）可以提供流畅的建议，但如果没有个人传感器基础，它们就无法检测个体模式或提供情境指导。这个为期三小时的教程教授参与者如何从被动监测转向可操作的健康对话。参与者检查一个结合了可穿戴健康数据可视化和对话代理反馈的仪表盘，然后使用可穿戴传感器-对话健康代理工作室（WSDWAS）来模拟可穿戴设备、生成传感器快照、配置代理角色和提示块，并比较对话风格。本教程以积极计算为基础，强调自主性、能力、隐私、安全以及健康支持和医疗建议之间的界限。
AI.summary: 本文描述了一个关于为健康和福祉设计移动和可穿戴传感器融合对话代理（CA）的三小时教程。它通过教导参与者如何从被动数据监测转向可操作的健康对话，解决了当前以仪表盘为主的健康应用程序和通用LLM对话代理的局限性。参与者使用可穿戴传感器-对话健康代理工作室（WSDWAS）学习模拟可穿戴设备、配置代理角色和比较对话风格，所有这些都以积极计算原则（如自主性、隐私和安全）为基础。
AI.keywords: 对话代理, 可穿戴传感器, 健康与福祉, 积极计算, 数据解读
AI.comments: 本教程解决了数字健康领域的一个关键空白：从被动数据显示转向主动、个性化和可操作的指导。将传感器融合与对话代理相结合，并辅以实用的工作室工具（WSDWAS）和伦理基础（积极计算），使其在设计未来健康技术方面具有创新性和高度相关性。其局限性可能是教程本身的形式，可能无法涵盖深入的技术实现细节。

title: Solving QBF by Clause Selection
summary:
Algorithms based on the enumeration of implicit hitting sets find a growing number of applications, which include maximum satisfiability and model based diagnosis, among others.
  This paper exploits enumeration of implicit hitting sets in the context of Quantified Boolean Formulas (QBF). The paper starts by developing a simple algorithm for QBF with two levels of quantification, which is shown to relate with existing work on enumeration of implicit hitting sets, but also with recent work on QBF based on abstraction refinement. The paper then extends these ideas and develops a novel QBF algorithm, which generalizes the concept of enumeration of implicit hitting sets.
  Experimental results, obtained on representative problem instances, show that the novel algorithm is competitive with, and often outperforms, the state of the art in QBF solving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于隐式命中集枚举的新型QBF算法，该算法在实验中表现出与现有最先进技术相当甚至更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 隐式命中集枚举算法在多个领域应用日益广泛，本文旨在将其应用于量化布尔公式（QBF）求解，并开发出一种新的、更通用的QBF算法。
AI.method: 论文首先为两层量化的QBF开发了一个简单算法，该算法与隐式命中集枚举和基于抽象细化的QBF工作相关。然后，在此基础上扩展，开发了一种概括隐式命中集枚举概念的新型QBF算法。
AI.result: 在代表性问题实例上的实验结果表明，该新型算法与QBF求解的现有最先进技术相比具有竞争力，并且通常表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的新型QBF算法通过概括隐式命中集枚举的概念，在QBF求解方面取得了显著的竞争优势，甚至超越了现有最先进的技术。
AI.translation:
基于隐式命中集枚举的算法在最大可满足性问题和基于模型的诊断等领域中应用日益广泛。
本文在量化布尔公式（QBF）的背景下利用了隐式命中集的枚举。论文首先为具有两层量化的QBF开发了一个简单算法，该算法被证明与隐式命中集枚举的现有工作以及近期基于抽象细化的QBF工作相关。随后，论文扩展了这些思想，并开发了一种新颖的QBF算法，该算法概括了隐式命中集枚举的概念。
在代表性问题实例上获得的实验结果表明，该新型算法与QBF求解的现有最先进技术相比具有竞争力，并且通常表现更优。
AI.summary: 本文研究了隐式命中集枚举算法在量化布尔公式（QBF）求解中的应用。首先，提出了一种针对两层量化QBF的简单算法，并探讨了其与现有隐式命中集枚举及抽象细化QBF工作的联系。在此基础上，进一步开发了一种泛化隐式命中集枚举概念的新型QBF算法。实验结果表明，该算法在性能上与现有顶尖QBF求解器相当甚至更优。
AI.keywords: QBF求解, 隐式命中集枚举, 子句选择, 量化布尔公式, 抽象细化
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将隐式命中集枚举的概念推广并应用于QBF求解，提出了一种新颖的算法。该研究在理论上将QBF求解与隐式命中集枚举和抽象细化等现有工作联系起来，并在实践中通过实验证明了其优越的性能，对QBF求解领域具有重要意义。

title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a promising way to transfer reasoning capabilities from stronger teacher models, but applying it to long-context reasoning teachers and short-context students introduces practical challenges, including tokenizer mismatch, teacher-student distribution mismatch, response length explosion, and training instability. In this work, we study this setting by transferring proof-reasoning capabilities from the long-context reasoning model SU-01 to short-context student models. To handle tokenizer differences, we perform OPD in a shared text space and align only tokens that occupy identical text spans under the student and teacher tokenizers. To mitigate the problem of excessive generation length and frequent truncation, we introduce a student reference KL loss and mask the advantages of special termination tokens such as </think> and <|im_end|>. This strategy constrains the student from drifting excessively from its initial policy, thereby mitigating the teacher-student distribution mismatch problem and fostering steady length growth. Experiments on both same-family and different-family student models, including Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Intern-S2, GLM-4.7, Gemma-4, show consistent gains in mathematical reasoning, especially natural-language math proving. Notably, Intern-S2-Preview improves by 21.2 points on ProofBench, reaching 55.2 and surpassing Gemini-2.5-Pro. It also improves on science benchmarks such as HLE and HiPhO, suggesting that OPD transfers reasoning capabilities that generalize beyond the mathematical training domain.

AI.title_translation: SimpleOPD：用于长上下文推理的简单与分词器无关的在线策略蒸馏
AI.tldr: SimpleOPD通过在共享文本空间中对齐token并引入KL损失来解决长上下文教师到短上下文学生在线策略蒸馏中的分词器和分布不匹配问题，显著提升了数学推理能力并泛化到科学领域。
AI.motivation: 将在线策略蒸馏（OPD）应用于长上下文推理教师模型和短上下文学生模型时面临实际挑战，包括分词器不匹配、师生分布不匹配、响应长度爆炸和训练不稳定性。
AI.method: 提出了SimpleOPD，通过在共享文本空间中执行OPD，并仅对学生和教师分词器下占据相同文本跨度的token进行对齐来处理分词器差异。引入学生参考KL损失并屏蔽特殊终止token（如</think>和<|im_end|>）的优势，以缓解生成长度过长和频繁截断的问题，同时限制学生策略漂移，从而减轻师生分布不匹配并促进长度稳定增长。
AI.result: 在同家族和不同家族学生模型（包括Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Intern-S2, GLM-4.7, Gemma-4）上，数学推理（特别是自然语言数学证明）能力均获得显著提升。Intern-S2-Preview在ProofBench上提高了21.2分，达到55.2分，超过Gemini-2.5-Pro。在HLE和HiPhO等科学基准上也取得了进步。
AI.conclusion: SimpleOPD成功地将推理能力从长上下文教师模型转移到短上下文学生模型，并且这些推理能力可以泛化到数学训练领域之外。
AI.translation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）提供了一种有前景的方法，可以从更强的教师模型中转移推理能力，但将其应用于长上下文推理教师和短上下文学生会带来实际挑战，包括分词器不匹配、师生分布不匹配、响应长度爆炸和训练不稳定性。在这项工作中，我们通过将证明推理能力从长上下文推理模型SU-01转移到短上下文学生模型来研究这一设置。为了处理分词器差异，我们在共享文本空间中执行OPD，并且仅对在学生和教师分词器下占据相同文本跨度的token进行对齐。为了缓解生成长度过长和频繁截断的问题，我们引入了学生参考KL损失，并屏蔽了特殊终止token（如</think>和<|im_end|>）的优势。这一策略限制了学生过度偏离其初始策略，从而减轻了师生分布不匹配问题并促进了长度的稳定增长。对同家族和不同家族学生模型（包括Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Intern-S2、GLM-4.7、Gemma-4）的实验表明，在数学推理，特别是自然语言数学证明方面，取得了持续的收益。值得注意的是，Intern-S2-Preview在ProofBench上提高了21.2分，达到55.2分，并超越了Gemini-2.5-Pro。它还在HLE和HiPhO等科学基准上有所改进，这表明OPD转移的推理能力可以泛化到数学训练领域之外。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SimpleOPD，一种用于长上下文教师到短上下文学生在线策略蒸馏的方法，旨在解决分词器不匹配、师生分布不匹配和响应长度爆炸等挑战。SimpleOPD通过在共享文本空间中对齐token和引入学生参考KL损失来克服这些问题。实验结果显示，该方法显著提升了学生模型在数学推理（尤其是证明）上的表现，并在科学基准上展现出泛化能力，证明了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 在线策略蒸馏, 长上下文推理, 分词器无关, 数学推理, 知识蒸馏
AI.comments: SimpleOPD的创新点在于其处理分词器不匹配和控制生成长度的策略，使得在线策略蒸馏在长上下文教师到短上下文学生的场景下变得可行和有效。其通过文本空间对齐和KL损失来稳定训练并提高性能，展示了强大的实用价值。该方法在多个模型和任务上的成功，特别是超越Gemini-2.5-Pro的性能，凸显了其重要性。

title: Learning to Forecast Crop Growth from Earth Observation Data
summary: Forecasting crop growth across agricultural landscapes is important for improving the productivity, resilience, and operational management of farming systems. In this work, we investigate whether Earth observation time series and meteorological drivers can be used to predict future canopy development at country scale. We focus on winter wheat and formulate crop growth prediction as forecasting future leaf area index (LAI) trajectories beyond the last available Sentinel-2 observation. We evaluate this task on a multi-year dataset which spans the entire country of Switzerland, containing over 20 million pixel-level Sentinel-2-derived LAI time series paired with meteorological variables. Because cloud cover and revisit gaps leave LAI supervision sparse, models fit the few valid (cloud-free) LAI observations yet oscillate implausibly between them, producing trajectories no real canopy could follow. We introduce a lightweight unimodal shape regulariser which improves trajectory plausibility with negligible loss in accuracy. We compare deep learning sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) models with classic machine learning baselines and show that Seq2Seq models generalise well across years, achieving $\mathrm{R}^2$ above 0.8 and consistently outperforming conventional approaches. AI.title_translation: 从地球观测数据中学习预测作物生长
AI.tldr: 该研究利用地球观测时间序列和气象数据，通过深度学习序列到序列模型预测瑞士全国范围内的冬季小麦作物生长（叶面积指数），并引入了轻量级单峰形状正则化器以提高预测轨迹的合理性，结果显示其性能优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 预测农业景观中的作物生长对于提高农业系统的生产力、韧性和运营管理至关重要。
AI.method: 研究将作物生长预测表述为预测未来叶面积指数（LAI）轨迹，超越最后可用的Sentinel-2观测。使用了一个跨越瑞士全国的多年数据集，包含超过2000万像素级的Sentinel-2衍生的LAI时间序列和气象变量。引入了一个轻量级单峰形状正则化器来改善轨迹的合理性。比较了深度学习序列到序列（Seq2Seq）模型与经典机器学习基线模型。
AI.result: 深度学习Seq2Seq模型在不同年份间泛化良好，R²高于0.8，并始终优于传统方法。轻量级单峰形状正则化器在精度损失可忽略不计的情况下提高了轨迹的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 遥感和天气驱动的序列建模可以学习景观尺度的作物生长动态。
AI.translation: 预测农业景观中的作物生长对于提高农业系统的生产力、韧性和运营管理至关重要。在这项工作中，我们研究了地球观测时间序列和气象驱动因素是否可以用于预测国家尺度的未来冠层发育。我们专注于冬小麦，并将作物生长预测表述为预测超越最后可用Sentinel-2观测的未来叶面积指数（LAI）轨迹。我们在一个涵盖整个瑞士全国的多年数据集上评估了这项任务，该数据集包含超过2000万像素级的Sentinel-2衍生的LAI时间序列以及气象变量。由于云层覆盖和重访间隔导致LAI监督稀疏，模型拟合少数有效的（无云的）LAI观测值，但在它们之间不可信地振荡，产生真实冠层无法遵循的轨迹。我们引入了一种轻量级单峰形状正则化器，它在精度损失可忽略不计的情况下提高了轨迹的合理性。我们比较了深度学习序列到序列（Seq2Seq）模型与经典机器学习基线模型，结果表明Seq2Seq模型在不同年份间泛化良好，R²高于0.8，并始终优于传统方法。总而言之，这些结果表明遥感和天气驱动的序列建模可以学习景观尺度的作物生长动态。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在使用地球观测数据和气象驱动因素预测国家尺度的作物生长，以提高农业生产力。研究以瑞士全国范围内的冬季小麦为对象，通过预测未来叶面积指数（LAI）轨迹来评估作物生长。面对稀疏的LAI数据导致的预测轨迹不合理问题，研究引入了一种轻量级单峰形状正则化器。实验结果表明，深度学习序列到序列（Seq2Seq）模型在泛化性和性能上均优于传统机器学习方法，R²值超过0.8，证明遥感和气象数据驱动的序列建模能有效学习景观尺度的作物生长动态。
AI.keywords: 作物生长预测, 地球观测, 叶面积指数, 序列到序列模型, 遥感
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将深度学习序列到序列模型应用于大规模作物生长预测，并针对稀疏数据导致的轨迹不合理问题提出了有效的单峰形状正则化器。这对于提高农业管理的精准性和效率具有重要意义，尤其是在利用遥感数据进行农业监测和预测方面展现了巨大潜力。其局限性可能在于模型对不同作物种类和地理区域的泛化能力，以及对更高分辨率或更复杂环境数据的处理能力。

title: MAGneT-3D: Monocular and Domain-Generalizable Temporal 3D Detection
comments: To appear at ECCVW 2026 (DriveX workshop; Oral paper). Johannes Meier and Mohamed Kotb - both authors contributed equally. Project page: https://mo-sameh.github.io/MAGneT-3D-Project-Page/
summary: Monocular temporal 3D detection aims to detect objects in 3D, given a monocular video. Query-based 3D detectors unify detection and cross-view association, but their learnable queries fit the spatial distribution of the training data (e.g., field-of-view). We show that this issue is especially severe when these models are applied to monocular video, hindering generalization to unseen datasets and environments. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGneT-3D, the first method for domain-generalized monocular temporal 3D object detection. Instead of relying on static learnable queries, we propose a Domain-Robust Anchor Generator (DRAG) approach that adaptively derives 3D proposals during inference. To further enable domain generalization, we propose a Temporal Refinement and Identity Merging (TRIM) strategy, reducing dependence on specific 3D proposals. To enable comprehensive domain-generalization evaluation, we establish a cross-dataset benchmark spanning nuScenes, Waymo, Lyft, and ONCE. Under zero-shot domain shifts, MAGneT-3D outperforms all baselines, improving NDS from 12.1% to 18.6% while also increasing in-domain accuracy.
