title: CoCA: Step-level Reward for Free in RL-based T2I Diffusion Model Fine-tuning
summary: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) diffusion model fine-tuning leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to align generated images with learnable reward functions. The existing approaches reformulate denoising as a Markov decision process for RL-driven optimization. However, they suffer from reward sparsity, receiving only a single delayed reward per generated trajectory. This flaw hinders precise step-level attribution of denoising actions, undermines training efficiency. To address this, we propose a simple yet effective credit assignment framework that dynamically distributes dense rewards across denoising steps. Specifically, we track changes in cosine similarity between intermediate and final images to quantify each step's contribution on progressively reducing the distance to the final image. Our approach avoids additional auxiliary neural networks for step-level preference modeling and instead uses reward shaping to highlight denoising phases that have a greater impact on image quality. Our method achieves 1.25 to 2 times higher sample efficiency and better generalization across four human preference reward functions, without compromising the original optimal policy.

title: A High-Accuracy Symplectic Scheme for a nonlinear transport problem
summary: We analyze an advection-diffusion-reaction problem with non-homogeneous boundary conditions that models the chromatography process.We prove stability and error estimates for both constant and affine adsorption, using the symplectic one-step implicit midpoint method for time discretization and finite elements for spatial discretization. In addition, we perform the stability analysis for the nonlinear, explicit adsorption in the continuous and semi-discrete cases. For the nonlinear, explicit adsorption, we also complete the error analysis for the semi-discrete case and prove the existence of a solution for the fully discrete case. The numerical tests validate our theoretical results

title: Research-Oriented Human-Centric Evaluation for Foundation Models
summary: Most current evaluations of foundation models focus on objective benchmarks, such as knowledge coverage and reasoning accuracy, often overlooking users' subjective experiences in human-AI collaboration. To address this gap, we propose a research-oriented Human-Centric Evaluation framework. It captures user perceptions across three core dimensions: problem-solving ability, information quality, and interaction experience, providing a structured, fine-grained approach to understanding how users evaluate and respond to model behavior in multi-modal research contexts. We conduct 604 human evaluation sessions across various disciplines, involving recent advanced foundation models. Through open-ended, time-limited collaborative tasks, we gather rich subjective assessments that highlight model capabilities and user preferences. Additionally, we perform an LLM-as-a-judge experiment and find that even sophisticated models struggle to accurately replicate human subjective judgment, emphasizing the irreplaceable value of first-person human assessment. Our project link is https://github.com/yijinguo/Human-Centric-Evaluation.

title: Numerical methods for fully nonlinear degenerate diffusions
summary: We propose finite difference methods for degenerate fully nonlinear elliptic equations and prove the convergence of the schemes. Our focus is on the pure equation and a related free boundary problem of transmission type. The cornerstone of our argument is a regularisation procedure. It decouples the degeneracy term from the elliptic operator driving the diffusion process. In the free boundary setting, a two-parameters regularisation entails new, genuine difficulties. To bypass them, we resort to the intrinsic properties of the regularised problem and a fixed-point type of argument. We present numerical experiments supporting our theoretical results. Our methods are flexible, and our approach can be extended to a broader class of non-variational problems.

title: No Data? No Problem: Synthesizing Security Graphs for Better Intrusion Detection
summary: Provenance graph analysis plays a vital role in intrusion detection, particularly against Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs), by exposing complex attack patterns. While recent systems combine graph neural networks (GNNs) with natural language processing (NLP) to capture structural and semantic features, their effectiveness is limited by class imbalance in real-world data. To address this, we introduce PROVSYN, a novel hybrid provenance graph synthesis framework, which comprises three components: (1) graph structure synthesis via heterogeneous graph generation models, (2) textual attribute synthesis via fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs), and (3) five-dimensional fidelity evaluation. Experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that PROVSYN consistently produces higher-fidelity graphs across the five evaluation dimensions compared to four strong baselines. To further demonstrate the practical utility of PROVSYN, we utilize the synthesized graphs to augment training datasets for downstream APT detection models. The results show that PROVSYN effectively mitigates data imbalance, improving normalized entropy by up to 0.35 in absolute terms, and enhances the generalizability of downstream detection models, yielding an absolute increase of up to 0.38 in balanced accuracy.

title: Responsiveness Verification: Will Predictions Change? How Much? How Often?
summary: Machine learning models are often used in applications where their inputs change due to routine interactions, strategic manipulation, or noise. In such settings, models can undermine safety as these changes lead them to predict over regions of input space they have not seen. We propose to address these challenges by measuring responsiveness---the probability that a model output changes when its inputs change under an interaction model. We develop algorithms to estimate responsiveness for any machine learning model, and a framework to specify broad classes of interaction models. We pair these algorithms with statistical guarantees that support practical validation. We demonstrate how our tools can promote safety and reliability across domains by detecting preclusion in recidivism prediction, estimating the cost of gaming in content moderation, and testing the robustness of benchmarks for LLMs.

title: Two-dimensional time-to-collision measures for articulated vehicles: predicting sideswipe and rear-end collisions
summary: Time-to-collision is a commonly employed measure for rear-end collision prediction. However, its conventional formulation, which assumes constant speed and heading, is incapable of identifying sideswipe collisions. A two-dimensional extension has been proposed to incorporate lateral interactions with passenger cars, yet it assumes identical, fixed headings and does not accommodate articulated vehicles such as tractor-semitrailers. In this paper, the existing formulation for the car is first refined to incorporate differences in vehicle heading. Subsequently, new two-dimensional time-to-collision measures are proposed for articulated vehicles: TTC$_{\mathrm{2D}}^{\mathrm{AV}}$ and modified TTC$_{\mathrm{2D}}^{\mathrm{AV}}$. These measures employ constant-speed and constant-acceleration assumptions and are analogous to their one-dimensional counterparts: time-to-collision and modified time-to-collision. The proposed measures are assessed in CARLA using randomly generated cut-in scenarios simulated with a tractor-semitrailer model, incorporating a range of trailer lengths. A short analysis is also conducted to test the measures in a roundabout and tight turn. The analyses demonstrate that the proposed measures substantially improve the detection of sideswipe collisions while maintaining a comparable level of performance to existing measures in detecting rear-end collisions. Across 30 simulated scenarios, they correctly identify 14 of 15 sideswipe collisions, compared with 7 of 15 identified by the existing formulation. Moreover, the mean prediction error for sideswipe collisions is reduced by approximately 20% compared to the existing formulation.

title: Concept Unlearning by Modeling Key Steps of Diffusion Process
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models remain susceptible to generating undesirable or harmful content. Although concept unlearning mitigates this risk, existing methods struggle with a critical optimization dilemma: thorough semantic erasure frequently induces the catastrophic forgetting of unrelated generative capabilities. To overcome this challenge, we propose Key Step Concept Unlearning (KSCU). Serving as an integrated methodological refinement deeply motivated by information theory, KSCU explores the profound impact of step scheduling order and reveals that traditional randomized timestep sampling severely disrupts trajectory dependency. We demonstrate that indiscriminately targeting the entire diffusion process is inefficient, as the optimal step range for unlearning inherently varies across different concepts. Rather than globally fine-tuning all timesteps, KSCU explicitly integrates a sequential-scheduling-based Key Step Table, CFG-aware leakage compensation, and prompt augmentation to dynamically isolate optimization to a concept-specific active region. This localized strategy successfully eradicates the target concept while preventing the structural collapse caused by early-step over-optimization. Consequently, KSCU significantly reduces computational overhead and establishes a state-of-the-art trade-off between concept erasure and utility retention. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that KSCU consistently delivers superior performance across diverse unlearning tasks, including nudity, style, object classes, and mass instance concepts. For example, in nudity removal, KSCU yields a 96.5% unlearning accuracy alongside a state-of-the-art FID of 14.1.

title: PHASE: Passive Human Activity Simulation Evaluation
summary: Cybersecurity simulation environments, such as cyber ranges, honeypots, and sandboxes, require realistic human behavior to be effective, yet no quantitative method exists to assess the behavioral fidelity of synthetic user personas. This paper presents PHASE (Passive Human Activity Simulation Evaluation), a machine learning framework that analyzes Zeek connection logs and distinguishes human from non-human activity with over 90\% accuracy. PHASE operates entirely passively, relying on standard network monitoring without any user-side instrumentation or visible signs of surveillance. All network activity used for machine learning is collected via a Zeek network appliance to avoid introducing unnecessary network traffic or artifacts that could disrupt the fidelity of the simulation environment. The paper also proposes a novel labeling approach that utilizes local DNS records to classify network traffic, thereby enabling machine learning analysis. Furthermore, we apply SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) analysis to uncover temporal and behavioral signatures indicative of genuine human users. In a case study, we evaluate a synthetic user persona and identify distinct non-human patterns that undermine behavioral realism. Based on these insights, we develop a revised behavioral configuration that significantly improves the human-likeness of synthetic activity yielding a more realistic and effective synthetic user persona.

title: MorphIt: Flexible Spherical Approximation of Robot Morphology for Representation-driven Adaptation
summary: What if a robot could rethink its own morphological representation to better meet the demands of diverse tasks? Most robotic systems today treat their physical form as a fixed constraint rather than an adaptive resource, forcing the same rigid geometric representation to serve applications with vastly different computational and precision requirements. We introduce MorphIt, a novel spherical approximation framework that treats morphological representation as a tunable resource. MorphIt enables automatic task-driven morphological adaptation through gradient-based optimization with tunable parameters that provide explicit control over the accuracy-efficiency tradeoff. Unlike existing approaches that rely on either labor-intensive manual specification or inflexible computational methods optimized for visualization rather than robotics, MorphIt generates spherical approximations up to 100x faster than optimization-based methods while maintaining superior geometric fidelity. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate that MorphIt outperforms baseline approaches and achieves better mesh approximation with fewer spheres. Through seamless integration with existing robotics infrastructure, MorphIt enables enhanced capabilities in collision detection accuracy, contact-rich interaction simulation, and navigation through confined spaces. By dynamically adapting geometric representations to task requirements, robots can now exploit their physical embodiment as an active resource rather than an inflexible parameter, opening new frontiers for manipulation in environments where physical form must continuously balance precision with computational tractability.

title: The Fools are Certain; the Wise are Doubtful: Exploring LLM Confidence in Code Completion
summary: Code completion entails the task of providing missing tokens given a surrounding context. It can boost developer productivity and serve as a code discovery tool. Code completion has recently been approached with Large Language Models (LLMs) fine-tuned on code (code LLMs). The performance of code LLMs can be assessed with downstream and intrinsic metrics. Downstream metrics are usually employed to evaluate the practical utility of a model, but can be unreliable and require complex calculations and domain-specific knowledge. In contrast, intrinsic metrics such as perplexity, entropy, and mutual information, which measure model confidence or uncertainty, are simple, versatile, and universal across LLMs and tasks, and have been proposed as proxies for functional correctness and hallucination risk in LLM-generated code. Motivated by this, we evaluate the confidence of LLMs when generating code by measuring code perplexity across programming languages, models, and datasets using various LLMs, and a sample of 2254 files from 881 GitHub projects. We find that strongly-typed languages exhibit lower perplexity than dynamically typed languages. Scripting languages also demonstrate higher perplexity. Shell appears universally high in perplexity, whereas Java appears low. Code perplexity depends on the employed LLM; under a fixed model, relative language-level rankings are largely stable across evaluation corpora. Although code comments modestly increase perplexity, the language ranking based on perplexity is barely affected by their presence. LLM researchers, developers, and users can use our findings to assess the suitability of LLM-based code completion in specific software projects based on how language, model choice, and code characteristics impact model confidence.

title: Optimizing Frequent Checkpointing via Low-Cost Differential for Distributed Training Systems
summary:
Distributed training of large deep-learning models often leads to failures, so checkpointing is commonly employed for recovery. State-of-the-art studies focus on frequent checkpointing for fast recovery from failures. However, frequent checkpointing generates numerous checkpoints, incurring substantial costs and thus degrading training performance. Recently, differential checkpointing has been proposed to reduce costs, but it is limited to recommendation systems, so its application to general distributed training systems remains unexplored.
  In this paper, we find that gradients generated during distributed training can be reused to construct differential checkpoints, while the former's size is smaller than the latter's, motivating us to reuse gradients for low-cost differential checkpointing. Based on this main idea, we propose \sysname, a frequent checkpointing framework for compression-enabled training systems that reuses compressed gradients as differential checkpoints, eliminating redundant differential computation and reducing checkpoint transmission cost. Furthermore, we extend gradient reuse to scenarios without gradient compression and propose \sysnameplus, which employs layer-wise-reuse snapshotting and incremental-merging persistence to overlap checkpointing with training execution. Experiments on diverse workloads, including billion-parameter-scale models, demonstrate that \sysname and \sysnameplus significantly reduce checkpointing overhead and enable checkpointing at frequencies as high as once per iteration, reducing training time by up to 89.2\% and 81.2\%, respectively.

title: Fast Operator-Splitting Methods for Nonlinear Elliptic Equations
summary: Nonlinear elliptic problems arise in many fields, including plasma physics, astrophysics, and optimal transport. In this article, we propose a novel operator-splitting/finite element method for solving such problems. We begin by introducing an auxiliary function in a new way for a semilinear elliptic partial differential equation, leading to the development of a convergent operator-splitting/finite element scheme for this equation. The algorithm is then extended to fully nonlinear elliptic equations of the Monge-Ampère type, including the Dirichlet Monge-Ampère equation and Pucci's equation. This is achieved by reformulating the fully nonlinear equations into forms analogous to the semilinear case, enabling the application of the proposed splitting algorithm. In our implementation, a mixed finite element method is used to approximate both the solution and its Hessian matrix. Numerical experiments show that the proposed method outperforms existing approaches in efficiency and accuracy, and can be readily applied to problems defined on domains with curved boundaries.

AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于其独特地引入辅助函数并重构全非线性方程以适应算子分裂框架，从而为非线性椭圆方程提供了一种更高效和准确的求解方案。其重要性在于拓宽了数值方法在处理复杂非线性问题和几何域上的应用范围。

title: The Metacognitive Bottleneck: Japanese Riddles Reveal Fundamental Limits of Machine Insight and Self-Evaluation in Reasoning AI
summary: Benchmark saturation and training-data contamination increasingly obscure whether reported gains in large language models (LLMs) reflect genuine advances in reasoning or familiarity with recurring patterns in benchmark problems. We introduce the NazoNazo Benchmark, a renewable and extensible evaluation dataset derived from Japanese children's riddles that isolates a specific class of reasoning processes: insight-like representational restructuring and metacognitive evaluation. Rather than modeling reasoning in general, these tasks provide a focused test of failure modes that are difficult to detect in standard benchmarks. We curate 201 riddles and establish a human reference on a 120-item subset (n = 126; mean accuracy 52.9%). The benchmark is fully open, low-cost to refresh, and designed for continual evaluation under reduced contamination risk. We evaluate 38 frontier LLMs (2023-2025) under a strict retrieval-free, zero-shot protocol. On the human-comparison subset, non-reasoning models achieve 7.6% accuracy and reasoning-oriented models reach 17.6%, compared with a human mean of 52.9%, although performance varies substantially across models. Beyond accuracy, qualitative analysis of model-generated thought-logs identifies a distinctive failure mode, which we call verification failure: models generate a correct intermediate candidate but fail to endorse it as their final answer. This dissociation between candidate generation and endorsement reveals a metacognitive bottleneck: across the models with usable thought-logs, verification failures account for between 5% and 39% of a model's incorrect answers. By isolating the gap between generation and verification, this work provides a practical framework for diagnosing reasoning reliability and suggests concrete directions for improvement, including better calibration, structured verification, and stopping mechanisms.

AI.title_translation: 元认知瓶颈：日本谜语揭示推理AI中机器洞察力和自我评估的根本局限
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLM）在需要洞察力和元认知评估的日本谜语基准上表现不佳，揭示了元认知瓶颈，即模型能生成正确答案但无法确认。
AI.motivation: 基准饱和和训练数据污染使得难以判断大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力是否真正提高。需要一个能隔离特定推理过程（如洞察力般的表征重构和元认知评估）的新基准来识别LLM的失败模式。
AI.method: 引入NazoNazo基准，一个基于日本儿童谜语的可再生、可扩展的评估数据集，旨在隔离洞察力般的表征重构和元认知评估。收集了201个谜语，并在120个谜语子集上建立了人类参考（平均准确率52.9%）。在严格的无检索、零样本协议下评估了38个前沿LLM。对模型生成的思维日志进行定性分析以识别失败模式。
AI.result: 在人类对比子集上，非推理模型准确率为7.6%，推理导向模型为17.6%，远低于人类平均52.9%。发现了一种独特的失败模式，称为“验证失败”：模型生成了正确的中间候选答案但未能将其确认为最终答案。在有可用思维日志的模型中，验证失败占模型错误答案的5%到39%。
AI.conclusion: 生成与验证之间的分离揭示了大型语言模型中的一个元认知瓶颈。这项工作提供了一个诊断推理可靠性的实用框架，并提出了具体的改进方向，包括更好的校准、结构化验证和停止机制。
AI.translation: 基准饱和和训练数据污染日益模糊了大型语言模型（LLM）报告的收益是否反映了推理的真正进步，还是对基准问题中重复模式的熟悉。我们引入了NazoNazo基准，这是一个源自日本儿童谜语的可再生和可扩展的评估数据集，它隔离了一类特定的推理过程：洞察力般的表征重构和元认知评估。这些任务并非普遍地建模推理，而是提供了一个针对标准基准中难以检测的失败模式的集中测试。我们收集了201个谜语，并在一个120个项目的子集上建立了人类参考（n = 126；平均准确率52.9%）。该基准完全开放，刷新成本低，并设计用于在降低污染风险的情况下进行持续评估。我们在严格的无检索、零样本协议下评估了38个前沿LLM（2023-2025年）。在人类对比子集上，非推理模型实现了7.6%的准确率，推理导向模型达到了17.6%，而人类平均为52.9%，尽管模型之间的表现差异很大。除了准确率，对模型生成的思维日志的定性分析识别出一种独特的失败模式，我们称之为验证失败：模型生成了正确的中间候选答案但未能将其确认为最终答案。这种候选生成与确认之间的分离揭示了一个元认知瓶颈：在具有可用思维日志的模型中，验证失败占模型错误答案的5%到39%。通过隔离生成与验证之间的差距，这项工作提供了一个诊断推理可靠性的实用框架，并提出了具体的改进方向，包括更好的校准、结构化验证和停止机制。
AI.summary: 本研究通过引入NazoNazo基准（一个基于日本儿童谜语的新型数据集），旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）在需要洞察力般表征重构和元认知评估方面的推理能力。结果表明，LLM在这些任务上的表现远低于人类，并揭示了“验证失败”这一独特的失败模式，即模型能够生成正确的候选答案但无法最终确认。这表明LLM存在一个“元认知瓶颈”，为诊断其推理可靠性提供了框架，并指出了未来改进的方向。
AI.keywords: 元认知瓶颈, 大型语言模型, 推理AI, 日本谜语, 自我评估
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于提出了一个新颖的基准NazoNazo，它有效地规避了传统基准的饱和和数据污染问题，并专注于测试LLM在洞察力和元认知评估方面的深层推理能力。通过引入日本儿童谜语，该基准具有文化独特性和可再生性。发现的“元认知瓶颈”——模型能生成正确候选但无法验证——是一个关键的洞察，揭示了当前LLM在自我评估和决策过程中的根本局限性，对未来AI推理能力的发展具有重要指导意义。

title: A noise-robust Monte Carlo method for electric field calculations in EMC3
summary: EMC3 is a state-of-the-art 3D Monte Carlo code for plasma edge transport in stellarator configurations, but it does not yet treat the $E \times B$ drift self-consistently. Computing the drift requires the electric field $E = -\nabla \varphi$, and hence an accurate gradient of the electric potential $\varphi$. Because the plasma fields produced by EMC3 are inherently noisy, the finite difference approximation used previously amplifies this noise, increasingly so as the grid is refined. We extend the Monte Carlo Gradient Approximation method, originally developed for 1D Fokker--Planck equations, to a 2D setting and apply it to the electric potential. For an isotropic diffusion coefficient, we derive a PDE governing the evolution of the electric field itself, which allows $E$ to be approximated directly by a Monte Carlo simulation, avoiding finite differences altogether. A numerical experiment based on manufactured solutions demonstrates the accuracy of the method and shows that the variance grows substantially more slowly under grid refinement than for finite differences. The resulting formulation contains a source term involving the second poloidal derivative of the potential, which we neglect. This is admissible only when the radial scale of the plasma edge is thin compared to the poloidal variation scale, an ordering expected to fail near X-points, during detachment, and in island divertors such as W7-X. The present work should therefore be regarded as a proof of concept rather than a general electric field solver for EMC3.

AI.title_translation: EMC3中电场计算的噪声鲁棒蒙特卡洛方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种噪声鲁棒的2D蒙特卡洛梯度近似方法，用于EMC3中电场计算，以解决有限差分法的噪声放大问题。该方法通过直接模拟电场PDE提高了精度并减缓了方差增长，但目前仅作为概念验证，在特定等离子体边缘条件下适用。
AI.motivation: EMC3是用于仿星器位形中等离子体边缘输运的3D蒙特卡洛代码，但其尚未自洽处理$E \times B$漂移。计算该漂移需要电场$E = -\nabla \varphi$，即电势$\varphi$的精确梯度。由于EMC3产生的等离子体场本身具有噪声，之前使用的有限差分近似会放大这种噪声，且随着网格细化而日益严重。
AI.method: 本文将最初为1D Fokker--Planck方程开发的蒙特卡洛梯度近似方法扩展到2D环境，并应用于电势。对于各向同性扩散系数，我们推导了一个控制电场本身演化的偏微分方程（PDE），该方程允许通过蒙特卡洛模拟直接近似$E$，从而完全避免了有限差分。
AI.result: 基于制造解的数值实验证明了该方法的准确性，并表明在网格细化下，方差的增长速度比有限差分慢得多。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作应被视为概念验证，而不是EMC3的通用电场求解器，因为它在公式中忽略了一个涉及电势的二阶极向导数的源项，这仅在等离子体边缘的径向尺度与极向变化尺度相比很薄时才可接受，而这种条件预计在X点附近、脱靶期间和W7-X等岛偏滤器中会失效。
AI.translation: EMC3是用于仿星器位形中等离子体边缘输运的先进3D蒙特卡洛代码，但其尚未自洽处理$E \times B$漂移。计算该漂移需要电场$E = -\nabla \varphi$，即电势$\varphi$的精确梯度。由于EMC3产生的等离子体场本身具有噪声，之前使用的有限差分近似会放大这种噪声，且随着网格细化而日益严重。我们将最初为1D Fokker--Planck方程开发的蒙特卡洛梯度近似方法扩展到2D环境，并应用于电势。对于各向同性扩散系数，我们推导了一个控制电场本身演化的偏微分方程（PDE），该方程允许通过蒙特卡洛模拟直接近似$E$，从而完全避免了有限差分。基于制造解的数值实验证明了该方法的准确性，并表明在网格细化下，方差的增长速度比有限差分慢得多。由此产生的公式包含一个涉及电势的二阶极向导数的源项，我们将其忽略。这仅在等离子体边缘的径向尺度与极向变化尺度相比很薄时才可接受，而这种条件预计在X点附近、脱靶期间和W7-X等岛偏滤器中会失效。因此，这项工作应被视为概念验证，而不是EMC3的通用电场求解器。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种噪声鲁棒的2D蒙特卡洛梯度近似方法，用于EMC3代码中的电场计算。该方法通过直接推导电场本身的偏微分方程，并采用蒙特卡洛模拟进行近似，有效解决了传统有限差分法在处理EMC3等离子体场固有噪声时，随着网格细化而噪声放大的问题。数值实验证明了该方法的准确性，并显示其在网格细化下方差增长显著慢于有限差分法。然而，由于忽略了一个源项，该方法仅在特定等离子体边缘条件下适用，不适用于X点附近、脱靶或岛偏滤器等场景，因此被视为概念验证而非通用电场求解器。
AI.keywords: 蒙特卡洛, 电场, EMC3, 噪声鲁棒性, 等离子体边缘
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将蒙特卡洛梯度近似方法扩展至2D，并用于解决EMC3电场计算中噪声放大这一关键问题，通过直接模拟电场PDE避免了有限差分法的弊端，在噪声鲁棒性和方差收敛性方面表现出优势。然而，其主要局限在于对一个源项的忽略，这使得该方法仅在特定等离子体边缘薄径向尺度假设下成立，限制了其在复杂等离子体物理场景（如X点、脱靶或岛偏滤器）中的通用性。因此，该工作虽然是重要的概念验证，但离成为EMC3的通用求解器尚有距离。

title: RobustFlow: Towards Robust Agentic Workflow Generation
summary: The automated generation of agentic workflows is a promising frontier for enabling large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks. However, the empirical study reveals that existing agentic workflow generation methods are not robust. They often generate inconsistent workflows when provided with instructions that are semantically equivalent but phrased differently. This brittleness severely undermines their reliability in real-world applications. To tackle this challenge, we propose RobustFlow, a robust agentic workflow generation system that leverages preference optimization to learn invariance across instruction variations. We also introduce a benchmark of semantically equivalent instruction variants with node-level and graph-level metrics for evaluating workflow generation robustness. By training on these instruction variants, RobustFlow achieves workflow generation robustness scores of 70\%--90\% across diverse perturbations, outperforming existing approaches including AFlow and ScoreFlow. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/RobustFlow.

AI.title_translation: RobustFlow：迈向鲁棒的智能体工作流生成
AI.tldr: 现有智能体工作流生成方法对指令变体不鲁棒，导致输出不一致。RobustFlow通过偏好优化学习指令不变性，显著提高了鲁棒性，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体工作流生成方法不够鲁棒，当指令语义等价但表述不同时，它们会生成不一致的工作流，这严重影响了它们在实际应用中的可靠性。
AI.method: 我们提出了RobustFlow，一个鲁棒的智能体工作流生成系统，它利用偏好优化来学习指令变体间的不变性。同时，我们引入了一个包含语义等价指令变体的基准，并使用节点级和图级指标来评估工作流生成的鲁棒性。
AI.result: RobustFlow在各种扰动下实现了70%—90%的工作流生成鲁棒性分数，优于包括AFlow和ScoreFlow在内的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: RobustFlow通过利用偏好优化和引入新的评估基准，有效解决了智能体工作流生成中的鲁棒性问题，从而提高了LLM在复杂任务中的可靠性。
AI.translation: 智能体工作流的自动化生成是使大型语言模型（LLMs）解决复杂任务的一个有前景的领域。然而，实证研究表明现有的智能体工作流生成方法不够鲁棒。当提供语义等价但措辞不同的指令时，它们经常生成不一致的工作流。这种脆弱性严重削弱了它们在实际应用中的可靠性。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了RobustFlow，一个鲁棒的智能体工作流生成系统，它利用偏好优化来学习指令变体间的不变性。我们还引入了一个包含语义等价指令变体的基准，并使用节点级和图级指标来评估工作流生成的鲁棒性。通过对这些指令变体进行训练，RobustFlow在各种扰动下实现了70%—90%的工作流生成鲁棒性分数，优于包括AFlow和ScoreFlow在内的现有方法。代码已在https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/RobustFlow 公开。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有大型语言模型（LLMs）智能体工作流生成方法在面对语义等价但表述不同的指令时缺乏鲁棒性的问题，提出了一种名为RobustFlow的系统。RobustFlow利用偏好优化来学习指令变体间的不变性，以生成更一致的工作流。为评估鲁棒性，作者还引入了一个新的包含节点级和图级指标的基准。实验结果表明，RobustFlow在不同扰动下能达到70%—90%的工作流生成鲁棒性分数，性能优于AFlow和ScoreFlow等现有方法。
AI.keywords: 智能体工作流, LLMs, 鲁棒性, 偏好优化, 工作流生成
AI.comments: RobustFlow通过明确解决指令变异鲁棒性这一关键挑战，为LLM驱动的智能体工作流的可靠性迈出了重要一步。引入专门的评估基准也对未来的研究具有重要价值。

title: TENET: One Step Toward Test-Driven Development for Repository-Level Code Generation
comments: Accepted at the 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE 2026)
summary: Test-Driven Development (TDD) is a widely adopted practice that requires developers to create and execute tests alongside implementation. With recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), developers can shift from manually writing the code to defining tests as executable specifications and delegating code synthesis to AI agents. However, enabling repository-level TDD under developer-written tests is challenging, requiring: (1) specification enhancement: identifying a concise yet representative test subset from large suites with rich task semantics; (2) retrieval augmentation: using tests to guide reasoning and context retrieval; and (3) test-driven refinement: interpreting test feedback for iterative improvement. We propose TENET, an agentic framework for repository-level code generation under the TDD paradigm. TENET includes: (1) a test harness mechanism that selects a concise test suite to maximize diversity of the target usage scenarios; (2) a tailored agent toolset for efficient retrieval and debugging; and (3) a reflection-based refinement workflow that iteratively analyzes failures and updates implementations. TENET consistently outperforms the strongest baselines across backbones, achieving 69.08% and 81.77% Pass@1 on RepoCod and RepoEval with Claude Sonnet 4, improving by 9.49 and 2.17 percentage points, respectively. Additionally, we present the first systematic study of how test suite characteristics influence LLM agent performance in TDD settings.
comment: Accepted at the 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE 2026)

AI.title_translation: TENET：迈向仓库级代码生成测试驱动开发的一步
AI.tldr: 本文提出了TENET，一个代理框架，用于在测试驱动开发范式下进行仓库级代码生成。TENET通过测试套件选择、定制代理工具集和基于反射的细化工作流程，显著优于现有基线，并在TDD设置中首次系统研究了测试套件特性对LLM代理性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在代码合成方面取得了进展，但要实现基于开发者编写测试的仓库级测试驱动开发（TDD）仍然面临挑战，包括如何从大型测试套件中识别简洁且具代表性的测试子集、如何利用测试指导推理和上下文检索，以及如何解释测试反馈进行迭代改进。
AI.method: 本文提出了TENET，一个代理框架，用于在TDD范式下进行仓库级代码生成。TENET包含：1) 一个测试线束机制，用于选择简洁的测试套件以最大化目标使用场景的多样性；2) 一套定制的代理工具集，用于高效的检索和调试；3) 一个基于反射的细化工作流程，用于迭代分析失败并更新实现。
AI.result: TENET在所有骨干网络上始终优于最强的基线，在使用Claude Sonnet 4时，在RepoCod和RepoEval上分别实现了69.08%和81.77%的Pass@1，分别提高了9.49和2.17个百分点。此外，本文首次系统研究了测试套件特性如何影响TDD设置中LLM代理的性能。
AI.conclusion: TENET框架在仓库级代码生成TDD方面取得了显著进展，通过其创新的测试选择、检索和细化机制，显著提升了LLM代理的性能。研究还首次揭示了测试套件特性对LLM代理在TDD环境下表现的影响。
AI.translation: 测试驱动开发（TDD）是一种广泛采用的实践，它要求开发人员在实现的同时创建和执行测试。随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展，开发人员可以从手动编写代码转变为将测试定义为可执行规范，并将代码合成委托给AI代理。然而，在开发人员编写的测试下实现仓库级TDD具有挑战性，需要：(1) 规范增强：从大型套件中识别出简洁但具有丰富任务语义的代表性测试子集；(2) 检索增强：使用测试来指导推理和上下文检索；以及(3) 测试驱动的细化：解释测试反馈以进行迭代改进。我们提出了TENET，一个在TDD范式下进行仓库级代码生成的代理框架。TENET包括：(1) 一个测试线束机制，用于选择简洁的测试套件以最大化目标使用场景的多样性；(2) 一套定制的代理工具集，用于高效的检索和调试；以及(3) 一个基于反射的细化工作流程，用于迭代分析失败并更新实现。TENET在所有骨干网络上始终优于最强的基线，在使用Claude Sonnet 4时，在RepoCod和RepoEval上分别实现了69.08%和81.77%的Pass@1，分别提高了9.49和2.17个百分点。此外，我们首次系统研究了测试套件特性如何影响TDD设置中LLM代理的性能。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了TENET，一个旨在解决仓库级代码生成中测试驱动开发（TDD）挑战的代理框架。TENET通过创新的测试线束机制选择代表性测试、定制的代理工具集进行高效检索和调试，以及基于反射的细化工作流程来迭代改进代码。实验结果表明，TENET在RepoCod和RepoEval数据集上显著超越了现有基线，并首次系统性地探讨了测试套件特性对大型语言模型（LLM）代理在TDD环境中性能的影响。
AI.keywords: 仓库级代码生成, 测试驱动开发, 大型语言模型, 代理框架, TENET
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一个创新的代理框架TENET，它将测试驱动开发范式与大型语言模型（LLM）的代码生成能力相结合，解决了仓库级代码生成中的关键挑战。其核心创新在于三个方面：智能的测试套件选择机制、为TDD量身定制的代理工具集以及基于反射的迭代细化过程。性能的显著提升证明了其有效性。此外，对测试套件特性影响的首次系统研究也为未来TDD与LLM结合的研究提供了宝贵的见解。

title: The Log-Rank Conjecture: New Equivalent Formulations
summary:
The log-rank conjecture is a longstanding open problem with multiple equivalent formulations in complexity theory and mathematics. In its linear-algebraic form, it asserts that the rank and partitioning number of a Boolean matrix are quasi-polynomially related.
  We propose a relaxed but still equivalent version of the conjecture based on a new matrix parameter, signed rectangle rank: the minimum number of all-1 rectangles needed to express the Boolean matrix as a $\pm 1$-sum. Signed rectangle rank lies between rank and partition number, and our main result shows that it is in fact equivalent to rank up to a logarithmic factor. Additionally, we extend the main result to tensors. This reframes the log-rank conjecture as: can every signed decomposition of a Boolean matrix be made positive with only quasi-polynomial blowup?
  As an application, we prove an equivalence between the log-rank conjecture and a conjecture of Lovett and Singer-Sudan on cross-intersecting set systems.

AI.title_translation: 对数秩猜想：新的等价表述
AI.tldr: 本文提出对数秩猜想的新等价形式，基于“有符号矩形秩”参数，证明其与秩在对数因子内等价，并将其推广到张量，还将其与Lovett和Singer-Sudan的猜想等价起来。
AI.motivation: 对数秩猜想是一个在复杂性理论和数学中存在已久的开放问题，它断言布尔矩阵的秩和划分数是准多项式相关的。
AI.method: 本文提出一个基于新矩阵参数“有符号矩形秩”的猜想的放松但仍等价的版本，该参数定义为将布尔矩阵表示为±1和所需的所有1矩形的最小数量。
AI.result: 主要结果表明，有符号矩形秩在对数因子内与秩等价。此外，该主要结果被推广到张量。作为一个应用，本文证明了对数秩猜想与Lovett和Singer-Sudan关于交叉相交集合系统的猜想之间的等价性。
AI.conclusion: 对数秩猜想被重新定义为：布尔矩阵的每个有符号分解是否都能在准多项式膨胀下变为正数？
AI.translation: 对数秩猜想是一个在复杂性理论和数学中存在已久的开放问题，具有多种等价表述。在其线性代数形式中，它断言布尔矩阵的秩和划分数是准多项式相关的。我们提出一个基于新矩阵参数“有符号矩形秩”的猜想的放松但仍等价的版本：将布尔矩阵表示为±1和所需的所有1矩形的最小数量。有符号矩形秩介于秩和划分数之间，我们的主要结果表明它实际上在对数因子内与秩等价。此外，我们将主要结果推广到张量。这重新定义了对数秩猜想为：布尔矩阵的每个有符号分解是否都能在准多项式膨胀下变为正数？作为一个应用，我们证明了对数秩猜想与Lovett和Singer-Sudan关于交叉相交集合系统的猜想之间的等价性。
AI.summary: 本文针对对数秩猜想这一长期未决问题，提出了一种基于“有符号矩形秩”的新等价表述。该参数定义为将布尔矩阵表示为±1和所需的所有1矩形的最小数量。研究表明，有符号矩形秩在对数因子内与秩等价，并且这一结果可以推广到张量。通过引入这一新参数，对数秩猜想被重新定义为关于有符号分解能否在准多项式膨胀下变为正数的问题。此外，文章还证明了对数秩猜想与Lovett和Singer-Sudan关于交叉相交集合系统的猜想之间的等价性。
AI.keywords: 对数秩猜想, 有符号矩形秩, 布尔矩阵, 复杂性理论, 张量
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入“有符号矩形秩”这一新参数，为解决对数秩猜想提供了一个新颖且放松的视角。将猜想重新定义为关于有符号分解的问题，并将其与另一个已有的猜想建立等价关系，这些都是其创新之处，可能为未来解决该猜想开辟新的研究方向。

title: SALSA-V: Shortcut-Augmented Long-form Synchronized Audio from Videos
summary: We propose SALSA-V, a multimodal video-to-audio generation model capable of synthesizing highly synchronized, high-fidelity long-form audio from silent video content. Our approach introduces a masked diffusion objective, enabling audio-conditioned generation and the seamless synthesis of unconstrained length audio sequences. Additionally, by integrating a shortcut loss into our training process, we achieve rapid generation of high-quality audio samples in as few as eight sampling steps, paving the way for near-real-time applications without requiring dedicated fine-tuning or retraining. We demonstrate that SALSA-V significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in both audiovisual alignment and synchronization with video content in quantitative evaluation and a human listening study. Furthermore, our use of random masking during training enables our model to match spectral characteristics of reference audio samples, broadening its applicability to professional audio synthesis tasks such as Foley generation and sound design.

AI.title_translation: SALSA-V：快捷增强型视频长时同步音频生成
AI.tldr: SALSA-V是一个多模态视频到音频生成模型，能从无声视频生成高度同步、高保真的长时音频，并能快速生成高质量音频，适用于近实时应用和专业音频合成。
AI.motivation: 解决从无声视频内容生成高度同步、高保真、长时音频的挑战，并实现快速生成以支持近实时应用。
AI.method: 提出了SALSA-V模型，该模型引入了蒙版扩散目标，以实现音频条件生成和无限制长度音频序列的无缝合成。通过集成快捷损失，模型可在少量采样步骤内快速生成高质量音频。此外，训练中使用的随机蒙版使其能够匹配参考音频的频谱特性。
AI.result: SALSA-V在视听对齐和与视频内容的同步方面显著优于现有的最先进方法（通过定量评估和人类听力研究）。它能在八个采样步骤内快速生成高质量音频样本，并能匹配参考音频样本的频谱特性，适用于拟音生成和声音设计等专业音频合成任务。
AI.conclusion: SALSA-V通过其创新的蒙版扩散目标和快捷损失，成功实现了从无声视频生成高度同步、高保真、长时音频的能力，并支持快速生成和专业音频合成任务，显著提升了视频到音频生成领域的性能。
AI.translation: 我们提出了SALSA-V，一个多模态视频到音频生成模型，能够从无声视频内容合成高度同步、高保真的长时音频。我们的方法引入了一个蒙版扩散目标，使得音频条件生成和无限制长度音频序列的无缝合成成为可能。此外，通过在训练过程中整合一个快捷损失，我们实现了在短短八个采样步骤内快速生成高质量音频样本，为无需专门微调或再训练的近实时应用铺平了道路。我们证明了SALSA-V在定量评估和人类听力研究中，在视听对齐和与视频内容同步方面均显著优于现有的最先进方法。此外，我们在训练期间使用随机蒙版，使我们的模型能够匹配参考音频样本的频谱特性，从而拓宽了其在专业音频合成任务（如拟音生成和声音设计）中的适用性。
AI.summary: SALSA-V是一种创新的多模态视频到音频生成模型，能够从无声视频内容合成高度同步、高保真的长时音频。它引入了蒙版扩散目标以支持音频条件生成和无限制长度序列合成，并通过集成快捷损失实现快速高质量音频生成。实验结果表明，SALSA-V在视听对齐和同步方面显著优于现有SOTA方法，并能匹配参考音频频谱，拓宽了其在专业音频合成任务中的应用。
AI.keywords: 视频到音频生成, 同步音频, 扩散模型, 快捷损失, 长时音频
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了蒙版扩散目标和快捷损失，这不仅解决了长时、高保真和高度同步视频到音频生成的难题，还显著加快了生成速度，使其具备近实时应用的潜力。随机蒙版的使用进一步扩展了其在拟音和声音设计等专业领域的应用范围，具有重要的实际意义。抽象中未提及具体局限性，但此类模型在处理极端复杂或特定风格音频时可能仍面临挑战。

title: Redefining Generalization in Visual Domains: A Two-Axis Framework for Fake Image Detection with FusionDetect
summary: The rapid development of generative models has made it increasingly crucial to develop detectors that can reliably detect synthetic images. Although most of the work has now focused on cross-generator generalization, we argue that this viewpoint is too limited. Detecting synthetic images involves another equally important challenge: generalization across visual domains. To bridge this gap,we present the OmniGen Benchmark. This comprehensive evaluation dataset incorporates 12 state-of-the-art generators, providing a more realistic way of evaluating detector performance under realistic conditions. In addition, we introduce a new method, FusionDetect, aimed at addressing both vectors of generalization. FusionDetect draws on the benefits of two frozen foundation models: CLIP & Dinov2. By deriving features from both complementary models,we develop a cohesive feature space that naturally adapts to changes in both thecontent and design of the generator. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that FusionDetect delivers not only a new state-of-the-art, which is 3.87% more accurate than its closest competitor and 6.13% more precise on average on established benchmarks, but also achieves a 4.48% increase in accuracy on OmniGen,along with exceptional robustness to common image perturbations. We introduce not only a top-performing detector, but also a new benchmark and framework for furthering universal AI image detection. The code and dataset are available at http://github.com/amir-aman/FusionDetect

AI.title_translation: 重新定义视觉领域中的泛化：基于双轴框架的FusionDetect假图像检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了FusionDetect，一个利用CLIP和Dinov2特征的假图像检测器，并在新的OmniGen基准测试上展示了最先进的性能，解决了跨生成器和跨视觉领域的泛化挑战。
AI.motivation: 生成模型快速发展，合成图像检测变得日益重要。现有工作主要关注跨生成器泛化，但忽略了同样重要的跨视觉领域泛化挑战，导致检测器在实际条件下性能受限。
AI.method: 本文提出了OmniGen基准测试，一个包含12个最先进生成器的综合评估数据集，用于更真实地评估检测器性能。同时，引入了FusionDetect方法，通过结合两个冻结的基础模型（CLIP和Dinov2）的特征，构建了一个能够适应生成器内容和设计变化的统一特征空间，以解决跨生成器和跨视觉领域的泛化问题。
AI.result: FusionDetect在现有基准测试上比最接近的竞争对手准确率高3.87%，精度高6.13%，并在OmniGen上准确率提高了4.48%。它还对常见的图像扰动表现出卓越的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文不仅引入了一个性能卓越的检测器FusionDetect，还提出了一个新的OmniGen基准测试和框架，以推动通用AI图像检测的发展。
AI.translation: 生成模型的快速发展使得开发能够可靠检测合成图像的检测器变得日益重要。尽管目前大多数工作都集中在跨生成器泛化上，但我们认为这种观点过于局限。检测合成图像涉及另一个同样重要的挑战：跨视觉领域的泛化。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了OmniGen基准测试。这个全面的评估数据集包含了12个最先进的生成器，提供了一种更真实的方式来评估检测器在实际条件下的性能。此外，我们引入了一种新方法FusionDetect，旨在解决泛化的两个维度。FusionDetect利用了两个冻结的基础模型（CLIP和Dinov2）的优势。通过从这两个互补模型中提取特征，我们开发了一个统一的特征空间，该空间自然适应生成器内容和设计的变化。我们的大量实验表明，FusionDetect不仅实现了新的最先进水平，比最接近的竞争对手准确率高3.87%，在现有基准测试上平均精度高6.13%，而且在OmniGen上准确率提高了4.48%，同时对常见的图像扰动表现出卓越的鲁棒性。我们不仅引入了一个性能顶级的检测器，还引入了一个新的基准测试和框架，以促进通用AI图像检测的发展。代码和数据集可在http://github.com/amir-aman/FusionDetect获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对合成图像检测中跨生成器和跨视觉领域的双重泛化挑战，提出了FusionDetect方法和OmniGen基准测试。FusionDetect通过融合CLIP和Dinov2的特征，构建了一个鲁棒的特征空间，并在OmniGen和现有基准测试上均展现出最先进的检测性能和对图像扰动的强大鲁棒性。该工作为通用AI图像检测提供了新的框架和工具。
AI.keywords: 假图像检测, 泛化, FusionDetect, OmniGen, CLIP, Dinov2
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“跨视觉领域泛化”的概念，重新定义了假图像检测的泛化挑战，拓宽了研究视野。提出的FusionDetect方法结合了两个强大的基础模型，有效解决了这一复杂问题。同时，OmniGen基准测试的建立为更真实的评估提供了重要的资源，对于推动AI图像检测领域的发展具有重要意义。

title: J-RAS: Mutual Adaptation for Medical Image Segmentation via Contrastive Retrieval-Augmented Joint Optimization
summary: Manual medical image segmentation by clinicians, though accurate, is time-consuming and variable across experts, while AI-based models automate this process but often falter under limited data and domain shifts. Inspired by how humans learn new tasks through guidance such as how children draw more accurately when shown reference images, we propose Joint Retrieval-Augmented Segmentation (J-RAS), a framework that enables segmentation networks to learn with guidance. J-RAS jointly optimizes a segmentation model and a retrieval model through alternating contrastive and supervised learning, allowing the retrieval network to discover contextually relevant image-mask pairs that refine the segmentation model's anatomical reasoning. Unlike conventional retrieval-based augmentation that passively provides similar samples, J-RAS establishes a mutual adaptation and optimization loop where the retrieval model learns to emphasize segmentation-relevant cues, while the segmentation model leverages retrieved examples to improve boundary delineation, robustness to rare cases and and cross-dataset generalization. Evaluations on two public benchmarks, ACDC and M&Ms, across multiple backbones (U-Net, TransUNet, SAM, and SegFormer) demonstrate the generality and effectiveness of J-RAS. For instance, on ACDC, SegFormer improves from a mean Dice of 0.8708$\pm$0.042 and HD of 1.8130$\pm$2.49 to 0.9115$\pm$0.031 and 1.1489$\pm$0.30. These results highlight how retrieval-guided contrastive optimization bridges human-like guidance and machine-learned precision in medical image segmentation.

AI.title_translation: J-RAS：通过对比检索增强联合优化实现医学图像分割的相互适应
AI.tldr: J-RAS通过检索增强的联合优化，使分割网络能从相关图像中学习，提高医学图像分割的准确性和泛化能力，有效解决了数据有限和领域转移的挑战。
AI.motivation: 手动医学图像分割耗时且专家间差异大；现有AI模型在数据有限和领域转移时性能不佳。本文受人类通过参考图像学习的启发，旨在通过指导机制提升分割网络的学习能力。
AI.method: 提出联合检索增强分割（J-RAS）框架，通过交替的对比学习和监督学习，联合优化分割模型和检索模型。检索模型发现上下文相关的图像-掩码对，并与分割模型建立相互适应的优化循环，检索模型强调相关线索，分割模型利用检索示例改进边界、鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.result: 在ACDC和M&Ms两个公共基准上，使用U-Net、TransUNet、SAM和SegFormer等多个骨干网络进行评估，J-RAS显示出通用性和有效性。例如，在ACDC数据集上，SegFormer的平均Dice系数从0.8708$\pm$0.042提高到0.9115$\pm$0.031，HD从1.8130$\pm$2.49降低到1.1489$\pm$0.30。
AI.conclusion: 检索引导的对比优化有效地弥合了医学图像分割中类人指导和机器学习精度之间的鸿沟，显著提升了分割性能。
AI.translation: 临床医生手动进行医学图像分割虽然准确，但耗时且专家之间存在差异，而基于AI的模型自动化此过程，但在数据有限和领域转移的情况下常常失效。受人类通过指导学习新任务的启发，例如儿童在看到参考图像时画得更准确，我们提出了联合检索增强分割（J-RAS），这是一个使分割网络能够通过指导学习的框架。J-RAS通过交替对比学习和监督学习联合优化分割模型和检索模型，使检索网络能够发现与上下文相关的图像-掩码对，从而完善分割模型的解剖学推理。与传统上被动提供相似样本的基于检索的增强不同，J-RAS建立了相互适应和优化循环，其中检索模型学习强调与分割相关的线索，而分割模型利用检索到的示例来改善边界描绘、对罕见情况的鲁棒性以及跨数据集泛化。在ACDC和M&Ms两个公共基准上，通过多个骨干网络（U-Net、TransUNet、SAM和SegFormer）进行的评估证明了J-RAS的通用性和有效性。例如，在ACDC上，SegFormer的平均Dice从0.8708$\pm$0.042和HD 1.8130$\pm$2.49提高到0.9115$\pm$0.031和1.1489$\pm$0.30。这些结果突出表明，检索引导的对比优化如何弥合医学图像分割中类人指导和机器学习精度之间的鸿沟。
AI.summary: J-RAS是一种用于医学图像分割的框架，它通过联合优化分割模型和检索模型，实现相互适应的学习。该方法利用交替的对比和监督学习，使检索模型能发现相关图像-掩码对以指导分割模型，从而提高分割网络的边界描绘、鲁棒性和跨数据集泛化能力，有效解决了传统AI模型在数据有限和领域转移下的挑战。
AI.keywords: 医学图像分割, 检索增强, 对比学习, 联合优化, 相互适应
AI.comments: J-RAS的创新之处在于其相互适应的检索-分割联合优化循环，它将检索模型从被动提供样本转变为主动学习和指导分割模型。这种机制有效地模拟了人类学习中参考图像的指导作用，显著提升了医学图像分割的性能和泛化能力，尤其在处理有限数据和领域转移问题上具有重要意义。

title: IntrinTrans: LLM-based Intrinsic Code Translator for RISC-V Vector
summary: The use of intrinsic functions to leverage hardware-specific capabilities is a crucial approach for optimizing library performance. Many mainstream libraries implement a large number of vectorized algorithms on Arm or x86 SIMD (Single-Instruction, Multiple-Data) intrinsic functions. Translating existing vectorized intrinsic code into the intrinsics of an emerging architecture is a practical and effective approach. However, current cross-architecture translation largely relies on manual rewriting or rule-based mapping methods, which are both time-consuming and prone to errors. We present \texttt{IntrinTrans}, a LLM-based agent that utilizes compile-and-test feedback to translate intrinsic code across architectures automatically, and further optimizes the generated intrinsics using register-usage information derived from liveness analysis. To evaluate the effectiveness of our method, we used \texttt{IntrinTrans} to translate the open-source benchmark from Arm Neon Intrinsic to the emerging RISC-V Vector (RVV) Intrinsic implementation and compared its performance with that of the native RVV implementation. Our experiments show that advanced LLMs can generate semantically correct RVV Intrinsic functions with only a finite number of iterations. Depending on the base LLMs, the pass rate ranges from 47% to 100%, achieving performance similar to the native implementation (0.85x to 1.28x).

AI.title_translation: IntrinTrans：基于LLM的RISC-V向量内在函数代码翻译器
AI.tldr: IntrinTrans是一个基于LLM的代理，它利用编译和测试反馈自动将现有的Arm或x86 SIMD向量化内在函数代码翻译成RISC-V向量内在函数，并使用活跃性分析的寄存器使用信息进行优化，实验表明其翻译的代码在语义上正确且性能接近原生实现。
AI.motivation: 优化库性能的关键方法是利用内在函数以发挥硬件特定能力。许多主流库在Arm或x86 SIMD内在函数上实现了大量向量化算法。将现有向量化内在代码翻译到新兴架构的内在函数是一种实用有效的方法。然而，当前的跨架构翻译主要依赖手动重写或基于规则的映射方法，这些方法既耗时又容易出错。
AI.method: 本文提出了IntrinTrans，一个基于LLM的代理，它利用编译和测试反馈自动进行跨架构内在函数代码翻译，并使用从活跃性分析中导出的寄存器使用信息进一步优化生成的内在函数。该方法通过将Arm Neon Intrinsic翻译为RISC-V Vector (RVV) Intrinsic进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，先进的LLM只需有限的迭代次数即可生成语义正确的RVV内在函数。根据基础LLM的不同，通过率范围从47%到100%，性能与原生实现相似（0.85x到1.28x）。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的方法能够有效地将现有向量化内在函数代码翻译到新兴架构的内在函数，生成语义正确且性能接近原生实现的代码，显著优于传统的手动或基于规则的方法。
AI.translation: 利用内在函数以发挥硬件特定能力是优化库性能的关键方法。许多主流库在Arm或x86 SIMD（单指令、多数据）内在函数上实现了大量向量化算法。将现有向量化内在代码翻译到新兴架构的内在函数是一种实用有效的方法。然而，当前的跨架构翻译主要依赖手动重写或基于规则的映射方法，这些方法既耗时又容易出错。我们提出了\texttt{IntrinTrans}，一个基于LLM的代理，它利用编译和测试反馈自动进行跨架构内在函数代码翻译，并使用从活跃性分析中导出的寄存器使用信息进一步优化生成的内在函数。为了评估我们方法的有效性，我们使用\texttt{IntrinTrans}将开源基准从Arm Neon Intrinsic翻译到新兴的RISC-V Vector (RVV) Intrinsic实现，并将其性能与原生RVV实现进行比较。我们的实验表明，先进的LLM只需有限的迭代次数即可生成语义正确的RVV内在函数。根据基础LLM的不同，通过率范围从47%到100%，性能与原生实现相似（0.85x到1.28x）。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个名为IntrinTrans的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代理，旨在解决将现有Arm或x86 SIMD向量化内在函数代码翻译到新兴架构（如RISC-V Vector）内在函数的挑战。IntrinTrans利用编译和测试反馈机制自动进行代码翻译，并通过活跃性分析获得的寄存器使用信息进一步优化生成的内在函数。实验结果表明，该方法能够生成语义正确且性能接近原生实现的RISC-V向量内在函数，显著提高了翻译效率和准确性，超越了传统的手动或基于规则的方法。
AI.keywords: LLM, 代码翻译, RISC-V Vector, 内在函数, 性能优化
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新性的方法，利用LLM和编译-测试反馈机制解决跨架构内在函数代码翻译的难题，尤其在RISC-V等新兴架构的生态建设中具有重要意义。结合活跃性分析进行优化，进一步提升了生成代码的质量。其在自动化和性能上的表现，展示了LLM在系统级编程和优化领域的巨大潜力，为未来编译器和代码迁移工具的发展提供了新的思路。

title: Influence of Network Topology and Vaccination Strategies on HPV Dynamics: A Simulation Study Using the SeCoNet Growth Model
summary: This study examines how contact network topology influences the effectiveness of vaccination programs in the context of human papillomavirus (HPV) transmission. Using the SeCoNet sexual contact network growth model, we evaluate age based, ring based, and several centrality based vaccination strategies across the overall, male, and female cohorts, focusing on peak incidence, timing of peak prevalence, and cumulative incidence. The simulations show that degree, betweenness, and percolation centrality based strategies are generally the most effective, while ring vaccination achieves the greatest reduction in cumulative incidence among females. Network topology also plays a critical role: higher average degree reduces vaccination effectiveness, whereas higher power-law exponent, longer average shortest path length, and stronger clustering improve vaccination outcomes. The results highlight the importance of incorporating network structure into the design of HPV vaccination programs.

AI.title_translation: 网络拓扑和疫苗接种策略对HPV动态的影响：基于SeCoNet增长模型的模拟研究
AI.tldr: 本研究利用SeCoNet模型模拟了不同网络拓扑和疫苗接种策略对HPV传播的影响，发现基于中心性的策略通常最有效，且网络拓扑对疫苗效果有显著影响。
AI.motivation: 本研究旨在探讨接触网络拓扑如何影响人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）传播背景下疫苗接种计划的有效性。
AI.method: 研究使用了SeCoNet性接触网络增长模型，评估了基于年龄、基于环和几种基于中心性的疫苗接种策略，针对总体、男性和女性人群，重点关注峰值发病率、峰值流行时间点和累积发病率。
AI.result: 模拟结果表明，基于度、介数和渗流中心性的策略通常最有效，而环状疫苗接种在女性中实现了累积发病率的最大降低。网络拓扑也起着关键作用：平均度越高，疫苗接种效果越差；而幂律指数越高、平均最短路径长度越长、聚类强度越强，疫苗接种效果越好。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了在设计HPV疫苗接种计划时纳入网络结构的重要性。
AI.translation: 本研究探讨了接触网络拓扑如何影响人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）传播背景下疫苗接种计划的有效性。我们利用SeCoNet性接触网络增长模型，评估了基于年龄、基于环和几种基于中心性的疫苗接种策略，涵盖总体、男性和女性人群，重点关注峰值发病率、峰值流行时间点和累积发病率。模拟结果显示，基于度、介数和渗流中心性的策略通常是最有效的，而环状疫苗接种在女性中实现了累积发病率的最大降低。网络拓扑也起着关键作用：平均度越高会降低疫苗接种的有效性，而幂律指数越高、平均最短路径长度越长、聚类强度越强则能改善疫苗接种效果。研究结果强调了在设计HPV疫苗接种计划时纳入网络结构的重要性。
AI.summary: 本研究利用SeCoNet性接触网络增长模型，模拟了不同网络拓扑和疫苗接种策略对HPV传播动态的影响。结果发现，基于度、介数和渗流中心性的疫苗接种策略通常最有效，而环状疫苗接种在女性中对降低累积发病率效果显著。研究还揭示了网络拓扑的关键作用：高平均度会降低疫苗效果，而高幂律指数、长平均最短路径和强聚类则能提高疫苗效果。这强调了在HPV疫苗接种计划设计中考虑网络结构的重要性。
AI.keywords: HPV, 疫苗接种策略, 网络拓扑, 模拟研究, SeCoNet模型
AI.comments: 该研究通过模拟方法深入探讨了网络拓扑和疫苗接种策略对HPV传播的影响，其创新之处在于使用了SeCoNet模型并对比了多种中心性策略，揭示了网络结构在公共卫生干预中的关键作用，为未来HPV疫苗接种计划的优化设计提供了重要的理论依据。

title: A Configuration-First Framework for Reproducible, Low-Code Localization
summary: As machine learning (ML) increasingly underpins critical applications, credible, comparable, and repeatable experimental results become more important. Everyday workflows should make rigorous experiment specification and controlled execution the default while allowing advanced experimentation when required. In practice, researchers still have to combine tools for configuration, execution, versioning, and evaluation, and repeat common implementation work within their application domain. In this paper, we present a configuration-first design for application-specific ML experimentation frameworks and implement it as LOCALIZE for radio-localization research. Experiments are declared in human-readable configuration files, a workflow orchestrator executes isolated stages with explicit inputs and outputs, and code, data, configurations, environment specifications, and generated artifacts are versioned. LOCALIZE provides preconfigured datasets, processing stages, model-development procedures, and experiment templates while retaining access to the underlying pipeline. Through a qualitative comparison and controlled quantitative studies comparing LOCALIZE with corresponding Jupyter notebook and Kedro implementations, we show that, within the studied localization workflows, LOCALIZE requires fewer codebase edits for changes supported by its localization-specific functionality, while total wall-clock time and peak memory usage remain comparable. In a controlled scaling experiment covering 1x, 5x, and 10x the base dataset volume, we observed sublinear growth in total CPU and wall time over the tested sizes.

AI.title_translation: 一种可复现、低代码定位的配置优先框架
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了LOCALIZE，一个用于无线电定位研究的配置优先机器学习实验框架，它提高了可复现性并减少了代码编辑量。
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习（ML）日益成为关键应用的基础，可信、可比较和可重复的实验结果变得越来越重要。现有ML实验工作流程通常需要组合多种工具并重复常见的实现工作，这阻碍了严格的实验规范和受控执行。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种针对特定应用ML实验框架的配置优先设计。他们将此设计实现为LOCALIZE，专用于无线电定位研究。LOCALIZE通过人类可读的配置文件声明实验，工作流协调器执行具有明确输入和输出的独立阶段，并对代码、数据、配置、环境规范和生成的工件进行版本控制。它提供预配置的数据集、处理阶段、模型开发过程和实验模板，同时保留对底层管道的访问。
AI.result: 通过定性比较和受控定量研究（与Jupyter notebook和Kedro实现对比），结果表明LOCALIZE在支持其定位特定功能的更改方面需要更少的代码库编辑，而总挂钟时间和峰值内存使用量保持可比。在涵盖基准数据集容量1倍、5倍和10倍的受控扩展实验中，观察到总CPU和挂钟时间呈次线性增长。
AI.conclusion: LOCALIZE作为一种配置优先框架，在不显著增加计算开销的情况下，提高了无线电定位ML实验的可复现性并减少了开发工作量。
AI.translation: 随着机器学习（ML）日益成为关键应用的基础，可信、可比较和可重复的实验结果变得越来越重要。日常工作流程应将严格的实验规范和受控执行作为默认设置，同时在需要时允许进行高级实验。实际上，研究人员仍然需要组合配置、执行、版本控制和评估工具，并在其应用领域内重复常见的实现工作。在本文中，我们提出了一种针对特定应用ML实验框架的配置优先设计，并将其实现为用于无线电定位研究的LOCALIZE。实验在人类可读的配置文件中声明，工作流协调器执行具有明确输入和输出的独立阶段，并且代码、数据、配置、环境规范和生成的工件都经过版本控制。LOCALIZE提供预配置的数据集、处理阶段、模型开发过程和实验模板，同时保留对底层管道的访问。通过定性比较和受控定量研究，将LOCALIZE与相应的Jupyter notebook和Kedro实现进行比较，我们表明，在所研究的定位工作流程中，LOCALIZE在支持其定位特定功能的更改方面需要更少的代码库编辑，而总挂钟时间和峰值内存使用量保持可比。在涵盖基准数据集容量1倍、5倍和10倍的受控扩展实验中，我们观察到在测试规模上总CPU和挂钟时间呈次线性增长。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了LOCALIZE，一个配置优先框架，旨在提高机器学习实验（特别是无线电定位研究）的可复现性并减少开发工作量。它通过人类可读的配置、隔离的工作流阶段和全面的版本控制来简化实验规范和执行。比较结果表明，LOCALIZE在特定领域更改方面减少了代码库编辑，同时保持了与现有工具相当的挂钟时间和内存使用量等性能指标，并展现了高效的扩展能力。
AI.keywords: 可复现ML, 低代码, 定位, 配置优先, 实验框架
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于其“配置优先”的方法，专为应用特定的ML实验设计，并在无线电定位领域得到了具体展示。该框架通过整合配置、执行和版本控制，解决了ML研究中可复现性和效率的实际挑战，从而有可能简化复杂的实验工作流程。其低代码特性和已证实的效率提升具有重要意义。

title: Effective Game-Theoretic Motion Planning via Nested Search
comments: Updated version. Offline graph creation runtime added. Acknowledgements added
summary: To facilitate effective, safe deployment in the real world, individual robots must reason about interactions with other agents, which often occur without explicit communication. Recent work has identified game theory, particularly the concept of Nash Equilibrium (NE), as a key enabler for behavior-aware decision-making. Yet, existing work falls short of fully unleashing the power of game-theoretic reasoning. Specifically, popular optimization-based methods require simplified robot dynamics and tend to get trapped in local minima due to convexification. Other works that rely on payoff matrices suffer from poor scalability due to the explicit enumeration of all possible trajectories. To bridge this gap, we introduce Game-Theoretic Nested Search (GTNS), a novel, scalable, and provably correct approach for computing NEs in general dynamical systems. GTNS efficiently searches the action space of all agents involved, while discarding trajectories that violate the NE constraint (no unilateral deviation) through an inner search over a lower-dimensional space. Our algorithm enables explicit selection among equilibria by utilizing a user-specified global objective, thereby capturing a rich set of realistic interactions. We demonstrate the approach on a variety of autonomous driving and racing scenarios where we achieve solutions in mere seconds on commodity hardware.
